issuer.description: The issuer resolved from the discovery document.

client_id.description: The OAuth client ID registered with the identity provider.

client_secret_set.description: Whether a client secret is stored. The secret itself is never returned.

subject_claim.description: The ID-token claim used as the stable user identifier.

email_claim.description: The ID-token claim used as the user's email address.

extra_scopes.description: Scopes requested beyond the default "openid email".

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: The negotiated client-authentication method at the token endpoint.

SSONameIDFormat.description:
SAML NameID format used as the member's permanent identity key. Assertions
with a different format are rejected. Omitting it resolves the format from your
identity provider's metadata, in one order: `persistent` if the metadata advertises
it, otherwise `email` if it advertises that, otherwise `persistent`. So a provider
advertising both resolves to `persistent`, and configuring a connection by hand
advertises nothing and also resolves to `persistent`. Send the value explicitly if
your provider asserts an email NameID.

- `persistent`: Uses an opaque, immutable identifier. Prefer this when your
  identity provider supports it. Email-shaped persistent IDs are rejected.
- `email`: Uses the email address. Reassigning an address can transfer access
  to the account and roles associated with that address.

SSOConnectionSAMLConfig.description: SAML configuration for a connection, resolved from metadata and any directly provided fields.

idp_metadata_url.description: The identity provider's SAML metadata document URL, if configured.

idp_metadata_last_fetched_at.description: When the metadata document was last read from that URL.

idp_sso_url.description: The identity provider's single sign-on URL.

certificate_count.description: The number of identity-provider signing certificates configured.

certificate_expires_at.description: The earliest expiry across the configured signing certificates.

SSOConnectionSAMLSP.description:
The values to register with your identity provider for this connection. Every one is derived from the connection's own ID and none depends on the identity provider, so they are present from the moment the connection exists.

That is the point of them: a SAML connection can be created before its identity provider is configured, and registering these there is how you configure it.

sp_entity_id.description: Service-provider entity ID for this connection. Configure it as the audience at your identity provider.

acs_url.description: Assertion Consumer Service URL where your identity provider posts its SAML response.

sp_metadata_url.description: Service-provider metadata document for this connection. Identity providers that support metadata import can read the entity ID and Assertion Consumer Service URL from it.

initiate_login_url.description: Where a browser starts a sign-in for this connection. A click on an app tile posts to the Assertion Consumer Service URL instead of arriving here. Use this URL wherever your identity provider asks for a sign-on URL. It also provides a link that takes members directly to this connection's sign-in.

SSOIdPConnection.description: An identity-provider connection: what members see on the sign-in button, what a first sign-in grants them, and the protocol details to register at the provider. At most one protocol block is present, and a SAML connection created with `configure_later` has none until its details arrive. `saml_sp` is there from the start either way, since every value in it derives from the connection itself.

display_name.description: The organization name shown next to the sign-in button.

default_jit_role.description: Role granted to a member provisioned on their first sign-in. Scoped by `default_jit_workspace_id`: a workspace role when one is set, an organization role when it is not, never both.

default_jit_workspace_id.description: Workspace new users are added to on first sign-in, if any.

allow_idp_initiated_saml.description: Whether members can start signing in at your identity provider, from an app tile rather than from your sign-in page. SAML only, and false on an OIDC connection, which has no identity-provider-initiated flow of its own.

data.description: The organization's identity-provider connections.

SSOIdPConnectionOIDCCreate.description: OIDC configuration for a new connection.

issuer_url.description: The identity provider's issuer. Bird appends `/.well-known/openid-configuration` to it and reads the OpenID discovery document from there. A bare host is accepted and assumed to be https, so an Okta tenant can be entered as `acme.okta.com`. A discovery document URL is accepted too and is reduced to the issuer it belongs to.

client_id.description: The OAuth client ID registered with the identity provider.

client_secret.description: The OAuth client secret. Write-only; never returned.

subject_claim.description: ID-token claim to use as the stable user identifier. Defaults to "sub".

email_claim.description: ID-token claim to use as the user's email. Defaults to "email".

extra_scopes.description: Scopes to request beyond the default "openid email".

SSOIdPConnectionSAMLCreate.description:
SAML configuration for a new connection. Supply the identity provider's metadata URL to resolve the entity ID, sign-in URL, and signing certificates from it; any field provided directly overrides the metadata.

Set `configure_later` instead to create the connection without them. The values you have to register with your identity provider are derived from the connection's own ID, so they do not exist until the connection does. Send the details afterwards with the SAML configuration endpoint.

configure_later.description: Create the connection without identity-provider details. Its entity ID and Assertion Consumer Service URL become available immediately, to register with your identity provider; the connection stays a draft, serves no sign-ins, and cannot be activated until the details arrive.

idp_metadata_url.description: The identity provider's SAML metadata document URL. The service fetches and parses it.

idp_entity_id.description: The identity provider's entity ID. Required when no metadata URL is provided.

idp_sso_url.description: The identity provider's single sign-on URL. Required when no metadata URL is provided.

idp_x509_certs.description: One to five PEM-encoded signing certificates. Required when no metadata URL is provided.

preferred_nameid_format.description: Overrides the format the identity provider's metadata advertises. Not accepted with `configure_later`: the format is stored on the configuration row, which that branch does not create, so send it with the details instead.

signed_requests.description: Whether authentication requests are signed. `true` is rejected. Omit this field and configure your identity provider not to require a signed `AuthnRequest`.

allow_idp_initiated_saml.description: Whether members can start signing in at your identity provider, from an app tile rather than from the sign-in page. On unless you set it to false.

SSOIdPConnectionCreate.description: Create an identity-provider connection. Provide exactly one of oidc or saml to select the single sign-on protocol.

display_name.description: The organization name shown next to the sign-in button.

default_jit_role.description: Role granted to users provisioned on their first sign-in. Required: a connection that grants nothing authenticates people into an organization they then have no access to, which needs a second, manual invitation to undo. Scoped by default_jit_workspace_id: a workspace role when one is set, an organization role when it is not. Granted only on first provisioning, and never over an existing grant, so it cannot change the access of someone who is already a member.

default_jit_workspace_id.description: Workspace to add new users to on first sign-in.

SSOIdPConnectionUpdate.description: Partially update an SSO connection's branding and JIT settings. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

display_name.description: The organization name shown next to the sign-in button.

default_jit_role.description: Role granted to a member provisioned on their first sign-in. Scoped by `default_jit_workspace_id`: a workspace role when one is set, an organization role when it is not, never both. Granted only on first provisioning, so it cannot change the access of someone who is already a member.

default_jit_workspace_id.description: Workspace to add new users to on first sign-in.

allow_idp_initiated_saml.description: Whether members can start signing in at your identity provider, from an app tile rather than from your sign-in page. SAML only: sending it for an OIDC connection is refused rather than stored, because nothing would read it.

preferred_nameid_format.description:
The NameID format this connection expects (SAML connections only). Set this
to correct a connection that nobody can sign in through. The API refuses an
assertion whose format does not match. A connection carrying the wrong value
has signed nobody in, so correcting it costs nothing.

Once members have signed in through the connection the format is fixed:
resending the current value is accepted, and changing it is refused. Their
identities are keyed on the identifier the old format sent, and nothing the
new format sends would match them. Create a connection for the new format
instead.

SSOConnectionSAMLConfigure.description:
The identity provider's details for a SAML connection created without them. Supply exactly one of a metadata URL, the metadata document itself, or the entity ID with the sign-in URL and signing certificates.

All three are validated identically, so a connection configured one way behaves the same as one configured another.

idp_metadata_url.description: The identity provider's SAML metadata document URL. The service fetches and parses it.

idp_metadata_xml.description: The identity provider's SAML metadata document, for a provider that hands out a file rather than hosting it. Parsed for the entity ID, sign-in URL and signing certificates; the document itself is not stored.

idp_entity_id.description: The identity provider's entity ID. Required when no metadata is provided.

idp_sso_url.description: The identity provider's single sign-on URL. Required when no metadata is provided.

idp_x509_certs.description: One to five PEM-encoded signing certificates. Required when no metadata is provided.

SSOConnectionTestStart.description: Where to send a browser to run a connection test.

start_url.description: Open this URL in a browser window to run the test. It sends the browser through a real sign-in at your identity provider and back, and reports what the identity provider returned. Single-use, and it expires shortly after it is issued.

SSOConnectionStatusTarget.description: The status to move a connection to. A deliberate subset of the connection's own status values: `draft` is only ever the state a connection is created in, and deleting is its own operation, so neither can be set here.

SSOConnectionCredentialRotation.description: New credentials for an existing connection. Provide the field that matches the connection's protocol: client_secret for OIDC, idp_x509_certs for SAML.

client_secret.description: The new OAuth client secret issued by your identity provider. Write-only; never returned.

idp_x509_certs.description: The identity provider's new PEM-encoded signing certificates, replacing the current set.

TrustDisplayStatus.description:
Where a trust requirement stands.

- `verified`: the requirement is met.
- `in_progress`: a verification is being reviewed.
- `action_required`: you need to complete a step.
- `under_review`: the requirement is being assessed and needs no action from you.

TrustGateUnlock.description: A capability that this trust requirement unlocks once it is satisfied.

action.description: Stable key for the unlocked capability. Use it to link directly to the capability and display `label` to customers.

label.description: Human-readable name of the unlocked capability.

TrustGateRemediation.description: What happens next for a trust requirement that is not yet verified. This may be a step you take or a review you wait on. Present for every non-verified state.

kind.description: What resolves this requirement: completing a hosted verification, running a built-in verification flow, or waiting for a review (no action from you).

TrustGate.description: A trust requirement and its current state for your organization.

slug.description: Stable identifier for the trust requirement.

name.description: Human-readable name of the trust requirement.

unlocks.description: The capabilities this requirement unlocks once it is satisfied.

remediation.description: What happens next while the requirement is not yet verified: a step you take or a review you wait on. Present for every non-verified state; null only once the requirement is verified.

data.description: Your organization's trust requirements, each with its current state.

EmailVerificationStart.description: Destination for a requirement verified by email.

email.description: The email address to send the one-time code to.

PhoneVerificationStart.description: Destination for a requirement verified by phone.

phone_number.description: The phone number, in E.164 format, to send the one-time code to.

TrustVerificationStart.description: Optional input for starting a verification. Only used for a requirement verified with a one-time code, where it names the destination the code is sent to; ignored for a provider-hosted verification. The requirement determines which variant applies.

TrustVerificationLaunch.description: A started verification flow. A requirement verified through a provider-hosted flow returns a hosted URL to redirect the customer to; a requirement verified with a one-time code returns its destination and, when known, delivery channel.

hosted_url.description: The hosted URL where the customer completes the verification. Null for a requirement verified with a one-time code.

channel.description: The channel a one-time code was sent over. Omitted for a provider-hosted verification or while the delivery channel is not yet known.

sent_to.description: For a requirement verified with a one-time code, a masked version of where it was sent (for example j•••@example.com). Omitted for a provider-hosted verification.

expires_at.description: When the hosted URL or one-time code expires. Null when it does not expire.

TrustVerificationCheck.description: The one-time code sent to complete a verification.

code.description: The one-time code you received.

TrustAction.description:
An action whose trust requirements are enforced.

- `buy_number`: allocate a dedicated phone number.
- `register_sender_id`: submit a sender for a country's registration program.
- `add_sender_id`: claim an alphanumeric sender.
- `register_verified_number`: register a phone number as a verified caller ID.

Read-only and open: an action is added here whenever a new capability starts
requiring verified standing, so treat an unlisted value as valid rather than
rejecting it.

TrustActionGate.description: One trust requirement an action depends on, and where it stands for your organization.

slug.description: Stable identifier for the trust requirement.

name.description: Human-readable name of the trust requirement.

satisfied.description: Whether this individual requirement is met. An organization override can permit the action without changing this status.

remediation.description: What happens next while the requirement is not yet verified: a step you take or a review you wait on. Present for every non-verified state; null only once the requirement is verified.

TrustActionRequirements.description: What an action requires of your organization, and how far you have got.

action.description: The action these requirements belong to.

satisfied.description: Whether the trust and organization eligibility checks permit the action. An organization override can permit it while individual requirements remain unmet. Permission is checked again when the action is submitted.

gates.description: The requirements the action depends on, in the order to present them. Working through them in order is advice rather than a constraint: each can be completed independently. These statuses describe verification facts; use the top-level `satisfied` value to decide whether to offer the action.

AdminCLISessionHandoffPurpose.description: Fixed purpose shown on the approval page. Staff CLI/MCP access releases a separate credential limited to approved Admin operations. Legacy purposes release the browser session and are unavailable under full Okta enforcement. No purpose attests the requesting machine.

purpose.description: Request CLI/MCP or local frontend development access. Omit for existing CLI/MCP behavior.

AdminCLISessionHandoffCode.description: Short code to match between the requesting process and approval page. The CLI- prefix requests Okta-backed staff credentials. DEV- identifies legacy frontend development; unprefixed codes identify legacy CLI/MCP session access.

approval_url.description: Approval URL relative to the configured staff application base.

polling_secret.description: Process-local secret used only to poll this handoff.
Secret issued to the process that started the handoff.

AdminCLISessionHandoffStatus.description:
- `pending` means no credential is available, including for an unknown or incorrect secret.
- `approved` releases a staff credential for `staff-cli-mcp`, or a browser session for a legacy purpose, in this response.
- `denied` means the staff member refused this handoff.
- `expired` means the handoff deadline passed; start login again.
- `consumed` means a staff credential was already issued; it cannot be recovered by polling, so start login again if its response was lost.

session_token.description: Existing staff session for process-local use only.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry of the existing session.

idle_expires_at.description: Current idle expiry of the existing session.

access_token.description: Staff access credential held only by the approved process.

refresh_token.description: Single-use credential for renewing access within the approved lifetime.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry of this access credential.

refresh_expires_at.description: Absolute deadline for renewing this grant, subject to the approving session remaining valid.

session.description: Present only when approval releases the staff session.

credential.description: Present only when Okta approval releases a separate staff credential.

AdminCLISessionHandoffDecisionValue.description: Staff decision for the displayed request.

from.description: The value before, as JSON text. Absent when the field was not set.

to.description: The value after, as JSON text.

AdminOperationConfirmationRevision.description: A staff revision of a proposal, in the order it was added.

number.description: The revision's number. Revision 1 is the agent's proposal.

changes.description: The fields it changed against the revision before it.

AdminOperationConfirmationEditableField.description: A body field a revision may change, with what the field accepts.

type.description: The field's JSON type, such as `string` or `boolean`.

enum.description: The values the field accepts, when it has a fixed set.

AdminOperationConfirmation.description: One immutable proposed sensitive admin operation and the result of running it. The proposal is frozen: running it sends these exact bytes and nothing else.

operation.description: Operation id of the proposed call.

region.description: Region whose API must run a regional operation. Absent for a global operation, which runs on any region's API.

staff_grant_id.description: The staff grant the proposing agent held. Proposals that share it came from the same agent session.

revision.description: The revision a run executes, or executed once the proposal completed. `review` and `execution` describe this revision.

admitted_revision.description: The revision a run was admitted for, once one passed the confirmation check and went on to the operation. Absent when no run was ever admitted, so nothing ran through this proposal.

revisions.description: The staff member's revisions, oldest first; empty when the agent's request runs as proposed.

editable.description: The body fields a revision may change. Absent when the operation runs only as proposed.

expires_at.description: When this proposal stops being executable. After this deadline, a recorded result remains retrievable until the proposal is deleted.

completed_at.description: When the operation's result was recorded. It keeps the time of the first recorded result, even when concurrent executions complete.

completed_by_user_id.description: The person whose session executed the operation. Present means the operation returned its own success on that session's request; Bird records it even when the response then fails to reach the browser. Absent means no executor was recorded. Older records may not include this value.

AdminCreateOperationConfirmation.description: One sensitive admin operation to freeze for the proposing staff member to run in the admin app.

operation.description: Operation id of the admin call being proposed. Only admin operations Bird supports confirming are accepted.

region.description: Region whose API runs a regional operation. Required for a regional operation and refused for a global one.

AdminOperationConfirmationChangeInput.description: One editable body field a revision sets.

pointer.description: JSON pointer to the field, one of the proposal's `editable` pointers.

value.description: The field's new value as JSON text, such as `"scam"` or `true`.

AdminCreateOperationConfirmationRevision.description: The staff member's revision of a proposal's editable fields.

revision.description: The revision the change is made to, as read. A proposal revised since then refuses it, so a stale page cannot replace a revision nobody reviewed.

changes.description: The editable fields the revision sets, each pointer once.

return_to.description: Admin path to resume after sign-in.

authorization_url.description: Okta sign-in URL for this browser's one-use challenge.

AdminAccessMode.description: Operations that require Okta access in addition to the Bird session. `disabled` uses existing Bird session access. `staff` requires Okta access for listing, viewing, creating, updating and deleting Staff records. `all_admin` requires Okta access for every admin business operation; starting, completing, checking and ending Okta access remain available with the Bird session. Legacy CLI session handoffs are unavailable in `all_admin`.

elevated.description: Whether this browser has live Okta admin access.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry of the current admin access. Absent without live access.

idle_expires_at.description: Idle expiry of the current admin access. Absent without live access.

code.description: Authorization code returned by Okta.

state.description: One-use challenge returned by Okta.

return_to.description: Validated admin path to resume after sign-in.

email.description: The staff member's email address.

AdminWorkProfileId.description: A personal Admin work profile; selecting one never changes staff permissions.

AdminActiveWorkProfile.description: The selected work profile, or null to use the staff role default.

AdminPinnedItems.description: Ordered navigation shortcut identifiers. Null uses the default empty selection; an empty array explicitly keeps the selection empty.

AdminHomeSectionId.description: A supported section of the personal Admin Home.

AdminHomeSections.description: Ordered Home section identifiers. Null uses the role defaults; an empty array keeps the selection empty.

prompt.description: Instructions used for this composer action.

AdminComposerAI.description: Personal composer actions. Prompt identifiers must be unique and default_prompt_id must identify one of the saved prompts; invalid combinations return 422.

default_prompt_id.description: Identifier of the saved prompt run by a single click.

profiles.description: Saved work profiles for the authenticated staff account in this environment. Profiles without saved choices start with no pins and use role defaults for Home sections.

profile.description: Required when updating pins or Home sections.

AdminCrmObject.description: Record collection available in the CRM workbench. Existing Leads support field updates through the current writer. Note creation on Leads requires Bird to be the authoritative writer. Generic Lead creation remains unsupported. Inquiry-linked Lead status and rejection reason changes require Sales lifecycle actions; CRM-only Leads can update these fields directly. Native Lead notes require CRM write permission and do not change the Sales lifecycle.

AdminCrmIdentifier.description: CRM UUID for an imported Attio entity or a native Bird CRM entity; this is not a Bird TypeID.

AdminCrmAttribute.description: Current Attio attribute definition. Only fields that can be edited in the workbench are marked writable.

slug.description: Attribute API slug.

title.description: Attribute label.

items.description: Allowed target object slug or UUID.

currency_code.description: Currency defined by this Attio field; null for other types.

AdminCrmAttributeList.description: Current non-archived attributes in Attio display order.

AdminCrmAttributeOption.description: An existing Attio select option or status.

title.description: Choice label.

AdminCrmAttributeOptionList.description: Available choices for an Attio field.

AdminCrmRecordIdentifier.description: CRM record TypeID of a company, person, lead or opportunity; a reference to a non-Admin source object keeps its source UUID. Responses return the TypeID. A bare UUID is still accepted as input until the CRM typed-ID transition closes.

AdminCrmMemberIdentifier.description: CRM member TypeID. A member is a CRM identity that preserves imported members; it is not an Auth user ID. Responses return the TypeID. A bare UUID is still accepted as input until the CRM typed-ID transition closes.

AdminCrmWorkState.description: Retained Sales work across canonical lead aliases, independent of record assignment. Needs attention includes a thread awaiting human work even when a separate thread has active AI; otherwise it excludes AI handling and known rejection and requires no owner or no recorded outreach. AI handling is persisted workflow eligibility, not worker or provider health.

AdminCrmOpportunityOutcome.description: Explicit Sales meaning of an opportunity stage. Unknown means no current mapping; no label-based meaning or forecast probability is inferred.

AdminCrmFieldValue.description: A field value from Attio, retaining its label and any explicit reference or currency. A reference to a company, person, lead or deal returns that record TypeID as value with its object slug as target_object; a workspace-member reference returns a member TypeID. A reference to any other source object, or to an object the object catalog does not know, keeps its source UUID and stored target_object.

value.description: Scalar value or reference identifier.

label.description: Display text recorded by Attio.

target_object.description: Object slug or actor type for a reference; null for other values.

currency_code.description: ISO currency code returned by Attio; null for non-currency fields.

first_name.description: Explicit personal-name component; null for other field types.

last_name.description: Explicit personal-name component; null for other field types.

country_code.description: Country code supplied by Attio for a location. Omitted for other values or missing location data.

region.description: State or region supplied by Attio for a location. Omitted when unavailable.

slug.description: Attribute API slug.

AdminCrmLeadAccountState.description:
Account resolution from retained, verified identity evidence.
- `linked`: One Bird signup is verified. Signup time and user are present; organization and signals are included when available.
- `not_linked`: No eligible verified signup was found. Account identity, signup time and signals are omitted.
- `ambiguous`: Identity evidence conflicts or resolves to multiple candidates. Account identity, signup time and signals are omitted.

AdminCrmLeadAccount.description: Account summary resolved through explicit CRM identity or authenticated inquiry linkage. Signup time is from Bird's signup ledger, never the CRM record or demo request creation time.

signals_unavailable.description: The account was resolved but its current signal lookup failed. Missing signals with false means no snapshot has been observed.

AdminCrmLeadWork.description: Retained Sales work summary projected into CRM. Absent when a current projection is unavailable. Independent of CRM owner and lifecycle; active automation means eligible AI handling, not worker health.

source_present.description: Whether the current observation found retained Sales activity linked to this Lead. False does not establish whether historical outreach occurred. Older responses may omit this field.

observed_at.description: Time the authoritative sources were sampled. Queue state can lag changes until the next reconciliation.

valid_until.description: Earliest source expiry or five-minute freshness deadline. Expired projections never establish an operational queue count.

human_work_required.description: A retained, non-rejected shared conversation outside active AI has waiting inbound or no acknowledged outreach, or captured Gmail has a customer message newer than its latest verified outbound message. Gmail replies require a person even when AI handles a separate shared conversation.

mail_activity_complete.description: Whether every relevant retained captured Gmail message can be classified relative to its contact. False or null means email activity evidence is incomplete and does not establish an unread reply or absence of outreach. An absent field is an older response with unknown classification availability. True does not establish external mailbox sync freshness or completeness. Incomplete evidence remains eligible for Needs attention independently of shared-conversation automation.

automation_active.description: At least one retained, non-rejected inquiry is in qualifying or question status with automatic or approval handling enabled and not paused.

outreach_recorded.description: Retained evidence confirms outreach through CRM, accepted or delivered conversation messages, a provider-acknowledged Gmail send, or a captured Gmail SENT message with its connected mailbox as sender. Queued or failed sends do not establish outreach.

AdminCrmRecord.description: Company, person, deal or lead stored in Bird CRM, without inferred Bird identity or commercial values. The id is the record TypeID, with a cpy_, per_, opp_ or led_ prefix matching object.

revision.description: Committed Bird revision. Absent on records imported without a native mutation.

title.description: Record name, or null when unnamed.

created_at.description: When the source created the record.

can_reassign_owner.description: Whether the single-record Opportunity read confirmed native current-recipient admission support and a writable single-value owner field. Absent in list and mutation responses or when the writer or schema is unavailable. Does not grant write permission; guarded updates require require_native and recheck current recipient, owner and revision.

can_create_note.description: Whether the single-record read confirmed note creation is supported by the current CRM owner. Leads require Bird write authority. Absent in list and mutation responses or when authority is unavailable. Does not grant write permission; creation rechecks authority.

can_update_lead_status.description: Whether a single-record Lead read confirmed that no retained inquiry or Sales lifecycle command owns its status and rejection reason. False requires Sales lifecycle actions. Absent when ownership could not be checked, for other objects, or in list and mutation responses. This does not grant write permission or override CRM field restrictions; updates recheck ownership.

signup_and_demo.description: Whether retained demo and authenticated signup evidence is linked to this Lead or its single linked Person. False means no verified retained match, not that the person never signed up. Absent when history is unavailable or identity is ambiguous. Does not replace the original entry_point.

total.description: Total records matching all filters across all pages when include_total is true; otherwise null.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Pass back as `starting_after` to advance forward. `null` when no next page exists.

prev_cursor.description: Cursor for the previous page. Pass back as `ending_before` to step backward. `null` when no previous page exists.

refresh_cursor.description: Refresh anchor, the first row of this response. Pass back as `ending_before` to fetch what precedes it in the current sort order. On a newest-first sort those are the items that have appeared since; on any other sort they are the items that sort earlier, so refreshing such a list means re-fetching it instead. Non-`null` whenever `data` is non-empty; `null` only on an empty page. Distinct from `prev_cursor`.

AdminCrmFieldValueInput.description: One typed scalar or reference. The attribute definition determines its format.

value.description: Scalar value, ISO date/timestamp, or external identifier.

target_object.description: Target object identifier for a record reference. Must match an entry in the attribute’s allowed_object_ids; the entry may be an object UUID or collection slug.

first_name.description: Explicit personal-name component; empty for other field types.

last_name.description: Explicit personal-name component; empty for other field types.

AdminCrmRecordFieldInput.description: Replace the values of one editable field. Empty values clear an optional field.

slug.description: Current attribute API slug.

AdminCrmRecordWrite.description: Write only the specified fields. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Required fields must be supplied when creating a record.

AdminCrmNote.description: Plain text note recorded on a CRM record. The id is an nte_ note TypeID.

revision.description: Committed Bird revision. Absent on records imported without a native mutation.

title.description: Note title, or null when the note has no title.

content.description: Plain text note content, or null when empty.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Pass back as `starting_after` to advance forward. `null` when no next page exists.

prev_cursor.description: Cursor for the previous page. Pass back as `ending_before` to step backward. `null` when no previous page exists.

refresh_cursor.description: Refresh anchor, the first row of this response. Pass back as `ending_before` to fetch what precedes it in the current sort order. On a newest-first sort those are the items that have appeared since; on any other sort they are the items that sort earlier, so refreshing such a list means re-fetching it instead. Non-`null` whenever `data` is non-empty; `null` only on an empty page. Distinct from `prev_cursor`.

AdminCrmNoteCreate.description: Add a plain text note to an Attio record.

AdminCrmRecordUpdate.description: Update the specified CRM fields. Optional preconditions are checked atomically and return 409 when stale.

require_native.description: Retained guarded-edit intent. Return 422 if the native writer is not configured; storage or staff-directory outages return 503. Preserve the value on exact retries because it participates in the operation fingerprint. Omitted or false does not bypass Opportunity owner-change guards. Native Opportunity owner changes require expected_revision and exactly one owner field, with zero values to unassign or one value to assign; other fields may be updated atomically in the same request. expected_owner is an optional additional precondition. The actor and any selected recipient must be active staff with admin:crm write and admin:crm_handovers write. Email verification is required for the recipient, including self-assignment, but not the acting admin. Owner selection uses the existing user/member binding rules. Committed receipts replay before changed recipient eligibility.

expected_owner.description: Owner ID observed before a record reassignment, or null for unassigned. A changed native owner returns a conflict.

expected_revision.description: Revision read before editing. Use zero for an imported record without a revision. A newer native record returns a conflict; refresh before retrying.

AdminCrmRecordTitle.description: Display name for an Attio record reference. The id is the record TypeID matching object.

title.description: Display name, or null when the record name could not be resolved.

AdminCrmRecordTitleList.description: Names for a bounded set of distinct Attio record references.

period_start.description: First expected-close date in the period, inclusive.

period_end.description: First expected-close date outside the period, exclusive. Must follow period_start; both dates must exist in the selected business timezone, as for Sales targets.

timezone.description: Explicit IANA business timezone, or UTC. Recorded expected-close dates are dates, not converted instants.

scope_name.description: Nonblank team name, trimmed for context identity, or empty for a seller. Renaming a team creates a different context and does not rewrite earlier submissions.

member_ids.description: Exact stable CRM owner-member roster. Seller scope requires one member. Each item is a member TypeID or, until the CRM typed-ID transition closes, a bare UUID; a TypeID and the bare UUID of the same member are one member. Order is canonicalized; duplicates and unmapped recipients are refused on submission. Responses return TypeIDs.

AdminCrmSalesForecastState.description:
One state per opportunity. Exclusions are checked from `unknown_stage` through `other_currency` in the order below; the first matching exclusion wins.

- `eligible` means the opportunity is open, closes within the selected period, and has an amount in the selected currency.
- `unknown_stage` means the current opportunity stage cannot be confirmed against the configured stage-outcome mapping.
- `closed` means the current stage maps to won or lost.
- `missing_close_date` means an open opportunity has no expected close date.
- `outside_period` means the expected close date is before the selected start date or on or after the end date.
- `missing_value` means the opportunity has no amount or no currency.
- `other_currency` means the source currency does not exactly match the selected currency; no conversion is applied.

amount.description: Exact submitted judgment of future recorded CRM opportunity value in the context currency. Not an actual economic outcome.

actor_id.description: Auth user UUID of the authenticated publisher. This is not a CRM member identifier.

AdminCrmSalesForecast.description: Current pipeline compared with retained manual judgments. Judgments retain server submission times and may be submitted after the period ends. They contain no historical pipeline snapshot; current pipeline fields are not the amounts observed at submission.

can_submit.description: Whether current CRM-write authority and self binding or manager roster admission permit this actor to submit for this context. Absent when eligibility could not be confirmed. It is a current hint; submission rechecks authority and requires CRM write permission.

basis.description: Compare targets only when the declared metric, dates, timezone, currency and exact member scope match. This is not bookings or revenue.

observed_at.description: Time this current read began, not a historical snapshot or proof of source completeness.

current_amount.description: Exact sum of currently eligible recorded opportunity values in the selected currency. It is separate from submitted judgments.

quarantined_count.description: All current opportunity projection failures in the namespace. Their owner may be unavailable, so they cannot be assigned to this roster or counted as zero.

counts.description: Mutually exclusive current-record states across the selected owner roster. Classification order is unknown stage, closed, missing close date, outside period, missing value, other currency, eligible. Counts are not historical facts.

expected_revision.description: Latest submission revision observed for this exact context. Zero creates the first submission.

AdminCrmSalesForecastSelection.description: Select one comparison state or all owned opportunities.

AdminCrmOpportunityIdentifier.description: CRM opportunity TypeID. Responses return the TypeID. A bare UUID is still accepted as input until the CRM typed-ID transition closes.

amount.description: Exact recorded decimal text from the owning CRM opportunity, without truncation or conversion; null when no amount is recorded.

currency_code.description: Exact nonempty currency text retained by the opportunity owner, or null when absent. Unsupported or mismatched values remain visible as forecast exclusions.

AdminCrmSalesTargetScope.description: A single CRM member or an explicitly published target roster, separate from organization team membership.

AdminCrmSalesTargetUnit.description: Count of explicitly defined outcomes, or an economic amount in one native currency.

metric_key.description: Sales or Finance-published measure identifier. It does not connect an outcome source or define revenue recognition by itself.

currency_code.description: Three uppercase currency letters for a currency target; empty for counts. No conversion is performed.

period_start.description: Inclusive local date at midnight in the declared timezone; the year must be at least 0001.

period_end.description: Exclusive local date at midnight in the declared timezone; the year must be at least 0001 and the date must follow period_start.

timezone.description: IANA timezone defining the target period. Server-local timezone aliases are refused.

scope_name.description: Published team label for a team target; empty for a seller target. Team membership is the publication roster.

seller_member_id.description: Exact CRM member for a seller target, null for a team. Accepts a member TypeID or, until the CRM typed-ID transition closes, a bare UUID; responses return the TypeID. Names and email addresses are not copied.

AdminCrmSalesTargetQuantity.description: Exact non-negative target quantity in its declared unit. Null or zero means no effective target; preserve the supplied decimal digits. Count targets require a whole quantity; fractional counts are refused on new publication. Accepted operation receipts remain replayable.

AdminCrmSalesCreditSource.description: Explicitly published credit measure. Commitment values are the exact monthly or annual minimum stated on the signed quote, not revenue, cash collected, or a total contract value.

AdminCrmSalesTargetPublication.description: Published target value, roster and credit policy. Optional credit_source is unconfigured when omitted; when supplied it requires a nonblank credit_basis_reference. agreement_signed_count and agreement_adopted_count require a count target; signed_monthly_commit and signed_annual_commit require a currency target. Once a nonempty credit_source is published, it cannot change on this target.

member_ids.description: Explicit roster for this version, stored in canonical member-ID order without mutating the submitted receipt intent. Each item is a member TypeID or, until the CRM typed-ID transition closes, a bare UUID. Member identities must be distinct after decoding; duplicate identities, including a TypeID and the bare UUID of the same member or different hexadecimal letter cases of one UUID, return 422. Responses return TypeIDs. A seller target contains only its seller. This roster alone is not outcome-time credit allocation.

credit_basis_reference.description: Exact published Sales or Finance credit-policy reference, or empty when none exists. Descriptive provenance only; it does not activate a credited outcome source.

active.description: Whether this target is currently in use. Archiving appends a version and preserves earlier publications.

change_reason.description: Business reason for this publication or correction. Do not include customer content or staff personal details.

effective_at.description: UTC publication time. Corrections become effective when published; earlier versions are not rewritten or backdated.

AdminCrmSalesTargetAttainmentState.description: Whether credited attainment is available, or why it cannot be calculated. The available state is reserved for a connected credited-outcome source; credit_details_required reserves permission-checked source validation in the credit detail. No credited outcomes are inferred from pipeline, signatures or current ownership.

credited_actual.description: Unavailable until the declared measure has an authoritative credited outcome source. Never pipeline value or unallocated signing value.

remaining_target.description: Unavailable while credited actual or a nonzero target is unavailable.

ratio.description: Unavailable while either operand is unavailable or the target is zero; never zero or infinity as a substitute.

credited_outcomes.description: Unavailable while credited source coverage cannot be established; not an empty-population count.

AdminCrmSalesTargetCreate.description: A new count publication requires a whole target quantity; zero-only decimal places such as 10.0 are allowed. Currency publications preserve exact supplied decimal digits without imposing a currency minor-unit scale. An authorized retry of an already accepted publication returns its original result without applying it again. Fresh-publication quantity rules do not invalidate that recovery, so this shared decimal-string shape also represents earlier accepted quantities. New fractional count publications are rejected with 422 after accepted-intent recovery has been checked.

expected_revision.description: Latest published revision observed before this edit. A concurrent publication conflicts.

adopted_version_id.description: Adopted contract version for agreement_adopted_count; null for signing-count and signed-commitment sources.

occurred_at.description: Recorded signing time, or recorded adoption time for adoption count. This determines period inclusion.

recorded_at.description: When the selected signing or contract-adoption event was recorded. This does not prove Billing first applied a contract.

quantity.description: Exact count or stated commitment in the source currency. No FX or annualization.

currency_code.description: Source currency for commitments; empty for counts.

revision.description: Exact retained source revision inspected for this credit.

AdminCrmSalesCreditState.description:
Derived availability of the retained published-credit calculation. This never
certifies complete commercial activity coverage.

- `available`: A credit basis and a positive target value are published, and
  every nonreversed credit matches its current retained source proof. `credited_actual`,
  `remaining_target` and `ratio` are available for this published-credit population.
- `target_not_set`: Source proofs are available, but the target value is absent
  or zero. `credited_actual` and member totals remain available;
  `remaining_target` and `ratio` are null. Publish a positive target value to enable comparison with the target.
- `credit_basis_not_published`: The target has no published credit source.
  `credited_actual`, `remaining_target` and `ratio` are null. Publish the target's credit source and
  attribution basis before recording outcome allocations.
- `evidence_unavailable`: At least one nonreversed credit has no current
  retained source proof or its proof revision no longer matches.
  `credited_actual`, `remaining_target` and `ratio` are null rather than partial totals. Re-inspect the
  source and publish a correction against its current evidence, or reverse
  the credit when no valid evidence remains; reversal requires no source proof.

credited_actual.description: Exact total of this member’s published outcome allocations.

AdminCrmSalesCreditSummary.description: Counts cover the latest publication of every retained credit outcome for this target, independently of the data page. When state is credit_basis_not_published, all three outcome counters are zero.

credited_actual.description: Exact current published credit; null when no credit source is published or any nonreversed source cannot be validated.

remaining_target.description: Exact max(target minus published credit, zero); null when no credit source is published, the target is unset or zero, or any nonreversed source cannot be validated.

ratio.description: Published credit divided by target, rounded to 18 decimal places. Null when no credit source is published, the target is unset or zero, or retained source proof is incomplete.

published_outcomes.description: Number of current nonreversed credit outcomes, including those whose source evidence is unavailable. Corrections replace the current publication in this count; prior revisions are not counted separately.

reversed_outcomes.description: Number of credit outcomes whose current publication is reversed. These are excluded from published_outcomes and unavailable_outcomes, regardless of retained source evidence.

unavailable_outcomes.description: Subset of published_outcomes whose current source proof is missing or no longer matches the retained evidence revision. Any positive count withholds credited_actual, remaining_target, ratio and member totals; do not add this count to published_outcomes.

source_population_complete.description: Always false: this is the published credit population, not proof that every commercial outcome was allocated.

members.description: Exact per-member totals for the published credit population. When state is evidence_unavailable because any nonreversed source proof no longer matches, all member totals are withheld and this array is empty, even if retained credit publications exist. The overall credited_actual, remaining_target and ratio are null in that state; an empty members array does not establish that no member received credit.

member_id.description: Exact member of the referenced target publication roster. Each member may appear only once in the allocation list; repeated IDs are refused even when their shares differ.

share.description: Explicit share attributed to this outcome, greater than zero and at most one. All member shares for the target outcome sum to at most one.

evidence.description: Copied source proof when evidence_retained is true. Null when the exact source revision no longer validates against its owner, including changed or missing source evidence; null means unavailable proof, not a zero outcome.

allocations.description: Published member shares when evidence_retained is true. Empty when source evidence is withheld, including for an unreversed credit; an empty withheld list does not mean a genuine zero allocation.

reason.description: Retained business explanation, including when source proof is unavailable. Target or organization erasure deletes the entire credit revision.

published_at.description: When this allocation revision was published; does not change the outcome time.

evidence_retained.description: Whether the exact copied source revision still validates against its owner.

AdminCrmSalesCreditPage.description: The summary is the authoritative aggregate for these credit publications. The nested target provides its definition and selected publication; target.attainment is a placeholder for the target-only read and must not be used as a competing credit total.

publication_enabled.description: Configured credit-publication feature flag, not confirmation that this target or caller may write. New allocations and corrections additionally require an active target with a published credit_source, matching source evidence and current revisions, and write permission. Disabling the flag does not itself disable reads, reversals, accepted-intent replay or erasure; their own preconditions still apply.

expected_target_revision.description: Latest target publication revision from the target read. A new publication returns 409 if the target has changed. An exact accepted-intent replay recovers its original receipt without publishing again.

expected_credit_revision.description: Zero for the first publication; otherwise the latest credit revision. A new intent with a stale nonzero revision returns 409; refresh the credit before deciding a new correction. An exact accepted-intent replay recovers its original receipt.

credit_id.description: Existing opaque credit ID. Required for reversal; no retained source reference is required to reverse a credit.

reference.description: Exact inspected source. Required when publishing or correcting an allocation; omitted for reversal.

expected_evidence_revision.description: Revision from inspected evidence when publishing or correcting. A new intent returns 409 if the source no longer matches this revision; re-inspect the source before deciding a new allocation or correction. Must be empty for reversal. An exact accepted-intent replay recovers its original receipt.

reversed.description: A reversal appends history, removes its current contribution, and requires an empty allocation list.

reason.description: Business justification for this exact outcome allocation or correction, limited to 500 Unicode characters. Must contain a non-whitespace character. Do not include customer content or staff personal details.

publication_enabled.description: Configured credit-publication feature flag, not confirmation that this target or caller may write. New allocations and corrections additionally require an active target with a published credit_source, matching source evidence and current revisions, and write permission. Disabling the flag does not itself disable reads, reversals, accepted-intent replay or erasure; their own preconditions still apply.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount in the recorded currency.

id.description: Stored stage identifier, or an empty string for records without a stage.

known.description: The record stage exists in the synced stage catalog. No open or closed outcome is inferred from its label.

attention.description: Distinct records with at least one ownership, next-step or overdue-close issue.

overdue.description: Opportunities with an expected close date before today in UTC.

oldest_created_at.description: Earliest source creation date, not stage entry or local import time.

complete.description: Compatibility for Admin versions deployed before native-only CRM. Equals configured; new clients must use configured.

metadata_at.description: Oldest update of the lead and opportunity stage catalogs, or null when either is missing. Catalog age does not measure record freshness.

pipeline_values.description: Recorded opportunity amounts across all stages, separated by currency. Includes closed stages.

oldest.description: Six oldest records with a known source creation date.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryObject.description: CRM sales record collection. Deals are CRM opportunities, not commercial Deal Desk records.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryMissingState.description: Unassigned means an observed empty identity. Unknown means the retained value could not be interpreted unambiguously.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryGroupBy.description: Dimension used to compare observed seller history.

configured.description: Whether a CRM namespace is configured. False returns an empty result.

from.description: Inclusive reporting interval start.

to.description: Exclusive reporting interval end.

partial_history.description: Retained observed events, without a historical backfill or certified uninterrupted writer coverage. Detectable discontinuities and unordered timestamps are reported separately; undetectable missing events remain possible. Erasure removes affected records and their history.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryIdentityId.description: Member TypeID for a crm_member identity, or the catalog UUID of a lead-status or opportunity-stage choice.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryIdentityKind.description: Bird CRM member, lead-status choice or opportunity-stage choice. Empty for unassigned or unknown identities. Imported representation kinds do not change the identity or create a new stage.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryIdentity.description: Bird CRM identity. The id is the canonical CRM member TypeID or choice UUID, preserved for imported and native records; it is not an Auth user TypeID or proof of current staff authority. Resolve display names from the current member or stage catalog by exact ID. Missing labels do not discard history.

id.description: Member TypeID for a crm_member identity, stage-choice UUID for a lead_status or opportunity_stage identity, or null for an unassigned or unknown value.

known.description: Whether one unambiguous identity or an explicit empty value was observed. Known with a null ID means unassigned.

observed_transfers.description: Known old-to-new owner changes in the period, attributed to the resulting owner and stage. Includes clearing an owner, excludes creation and unknown owner changes.

stage_entries.description: Observed entries into a known nonempty stage in the period, including creation. Attributed to the owner at entry.

completed_episodes.description: Stage episodes whose observed exit falls within the period, including those excluded from duration measurement.

measured_completed_episodes.description: Completed episodes with an observed entry, a known nonempty stage, continuous observed stage state and ordered timestamps. This is the denominator for duration percentiles.

open_episodes.description: Last observed stage episodes still open at the exclusive period end. Includes entries before the period start; these are censored dwell, not completed durations.

unknown_start_episodes.description: Retained episodes whose entry is unobserved, including stages first seen after a discontinuity. Their age is unknown and excluded from duration measurement.

unknown_stage_episodes.description: Retained episodes with an unassigned or uninterpretable stage. Excluded from duration measurement; can overlap unknown-start episodes.

median_completed_seconds.description: Median elapsed seconds among measured completed episodes, or null when none qualify. It is not seller working time or time owned by one person.

p95_completed_seconds.description: 95th percentile elapsed seconds among measured completed episodes, or null when none qualify. It is not seller working time or time owned by one person.

exited_stage_entries.description: Known stage entries inside this period with an observed exit before the exclusive horizon. Entry owner/stage attribution matches stage_entries; includes exits to unknown destinations.

unknown_exit_stage_entries.description: Subset of exited_stage_entries whose destination was not interpretable. Subtract from exited_stage_entries for known-destination exits; never treat them as won or lost.

open_stage_entries.description: Known stage entries inside this period whose last retained episode is open at the horizon. Includes discontinuous or unordered open episodes whose duration is unavailable. measured_open_episodes is the open-age percentile denominator. Closed episodes with an unobserved exit are excluded from both open and exited entry counts; missing transitions are not observed conversions.

measured_open_episodes.description: Open episodes with known observed entry, a known nonempty stage, continuous stage state and ordered timestamps. Includes older entries; denominator for open-age percentiles.

median_open_seconds.description: Median elapsed seconds of measured open episodes at the exclusive horizon. Censored stage age, not completed velocity or seller working time.

p95_open_seconds.description: 95th percentile elapsed seconds of measured open episodes at the exclusive horizon. Censored stage age, not completed velocity or seller working time.

discontinuous_episodes.description: Retained episodes with a detectable break between one captured new stage and the next captured old stage. Duration is unavailable. May overlap unknown-start, unknown-stage and unordered exclusions; the counts are not a partition.

unordered_episodes.description: Retained episodes touching timestamps that run backwards in authoritative record-revision order. Duration is unavailable. May overlap the other exclusion counts.

retained_records_without_history.description: Currently retained records in the selected object with no history before the requested period end. This count ignores owner and stage filters because their historical values are unknown; it is not a completeness certificate. A retained owner or stage event does not certify historical capture of amount, expected close date or forecast category.

summary.description: Metrics over all matching retained facts before pagination. Owner filtering applies to the owner at entry, transfer result, or episode exit according to each metric.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryEpisode.description: A retained stage episode. The owner is observed immediately before the exit, or is the last observed owner for an open episode. With entry_cohort_only=true, owner is the owner at the observed entry instead. Neither mode attributes the entire duration to this seller. The exit_stage is the destination retained at an observed exit. A completed episode can have exit_stage.known=false when its destination is unknown; an open episode or unobserved exit also has no known destination. Current stage configuration is never applied retrospectively.

entered_at.description: Observed stage entry, or null when the record was already in this stage when capture first observed it.

exited_at.description: Observed stage exit, or null while still open or when a discontinuity makes the exit time unknown.

observed_at.description: Observed exit or discontinuity-discovery time for a closed episode; the requested exclusive period end for an open episode.

duration_seconds.description: Elapsed seconds from a known entry to exit or the requested period end. Null when the entry or stage is unknown, the stage is unassigned, continuity is broken or timestamps are unordered. Open values are censored dwell and excluded from completed-duration percentiles.

open.description: This is the last observed stage at the requested period end. A closed episode can have an unknown exit after a detectable discontinuity.

discontinuous.description: Captured stage states do not connect across this episode. Its duration is excluded, and its entry or exit may be unknown.

unordered.description: Observed timestamps run backwards in record-revision order within or at the boundary of this episode. Its duration is excluded; revisions remain authoritative.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryChangeKind.description: Filter observed changes. Slipped and pulled require two known dates. Value includes amount, currency or knowledge-state changes; owner includes knowledge-state changes on non-creation observations only. Stage and category include knowledge-state changes.

observations.description: Number of matching retained record revisions across all pages, including creations. Each revision counts once even when it changes multiple fields. Separate revisions of the same opportunity count separately; this is neither a distinct-opportunity count nor a count of individual field changes.

measured_amount_pairs.description: Both amounts were captured unambiguously. An owner filter requires both owner identities known; a stage filter requires both stage identities known. Selecting unknown owner or stage admits no measured pair. Without those filters, unknown identities do not exclude a measured amount pair. Known empty amounts are measurable zero.

unknown_amount_pairs.description: Observations excluded from value flows because either amount is unknown or uncaptured, or because an active owner or stage filter requires attribution that is unknown. Without those identity filters, unknown owners and stages alone do not exclude an amount pair.

owner_transfers.description: Matching non-creation observations where both owner identities are known and the previous and new normalized owner identities differ. Assignment from or clearing to a known unassigned owner counts. Creations and changes involving an unknown owner do not count.

currency_changes.description: Matching observations where both amounts are known and both currency codes are present and different. Unknown or uncaptured amounts and known empty denominations do not count. There is no separate creation exclusion; both captured denominations are required.

slipped_changes.description: Matching observations where both expected-close dates are captured, known and present, and the new date is later than the previous date. Initial date assignment, clearing, unknown dates and unchanged dates do not count. Repeated slips of one opportunity count separately.

pulled_changes.description: Matching observations where both expected-close dates are captured, known and present, and the new date is earlier than the previous date. Initial date assignment, clearing, unknown dates and unchanged dates do not count. Repeated pulls of one opportunity count separately.

slipped_days.description: Sum of positive calendar-date changes; repeated slips of a record count separately. This is not elapsed stage time.

unknown_close_pairs.description: Observations where either the previous or new expected-close date was uncaptured or unknown. A captured date that was explicitly cleared is known and does not count as unknown.

value_added.description: Exact selected-currency value flow across the filtered observations. Null without a currency selection. Known empty values contribute zero. Unknown amount pairs are excluded; unknown owner or stage attribution excludes a pair only when that identity filter is active. Without identity filters, otherwise measured movements remain included. This is recorded book movement, not revenue or current pipeline.

value_removed.description: Exact selected-currency value flow across the filtered observations. Null without a currency selection. Known empty values contribute zero. Unknown amount pairs are excluded; unknown owner or stage attribution excludes a pair only when that identity filter is active. Without identity filters, otherwise measured movements remain included. This is recorded book movement, not revenue or current pipeline.

net_value_change.description: Exact selected-currency value flow across the filtered observations. Null without a currency selection. Known empty values contribute zero. Unknown amount pairs are excluded; unknown owner or stage attribution excludes a pair only when that identity filter is active. Without identity filters, otherwise measured movements remain included. This is recorded book movement, not revenue or current pipeline.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryChangeSummary.description: All matching retained observations across every page. Movement counters can overlap and are not a partition of observations. Value flows include creation, clearing, owner transfers and denomination changes in the selected currency, without FX.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryAmount.description: Captured money using the shared amount and currency_code vocabulary. Fields stay nullable, and legacy denomination text stays exact rather than being recast as validated money.

captured.description: False when the event predates financial capture or an older writer omitted capture after installation.

known.description: Whether the value could be read unambiguously. A known null is an explicitly empty value.

amount.description: Exact decimal in currency units, without rounding or conversion.

currency_code.description: Exact captured denomination. Noncanonical legacy values are preserved rather than converted or relabeled.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryValueKind.description: Captured category representation. Null for an expected-close date or when no category representation was retained, including a cleared or unknown category. An explicitly empty retained text category still has kind=text.

value.description: An ISO calendar date for expected_close, or the raw recorded forecast category value. Null when no value was captured, the value is unknown, or the field was cleared. A retained text category can instead be the explicit empty string with known=true; use captured, known and kind to distinguish these states.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryCapturedValue.description: A forward-captured value. Uncaptured history and ambiguous values are not inferred from current metadata.

amount_delta.description: Exact after minus before amount only when both are present, known and in the same currency. Null does not mean zero.

close_delta_days.description: After minus before expected-close calendar dates. Positive means slipped; negative means pulled forward. Null if either date is absent or unknown.

currency_code.description: Selected denomination for exact value-flow totals. Null leaves all value totals unavailable.

AdminCrmLossReasonCatalogCreate.description: Explicit creation and binding of a new optional loss-reason field. Reason titles must be nonempty, trimmed and distinct without regard to case. Existing fields cannot be replaced.

expected_revision.description: Exact displayed binding version.

field_slug.description: Unique field name for the new loss-reason catalog.

reasons.description: Explicit initial reason titles. Stable choice identities are assigned when accepted.

AdminCrmRetiredAuthority.description: Compatibility value for predecessor Admin clients during deployment. No runtime authority selection remains.

AdminCrmLossReasonBindingState.description: Whether an explicit current opportunity reason field is usable. Unavailable preserves the saved binding when its field or choices no longer match.

slug.description: Exact opportunity field slug.

title.description: Current field label.

AdminCrmOpportunityLossReasons.description: Explicit loss-reason binding and the current choices. No field or reason meaning is inferred from labels. Reasons are optional.

revision.description: Saved binding revision, or zero before configuration.

catalog_revision.description: Opaque version of the displayed fields and bound choices.

field_slug.description: Explicitly bound field, or null when unconfigured. An unavailable binding is retained for inspection.

managed_field_slug.description: Loss-reason field created through Sales settings, or null when none was published. Its choices can be edited only while it is the available bound field.

updated_at.description: Latest saved binding time, or null before configuration.

fields.description: Existing writable, optional, singular-select opportunity fields eligible for explicit binding.

reasons.description: Current choices of the bound field. Missing or removed historical choices are not assigned a replacement meaning.

AdminCrmLossReasonCatalogChoiceWrite.description: A retained choice to rename or an explicit new choice. Omit id only to add a new reason.

title.description: Trimmed, nonempty title distinct from the other published reason titles without regard to case.

AdminCrmLossReasonCatalogUpdate.description: Complete active choice list for the available bound field created through Sales settings. Existing choices keep their identity when renamed. Omitted choices stop being selectable; recorded values are not changed.

expected_revision.description: Exact displayed binding version.

reasons.description: Complete active reason list. An empty list explicitly removes all selectable reasons while preserving recorded values.

expected_revision.description: Binding revision used to prepare this change.

field_slug.description: Exact eligible field slug. An empty value explicitly removes the binding without clearing record values or history.

AdminCrmOpportunityLossWrite.description: Saves one configured lost stage and an explicitly selected or omitted reason together. Omitting reason_id records no reason; it never carries an earlier episode's reason forward.

expected_revision.description: Opportunity revision inspected before this command. Use zero when the retained imported opportunity has no native revision; the first successful write advances it to one.

stage_id.description: Choose an ID from the current opportunity stage choices mapped to lost. An ID outside those lost-stage choices returns 422; stale stage or reason configuration/catalog revisions return 409 before stage eligibility is checked.

reason_id.description: Choose an ID from the current displayed choices of the bound loss-reason field. An ID outside those choices returns 422; refresh the reason catalog before choosing again.

AdminCrmOpportunityStageType.description: The declared kind of the opportunity stage field.

title.description: Current stage label. It does not determine its outcome.

AdminCrmOpportunityStageOutcomes.description: Current opportunity-stage meaning. Unmapped stages remain unknown. This configuration does not change stage definitions, lead lifecycle, historical raw facts, forecast probabilities or commercial receipts.

revision.description: Current configuration revision; zero means none has been saved.

catalog_revision.description: Opaque version of the currently displayed stage catalog.

updated_at.description: Last saved configuration time, or null before the first save.

expected_revision.description: Configuration revision displayed when this intent was prepared.

expected_catalog_revision.description: Catalog version displayed when this intent was prepared.

stages.description: Exactly one entry for every currently displayed stage. Unknown explicitly removes its mapping. Duplicates and choices outside that catalog are refused.

AdminCrmConnectionState.description: available means Attio responded; unconfigured means no server credential; unavailable means Attio could not be reached or authorized.

AdminCrmStatus.description: Connection and standard company schema available to the staff CRM workbench.

signup_task_sources_available.description: Whether this API accepts new signup-sourced tasks under native CRM authority. False or absent disables new source capture, not receipt recovery or existing task reads and edits.

is_demo.description: True only for the disposable local fixture, so the workbench can label sample data. Always false in production.

company_object_id.description: External Attio companies object identifier, when schema discovery succeeds.

company_fields.description: Supported standard fields confirmed by Attio schema discovery.

unmapped_fields.description: Commercial fields with no approved company mapping; they are not inferred from other attributes.

AdminCrmCompany.description: Projected standard Attio company fields. The id is a cpy_ company TypeID.

name.description: Company name recorded in Attio, or null when absent.

domains.description: Domains recorded on the company; these do not establish a Bird organization link.

description.description: Company description recorded in Attio, or null when absent.

created_at.description: Time Attio created the company record.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Pass back as `starting_after` to advance forward. `null` when no next page exists.

prev_cursor.description: Cursor for the previous page. Pass back as `ending_before` to step backward. `null` when no previous page exists.

refresh_cursor.description: Refresh anchor, the first row of this response. Pass back as `ending_before` to fetch what precedes it in the current sort order. On a newest-first sort those are the items that have appeared since; on any other sort they are the items that sort earlier, so refreshing such a list means re-fetching it instead. Non-`null` whenever `data` is non-empty; `null` only on an empty page. Distinct from `prev_cursor`.

AdminCrmCompanyIdentifier.description: CRM company TypeID. Responses return the TypeID. A bare UUID is still accepted as input until the CRM typed-ID transition closes.

AdminCrmOrganizationLink.description: A Bird organization identifier explicitly recorded in a related Attio Workspace record.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Pass back as `starting_after` to advance forward. `null` when no next page exists.

prev_cursor.description: Cursor for the previous page. Pass back as `ending_before` to step backward. `null` when no previous page exists.

refresh_cursor.description: Refresh anchor, the first row of this response. Pass back as `ending_before` to fetch what precedes it in the current sort order. On a newest-first sort those are the items that have appeared since; on any other sort they are the items that sort earlier, so refreshing such a list means re-fetching it instead. Non-`null` whenever `data` is non-empty; `null` only on an empty page. Distinct from `prev_cursor`.

AdminCrmTaskSourceKind.description: Owning source kind for immutable task provenance.

AdminCrmTaskIdentifier.description: CRM task TypeID. Responses return the TypeID. A bare UUID is still accepted as input until the CRM typed-ID transition closes.

AdminCrmTaskResponsibilityRole.description:
Selected member's current task responsibility:
- `assignee` means an ordinary assignee, or a non-accountable co-assignee on a handover task.
- `accountable` means the person currently responsible for the handover task.
- `coverage` means the fallback person for the handover task.
- `recipient` means the person currently asked to accept a pending handover.

AdminCrmTaskSourceReference.description: Immutable reference to the retained signup or inquiry that prompted a native CRM task. It grants no source access; source context is resolved under its owning permissions. Source erasure removes this provenance while preserving the independent task.

AdminCrmRecordReference.description: An explicit record relation. Responses name the object by its slug when the object catalog knows it, otherwise by the stored object UUID, and give the record as its TypeID for companies, people, leads and deals, otherwise as its source UUID. Requests also accept an object UUID and a bare record UUID until the CRM typed-ID transition closes.

object_id.description: Object slug, or the stored object UUID when the object catalog does not know the object. An object UUID is also accepted in requests.

AdminCrmTask.description: CRM task TypeID and its explicit assignees and record relations. handover_accountable_member_id is the accountable assignee, present only for an enrolled task; this assignee and a deadline must be retained, and completion is controlled by the handover owner.

responsibility_roles.description: Current roles for the responsible_member_id selection. Absent when that filter was not requested.

can_edit_content.description: True when the owning CRM currently supports replacing task text. Absence means unavailable. Other task fields remain subject to current handover constraints.

revision.description: Committed Bird revision. Absent on records imported without a native mutation.

content.description: Plain text task content, or null when empty.
