AdminSharedIPPoolSelection.description:
The shared SparkPost pool selection.

- `automatic`: Follow the organization's sender-legitimacy tier.
- `bird_trusted`: Force the trusted shared route.
- `bird_std_1`: Force the standard shared route.
- `bird_probation`: Force the probation shared route.
- `bird_restricted`: Force the restricted shared route.
- `sp_shared`: Force SparkPost's own shared pool.

`automatic` chooses one of the four named Bird routes from sender
legitimacy; a forced value chooses its route directly. SparkPost receives
a Bird route with the account region's `us_` or `eu_` prefix, and
`sp_shared` exactly as written in both regions.

reason.description: Why the shared pool selection is being changed. Recorded in the admin audit log.

quantity.description: Number of dedicated IPs to provision.

ip_pool_id.description: The IP pool to allocate the IPs into.

title.description: Case subject or title.

status.description:
Case status.

- `OPEN`: active.
- `SNOOZED`: paused.
- `DONE`: resolved.

updated_at.description: When the case was last updated.

customer_email.description: Email address of the customer who opened the case.

assignee_name.description: Display name of the assigned agent or bot. Null when unassigned.

data.description: Support cases attributed to the organization, ordered newest first.

truncated.description: Whether the attribution scan stopped at its 500-thread limit before filling this list. When true, older attributed cases may exist that are not listed; the support inbox filtered on the organization shows the full tenant.

open_count.description: Number of currently open support threads. For an organization, the open threads attributed to it among the newest 500 on its tenant; a lower bound when `open_count_truncated` is true.

open_count_truncated.description: Whether an organization's open count stopped at the 500-thread scan limit, so open attributed cases beyond it were not counted. Always false for workspace-wide metrics.

frt_median_sec.description: Median first-response time in seconds over the period. Null when no data.

resolution_median_sec.description: Median resolution time in seconds over the period. Null when no data.

csat_percent.description: CSAT score as a percentage (0–100) over the period. Null when no data.

sla_frt_compliance_percent.description: Percentage of threads where the first response met the configured SLA target over the period. Null when no SLA is configured or no data.

customer_waiting_median_sec.description: Median time in seconds that customers spent actively waiting for a reply over the period, excluding time the thread was snoozed. Null when no data.

period_days.description: Number of days the metrics cover.

AdminRoleSource.description: Authority that owns these role assignments.

full_name.description: The staff user's full name. `null` when unset.

roles_managed_by.description: Present when role assignments are managed through Okta groups.

AdminReviewSource.description: What flagged a user for manual trust and safety review. `sift`: a provider decision did. `admin`: a staff member did. Closed rather than extensible because the set is fixed until somebody adds a source deliberately, and a new one arrives with its own release note. Spelled `sift` rather than `automated` (as `AdminBanEvidenceActorKind` spells the same actor) because this value is stored verbatim and the wire must not rename it.

AdminPlatformUserOrg.description: One organization a platform user belongs to, with their role in it, for the users list.

role.description: The user's organization-level role, or null when they hold only workspace-level access.

has_password.description: True when the account has a password set; false for passwordless/social-only accounts.

password_changed_at.description: When the account password was last set. Null if no password change has been recorded.

mfa_factors.description: The user's enrolled multi-factor authentication methods.

recovery_codes_remaining.description: Unused MFA recovery codes remaining. Null when the user has no MFA factor enrolled.

external_identities.description: Social login providers (Google, GitHub) connected to the account.

banned_reason.description: Why the user is banned: `admin` (banned by an admin), `sift` (banned autonomously by the Sift trust & safety system), or `org_ban` (banned because their organization was banned). Null when the user is not banned.

last_ban_category.description: The category of the user's most recent suspension. Retained after reinstatement, so a non-null value does not mean the user is currently suspended.

last_ban_note.description: Staff note recorded with the user's most recent suspension. Retained after reinstatement, so a non-null value does not mean the user is currently suspended.

last_banned_at.description: When the user's most recent suspension was applied. Unlike banned_at, this is retained after reinstatement (not cleared), so a non-null value does not mean the user is currently suspended.

under_review_at.description: When the user was flagged for manual trust and safety review. A review is softer than a suspension: the account keeps working, and a human is expected to look at it. Null when no review is open.

review_source.description: What flagged the user for review. Null when no review is open.

deleted_at.description: When set, the user has been deleted and can no longer be reinstated.

account_abuse_score.description: Sift account_abuse risk score (0–1, higher is riskier). Null when Sift has no score for the user or the score could not be fetched.

payment_abuse_score.description: Sift payment_abuse risk score (0–1, higher is riskier). Null when Sift has no score for the user or the score could not be fetched.

device_otp_exempt_at.description: When staff exempted this account from the email code that password sign-in normally sends to an unrecognised device. Absent when the account is not exempt. Only accounts with no multi-factor authentication enrolled can be exempted, and enrolling a factor makes the exemption inert.

device_otp_exempt_by.description: The staff member who granted the exemption. Absent when the account is not exempt.

device_otp_exempt_by_email.description: Email address of the staff member who granted the exemption, resolved on the single-user read. Absent when the account is not exempt, when a response does not resolve it, or when the lookup failed.

device_otp_exempt_note.description: Why the exemption was granted. Absent when the account is not exempt.

organization_count.description: Total number of organizations the user belongs to.

organizations.description: The organizations the user belongs to, capped at a few entries; organization_count carries the true total.

data.description: The platform user's most recent sessions, capped at 20 entries, ordered by last_seen_at descending.

note.description: Optional free-text detail recorded alongside the category, for staff.
Why this account is exempt, naming the demo or review programme it was created for.
Free-text reason recorded in the audit log for verifying the address without the link or code.

AdminAuditLogFields.description: Admin-audit-only fields layered on top of the shared audit fields.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset token for this exact row, encoding (occurred_at, id). Pass a row's cursor as `starting_after` to page after it, or `ending_before` to page before it. The admin list is merged across regions in the BFF, so the page boundary cursor is taken from the first/last kept row's cursor.

sensitive.description: True when the action is in the curated high-risk set (org bans, billing adjustments, staff changes, quota/rate overrides). Drives the UI badge and the `sensitive` filter.

AdminAuditLogEntry.description: A single platform (admin) audit log entry as returned in list responses (without bodies).

AdminAuditLogEntryDetail.description: A single platform audit log entry with the captured request and response bodies.

AdminBillingAutoTopupSettings.description: The organization's stored automatic top-up configuration. Amounts use the wallet currency. Enabling the setting does not guarantee that a saved card can be charged.

enabled.description: Whether automatic top-up is enabled. Defaults to false when no settings have been configured.

threshold.description: Settled wallet balance below which automatic top-up is triggered, as a decimal string in currency units. Null when no threshold is configured. A disabled setting can retain its threshold.

amount.description: Amount to add on each automatic top-up, as a decimal string in currency units. Null when no amount is configured. A disabled setting can retain its amount.

consent_id.description: Configured saved payment method. Null selects the organization's default payment method.

currency_code.description: Currency in which the threshold and amount are expressed.
ISO 4217 currency code.

balance.description: Spendable snapshot as a decimal string in the wallet's currency, including confirmed unused reserved funds. The remaining balance fields explain this same snapshot. Concurrent activity and active holds can still delay funding a send or purchase.

settled_balance.description: Ledger balance as a decimal string: money that has settled into wallet transactions. This is what `balance_after` on the wallet's latest transaction ties to. It sits above `balance` while usage is in flight, because usage is charged against an open block and settles in batches.

reserved.description: Funds allocated to open usage blocks and active holds, as a decimal string. Includes both used and unused funds. Subtract this from `settled_balance`, then add `unused_reserved` to reconcile the spendable `balance`.

unused_reserved.description: Unused reserved funds included in the spendable balance, as a decimal string. Taken from the same snapshot as `balance` and capped at `reserved`. Zero when no unused funds can be confirmed, including when live accounting is unavailable; zero does not prove all reserved funds have been spent.

credit_limit.description: Credit limit as a decimal string. "0.00" for prepaid wallets.
New credit limit. Cannot be reduced below the current balance deficit.

credit_note_settlement.description: Whether this transaction settles a credit note or reverses its settlement.

organization_id.description: Organization that owns the wallet this transaction belongs to.

type.description: Transaction type. `top_up` (a manual or automatic top-up credit), `charge` (a usage or subscription debit), `refund` (a refunded payment; this debits the wallet when the refund claws back the credit the original top-up added), or `adjustment` (a manual correction, positive or negative).

amount.description: Gross amount as a decimal string. Positive for top_up, negative for charge, and negative for a refund that claws the credit back. Refunds and adjustments may be either sign (never zero).

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the wallet this transaction belongs to.

net_amount.description: Net amount as a decimal string (amount minus tax). Present for charge and adjustment transactions; null for top_up and refund.

tax_amount.description: Tax amount as a decimal string. Present for charge and adjustment transactions; null for top_up and refund.

balance_after.description: Wallet balance after this transaction as a decimal string.

description.description: Human-readable description of the transaction.
description.example: Manual top-up

billing_period.description: First day of the billing month this transaction belongs to.

actor_id.description: Staff user ID who performed the action. Null for automated transactions.

reverses_transaction_id.description: For a staff debit, the wallet credit it takes back; that credit then pays invoices with only what is left. Null otherwise.

reason.description: Audit reason for manual adjustments and refunds.

credit_reason.description: The recorded credit reason or staff adjustment class, independent of any optional reversal link: a staff adjustment class, `provisioning_failure`, `overage_true_up`, `credit_note` or `forfeiture_reversal`. Null when the row records none, including adjustments written before classes were required.

debit_reason.description: Set only on the system debit that forfeits a closed organization's unused credit.

urls.description: Contextual external links for this transaction. Top-up transactions linked to a payment intent include a "View on Airwallex" link; other transactions have none.

AdminBillingWalletAdjustmentClass.description: Staff-selected class of a wallet adjustment. On a credit, why Bird adds the money; `payment_received` is money the customer paid outside the payment provider. On a debit, the class recorded for the correction. The optional `reverses_transaction_id` identifies a specific credit separately.

amount.description: Adjustment amount (must be positive).

reason.description: Audit reason for the adjustment (stored in transaction history).

reverses_transaction_id.description: For a debit only, the wallet credit it takes back. That credit then pays invoices with only what is left, and invoices it paid reopen by the difference. The debit may not exceed what the credit has left to reverse.

class.description: Staff-selected class of this adjustment. For a debit, this class does not link or validate a specific credit. The optional reverses_transaction_id links the credit and reduces what it can pay toward invoices.

AdminBillingPaymentCreditType.description:
Wallet transaction type of a payment credit.

- `top_up`: money received.
- `adjustment`: a credit without a billing period.

AdminBillingPaymentCreditOrigin.description:
Where a payment credit came from.

- `payment`: a payment collected through the payment provider.
- `bank_receipt`: a bank transfer recorded by staff.
- `credit`: a goodwill, promotion or other credit that moved no money.

AdminBillingPaymentCredit.description: A wallet credit that can pay invoices, with how much of it is already allocated.

payment_intent_id.description: The payment intent that collected the money. Null unless the origin is payment.

description.description: Human-readable description of the credit.

amount.description: Credit amount as a decimal string.

capacity.description: The part of the credit that can pay invoices, as a decimal string. Equal to the amount.

allocated.description: The part of the capacity that already pays invoices, as a decimal string.

unallocated.description: The part of the capacity that pays no invoice yet, as a decimal string.

pays_invoice_id.description: The invoice the credit was sent to pay. Null when it named none.

AdminBillingCreditNoteUnitPrice.description: Positive net unit price in major currency units, at least one microunit (0.000001), with at most six decimal places. The currency must match the organization's wallet currency.

AdminBillingCreditNoteLine.description:
One line to credit. Which variant applies depends on whether the request names a source invoice, which this schema cannot see, so the service still checks the line against the request.
A line crediting an invoice line carries only source_line_item_id and quantity. The product, description, unit price, and period are copied from the invoice line itself, and supplying them is refused, since a credit note must not assert something the invoice never charged.
A standalone line carries product_id, description, quantity, and unit_price, and must not carry source_line_item_id.

source_line_item_id.description: Invoice line item this credits. Set only when crediting a specific line on a source invoice.

product_id.description: Product this line credits. Required, and only valid, on a standalone line with no source invoice.

description.description: What this line credits. Required, and only valid, on a standalone line with no source invoice.

unit_price.description: Net unit price. Required, and only valid, on a standalone line with no source invoice.

period_start.description: First day of the credited service period, UTC. Only valid on a standalone line.

period_end.description: Exclusive end of the credited service period, UTC; the credited last day is the day before. Only valid on a standalone line.

AdminBillingCreditNoteCreate.description: A credit note to request, against a source invoice or standalone. Shared by the request and preview operations, so a preview and the request right after it compute the same document.

source_invoice_id.description: Invoice this note credits. Omit for a standalone note.

reason.description: Why the credit note is requested. Printed on the note and shown to the approver.

credit_wallet.description: When true, approval issues the note and schedules a credit of its gross total to the organization's wallet. Check the request's wallet_effect for the settlement outcome; the credit can fail if the wallet currency changes.

po_number.description: Purchase order number to print on the credit note.

AdminBillingCreditNoteRequestKind.description: Whether the request issues a credit note or voids an issued one.

AdminBillingCreditNoteRequestStatus.description: Execution status of a credit note request. The decision itself lives on the approval request.

AdminBillingCreditNoteComputedLine.description: A computed credit note line in a preview or request, before an issued document exists.

workspace_id.description: The workspace this line concerns. Absent for an org-level charge, such as the plan's recurring fee.

product_id.description: The product this line concerns, or absent when the line is not tied to one.

period_start.description: First day of the line's service period (UTC). Absent for lines with no period (for example, adjustments).

period_end.description: Exclusive end of the line's service period: the next period's first day (UTC); the billed last day is the day before. Absent for lines with no period.

quantity.description: Quantity credited by this line. Absent when crediting a whole line without a quantity.

unit_name.description: Unit the credited quantity is counted in (for example, `message`, `minute`). Absent when the line has no unit.

net_amount.description: This line's amount before tax, as a decimal string in `currency_code` units.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate applied to this line, as a decimal fraction (for example, `0.21` for 21%). Null when the tax rate is unknown; a known zero rate is "0".

tax_amount.description: Tax charged on this line, as a decimal string in `currency_code` units.

gross_amount.description: This line's total (`net_amount` plus `tax_amount`), as a decimal string in `currency_code` units.

sort_order.description: Position of this line among the computed lines, for display order.

AdminBillingCreditNoteWalletEffect.description: What a credit note request does to the wallet. `none` when it moves no money. On a request still awaiting approval it means no effect has been scheduled yet, and a credit may follow on approval if `credit_wallet` is true. `pending` until the issue credit or the void's reversal posts, `settled` once it has, and `failed` when the wallet's currency changed after the request, which is never retried.

AdminBillingCreditNoteRequest.description: A credit note issue or void put up for finance approval. Decide it through the billing approval request named by approval_request_id.

source_invoice_id.description: Invoice an issue request credits. Null on a standalone note and on a void.

credit_note_id.description: The note a void targets, or the note an approved issue created.

total_gross.description: Decimal amount in major units of currency_code; for a void, the note's total.

line_items.description: The lines an approved issue writes. Empty for a void.

wallet_effect_failure.description: Why the wallet effect failed, or null when it has not.

BillingInvoiceStatus.description:
Payment status of the invoice.

- `open`: issued and awaiting full payment.
- `paid`: fully settled.
- `partial`: partially paid; a balance remains.
- `void`: cancelled before or after issue.

AdminBillingCreditNoteSummary.description: A credit note in a list.

credit_note_number.description: Sequential reference printed on the credit note (e.g. "CN-2600001").

source_invoice_id.description: Invoice this note credits. Absent on a standalone note.

amount_credited.description: Amount credited to the organization's wallet so far.

AdminBillingCreditNotePreview.description: The computed shape of a credit note that has not been requested: its line items and totals. Previewing writes nothing, allocates no number, and moves no money, so this schema deliberately carries no identity field, no number, and no timestamp. It is a separate schema from a requested or issued note's, rather than that schema with those fields nulled, so no client can mistake a preview for a credit note.

reason.description: Why the credit note should be voided. Shown to the approver and recorded on the wallet reversal.

AdminBillingWalletAdjustmentRequestStatu.description: `awaiting_approval` (no money has moved), `executed` (the adjustment posted; see `wallet_transaction_id`), `failed` (approved but not posted; see `failure_reason`), `rejected` (a finance user declined it), `withdrawn` (withdrawn before a decision), or `orphaned` (the approval request did not arrive before the adjustment expired unposted; a late approval request can still be linked but never posts the adjustment).

organization_id.description: Organization that owns the wallet.

amount.description: Requested amount, always positive, in the wallet's currency when the request was made.

reason.description: Audit reason, copied to the wallet transaction when the adjustment posts.

class.description: Staff-selected class retained from the request and recorded when the adjustment posts.

requested_by.description: Staff user who requested the adjustment.

approval_request_id.description: Finance approval request that decides this adjustment. Null while none has been linked; an orphaned adjustment can link a request that arrived after it expired.

wallet_transaction_id.description: Wallet transaction the adjustment posted. Null unless the status is `executed`.

failure_reason.description: Why an approved request did not post. Null unless the status is `failed`.

decided_by.description: Staff user whose decision or withdrawal closed the request. Null while awaiting approval, and for an orphaned request.

decided_at.description: When the closing decision or withdrawal was recorded. Null while awaiting approval, and for an orphaned request.

reverses_transaction_id.description: Original wallet credit this request asks to reverse. A populated ID does not mean a debit has posted; inspect the request status and wallet_transaction_id. Null when no reversal was requested.

AdminBillingApprovalEntityType.description: Kind of money movement awaiting approval.

AdminBillingApprovalRequestStatus.description: Approval state of a finance approval request. What the decision did to the record is execution_status.

AdminBillingApprovalSnapshotKind.description: What the request does to the customer's money.

AdminBillingApprovalLinks.description: Records the request concerns. A link is absent when the request does not concern that kind of record.

credit_note_id.description: Credit note the request issues or voids. A credit note is an invoice document, so this is an invoice ID.

AdminBillingApprovalSnapshot.description: What the requester submitted, as it was when they submitted it. The live record is on the request detail.

amount.description: Amount in the record's own currency, exactly as the record holds it.

reason.description: Reason the requester gave.

reverses_transaction_id.description: Original wallet credit a requested debit reverses. Absent for an unlinked adjustment or another request type.

class.description: Staff-selected wallet adjustment class. Absent for other request types.

entity_id.description: Identifier of the record awaiting approval in its owning ledger.

region.description: Region whose ledger holds the record.

decided_by.description: Staff member whose decision or withdrawal completed the request, or null while pending.

decided_at.description: When the request completed, or null while pending.

allow_reject.description: Whether the request can be rejected.

note.description: Note recorded by the decision that completed the request, empty when none was supplied.

stages.description: Approval stages copied from the flow when the request was submitted.

decisions.description: Decisions recorded on the request in chronological order.

AdminBillingApprovalExecutionStatus.description: What the decision did to the record, as the record's owner reports it. awaiting_approval means the effect is still due; pending and confirmed are a refund's provider states; orphaned means the record was closed because its request did not arrive in time, so nothing executes; failed carries the reason on the request detail.

AdminBillingApprovalAdjustmentType.description: A credit adds wallet funds; a debit removes them.

class.description: Staff-selected class retained on the adjustment request.

reason.description: Audit reason recorded when the adjustment was requested.

wallet_transaction_id.description: Applied wallet transaction, or null before execution.

decided_by.description: Staff user who settled the request, or null before a decision.

decided_at.description: Time the request was settled, or null before a decision.

reason.description: Audit reason recorded when the refund was requested.

wallet_clawback.description: Whether the refund removes the refunded funds from the wallet.

external_id.description: Provider refund identifier, or null before submission.

confirmed_at.description: Time the provider confirmed the refund, or null before confirmation.

AdminBillingApprovalCreditNoteKind.description: Issue creates a credit note; void cancels an existing credit note.

AdminBillingApprovalWalletEffect.description: Whether the credit note has a wallet movement, and its execution status.

tax_rate.description: Decimal tax rate, or null when no rate applies.

credit_wallet.description: Whether issuing the note credits the wallet.

wallet_effect_failure.description: Reason the wallet effect failed, when present.

credit_note_number.description: Issued credit note number, when a document exists.

credit_note_status.description: Current status of the issued credit note document.

AdminBillingApprovalRecordDetail.description: Live fields from the record owner, identified by the approval entity type.

AdminBillingApprovalRecord.description: The record awaiting approval as its owning ledger holds it now.

status.description: The record's execution status in its ledger now. The list's execution_status is a copy of it, refreshed within minutes.

failure_reason.description: Why execution failed, or null when it has not failed.

amount.description: Amount in the record's own currency, exactly as the record holds it.

AdminBillingApprovalDecisionValue.description: Decision on a finance approval request.

note.description: Reason for the decision. Required to reject.

stage_id.description: Stage to decide. Needed only while the request has more than one open stage.

requests_enabled.description: Whether this organization's region takes wallet adjustments, refunds and credit notes as approval requests. While false, adjustments and refunds post directly and credit notes cannot be requested; requests opened earlier can still be decided, withdrawn and executed.

currency_code.description: Target billing currency. Must be a supported billing currency. A request naming the wallet's current currency succeeds and moves no money — this is the retry path that finishes a re-stamp an earlier partial attempt left behind. The balance and credit limit are converted at the current published rate; when a non-zero balance is converted, the rate is recorded in the description of the adjustment transaction(s) this creates — one closing the old balance, and, unless it rounds to zero in the target currency, one booking the converted balance in the new currency.

AdminBillingSubscriptionCurrencyRestamp.description: Result of re-stamping a wallet's organization's zero-price subscriptions to the wallet's current currency.

subscriptions_restamped.description: How many zero-price subscriptions were re-stamped. Priced subscriptions are never counted here.

currency_code.description: The wallet's currency at the time of the request, read server-side and used for every re-stamped subscription.

ChannelSlug.description: A product channel slug. Open enum: new channels may be added over time; treat any unrecognized value as a future channel rather than an error.

external_description.description: A customer-facing description of the product. Null when none is set.

unit_name.description: The unit the product's usage is measured in, such as `email` for emails sent.

channel.description: The channel this product's spend is attributed to, derived from its slug. Absent for products that belong to no channel, such as plan tiers.

pricing_model.description:
How the product is priced.

- `plan`: it comes with the organization's subscribed plan, with usage
  tracked against that plan's included allowance.
- `metered`: it is billed per unit beyond any included allowance.
- `rate_card`: the per-unit price varies by attributes of the usage, such
  as destination, instead of being flat.
- `unit_subscription`: it is a standalone add-on billed as its own
  recurring subscription, independent of the plan.
- `custom`: a pricing arrangement that does not fit the other models.
- `counter`: usage is recorded without enforcing a spending cap or blocking
  requests.

AdminBillingSubscriptionDisplayStatus.description:
The subscription status to show staff. Equals `status`, except:

- `pending_switch`: an incomplete Email plan whose switch is paid and waits
  for `pending_switch.starts_at`. Its `status` stays `incomplete` until the
  handover activates it.

BillingPlanSwitchPaymentState.description: Payment progress for a pending plan switch. `awaiting_payment` is payable until its deadline. `paid` means the payment settled and the switch starts on its start date, if it has one. `needs_reconciliation` means a provider result requires review and must not be paid again. `expired` means the deadline passed without payment, so the switch will not happen.

BillingPendingPlanSwitch.description: A move from a legacy Email plan to a new Email plan that has not started yet. The legacy plan stays active until the new plan starts. A paid switch with a start date begins on that date; without one, it begins when its payment settles.

replaces_subscription_id.description: The current Email plan subscription this plan replaces.

starts_at.description: When this plan replaces the current Email plan. Omitted when the switch starts as soon as its payment settles.

plan_payment_id.description: The plan payment for this switch. Omitted until Bird creates it.

BillingInterval.description: The recurring interval one subscription charge covers.

BillingPricingInterval.description: A period: a unit and a count. A day is a fixed 24-hour UTC period. A larger `count` lengthens the period without multiplying the amount quoted for it.

unit.description: The calendar unit the period is counted in.

count.description: Number of units in the period.

BillingSubscriptionPriceBasis.description: A pricing_interval amount is multiplied by quantity and intervals_per_charge. A whole_period amount is the agreed total charged once.

AdminBillingSubscription.description: A subscription with its accepted recurring terms. Product defaults apply to new subscriptions; accepted subscriptions retain their period. `pricing_interval` and `intervals_per_charge` are absent when `billing_interval` is unavailable.

commercial_product_id.description: Commercial product whose plan this subscription is. Absent for subscriptions that are not base plans; an older plan subscription without one belongs to the product its plan configuration names.

ref_id.description: UUID of the resource this subscription provisions, such as a dedicated number's allocation. Null when it provisions no tracked resource, as with a plan or a subscription staff created directly.

unit_price.description: Fixed net total for all quantities over one charge period. When present, unit_price_basis is whole_period and quantity does not multiply this total. For a recurring package, this is the accepted price; a changed published price stops renewal until the customer accepts new terms. When absent, unit_price_basis is pricing_interval and billing resolves the rate card at charge time, multiplying its price by quantity and intervals_per_charge.

resolved_unit_price.description: Current display price in the subscription currency, using the accepted fixed price when present or the applicable rate-card price otherwise. Included in the organization subscription list when a price is available. This does not replace the accepted terms in unit_price.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code.

billing_cycle_type.description: Stored cycle classification; renewal scheduling currently uses `billing_anchor`.

billing_interval_count.description: Number of billing intervals in one period. A day interval with a count of 30 renews every 30 days. A stored whole-period price is charged once without multiplying it by this count.

pending_switch.description: Present on an incomplete Email plan subscription that waits to replace the organization's current Email plan. Platform-wide subscription and plan lists include it only once the switch is paid, so there `payment_state` is always `paid`.

pricing_interval.description: Period covered by one published recurring rate. The count changes the duration without multiplying the rate.

intervals_per_charge.description: Number of complete pricing intervals bought by each recurring charge. Renewal duration is pricing_interval.count multiplied by this value.

description.description: Optional label for this billable item, shown in subscription details and invoice lines.

start_date.description: First service day in UTC, today or earlier. Supplying this date charges every subscription period from that day through the current period now, retaining the original renewal anchor. Creation stays incomplete until these charges are recorded. Background recovery completes interrupted creation without charging a period twice. Each unit-item create is a new purchase; other pricing models refuse a repeated create while an effective no-reference subscription exists. Omit to retain the legacy uncharged first period starting now.

product_id.description: ID of the product to subscribe the organization to. Plan products are not accepted here: assign an organization's plan with the plan-assign operation, which charges the change and applies the upgrade and downgrade rules.

unit_price.description: Fixed net total for one whole subscription period, covering all quantities. Quantity does not multiply this amount. Omit or send null to use the rate card at charge time, multiplied by quantity and pricing intervals per charge.

billing_interval.description: Billing cadence for the subscription. Omit it to take the product's own, which is what a `unit_subscription` product requires: its cadence is configured on the product and its rate card is priced per that interval, so sending an interval that disagrees returns 422. Defaults to `month` for every other pricing model.

billing_cycle_type.description: Stored cycle classification. This does not change the first period or future renewal dates; scheduling currently uses the billing anchor.

quantity.description: Number of subscribed units. Multiplies rate-card pricing, but not an explicitly supplied unit_price, which is the fixed total for all units.

unit_price.description: Fixed net total for the whole subscription period, covering all quantities, in its existing currency. Quantity does not multiply this amount. Takes effect on future renewals without an immediate charge. Send null to use the rate card at charge time; this is rejected if no rate-card price is available.

billing_interval.description: Billing cadence for the subscription. Send `unit_price` for the new period in the same request; sending a changed interval on its own returns 422, because the stored price would otherwise keep describing the old period. Changing a unit subscription's cadence returns 422 whatever else you send, since it comes from the product's billing configuration. Sending the interval the subscription already has is accepted and changes nothing.

billing_cycle_type.description: Stored cycle classification. Changing it does not alter period dates or renewal timing; renewals currently use the subscription's billing anchor.

mode.description: 'immediate' cancels now. 'at_period_end' sets cancel_at_period_end and status to non_renewing.

bucket.description: Calendar date of this usage bucket (UTC).

quantity.description: For metered products, units consumed on this date. For pay-as-you-go products, transaction count on this date.

net_amount.description: Net spend on this date. Present only for rate-card products.

projected_quantity.description: Linear-pace estimate of total units by period end, based on usage to date.

projected_net_amount.description: Linear-pace estimate of total spend by period end. Included for pay-as-you-go products only; absent for metered products where spend is not per-unit.

BillingUsageDomainBucket.description: Volume breakdown for one sending domain in the period. Spend is not included because email is a metered product with a flat included allowance rather than per-domain charges.

domain.description: Sending domain.

sent.description: Emails sent via this domain in the period.

share_pct.description: Percentage share of total email volume for the period (0–100). Shares across all returned domains sum to 100, subject to floating-point rounding.

quantity.description: Units consumed in the current billing period.

included.description: Units included in the plan for the current billing period.

overage.description: Units consumed beyond the included allowance. Zero when within the included limit.

utilization_pct.description: Percentage of the included units consumed. May exceed 100 when overage is non-zero.

daily_breakdown.description: Per-day usage for the period, ordered chronologically. Included when the daily breakdown is requested.

projection.description: Linear-pace projection to period end. Present only for the default billing-period view (no custom start/end window); absent when a custom analytics range is supplied because the window is historical and a projection is not meaningful.

domain_breakdown.description: Top sending-domain breakdown for the period, ranked by volume. Included for email products when the domain breakdown is requested.

transaction_count.description: Number of transactions (messages) sent to this country in the period.

net_amount.description: Net spend for messages sent to this country.

transaction_count.description: Number of transactions in the current billing period.

net_amount.description: Net amount charged for transactions in the current billing period.

daily_breakdown.description: Per-day usage for the period, ordered chronologically. Included when the daily breakdown is requested.

projection.description: Linear-pace projection to period end. Present only for the default billing-period view (no custom start/end window); absent when a custom analytics range is supplied.

country_breakdown.description: Per-country breakdown for the period, ranked by volume. Included when the country breakdown is requested.

pricing_model.description: Pricing model for this product. `metered`: usage counted against an included allowance; the `metered` field is populated. `rate_card`: pay-as-you-go transactions at a rate card price; the `transactional` field is populated.

subscription_id.description: ID of the active subscription for this product. `null` for pay-as-you-go products with no subscription.

period_start.description: Start of the measurement window for this item (inclusive). For subscribed products this is the current subscription period start; for pay-as-you-go products it is the first day of the current calendar month.

period_end.description: End of the measurement window for this item (exclusive). For subscribed products this is the current subscription period end; for pay-as-you-go products it is the first day of the next calendar month.

metered.description: Usage details for metered products. Present when `pricing_model` is metered.

transactional.description: Spend details for rate-card products. Present when `pricing_model` is `rate_card`.

data_complete.description: Whether usage data for this item is complete. When `false`, real-time usage data was temporarily unavailable; quantities and amounts may be zero rather than the actual values for the period. The item is still included so the product and subscription context remains visible.

period_start.description: Start of the current calendar month (inclusive). Each item also carries its own period reflecting the actual measurement window.

period_end.description: Start of the next calendar month (exclusive). Each item also carries its own period reflecting the actual measurement window.

items.description: Usage summary per active product.

BillingUpgradeDescription.description: Optional single-line copy shown when offering a plan upgrade. This text does not define pricing or benefits.

fields.description: Names of the dimension keys this product prices on.

BillingProductMatchingSpec.description: Fallback tiers for pricing a `rate_card` product when a request does not match on every dimension.

patterns.description: Each entry lists the dimension field names to match on for one tier, ordered from most specific to least. Price lookup tries each tier in turn until one matches.

BillingProductChargeTiming.description: Distinguishes one-time rate-card charges from per-use rate-card pricing. One-time charging requires rate-card pricing without session increments. Plan and unit-subscription charge periods come from their separate cadence configuration.

BillingProductUseIncrement.description: Whether this product is billed by session duration. When `true`, its prices use an increment (initial and continuation seconds) to determine how each session's duration is rounded when calculating the charge.

internal_description.description: Internal notes visible only to Bird staff.

upgrade_description.description: Optional copy shown when offering a plan upgrade. Omitted when no copy is set.

label.description: Internal grouping label used to organize products in the admin overview (e.g. SMS, E-mail, Numbers).

channel.description: The channel this product's spend is attributed to, derived from its slug. Absent for products that belong to no channel, such as plan tiers.

billing_unit_size.description: Number of units that form one chargeable block for metered overage. Overage is ceiling-rounded to the nearest multiple of this value before applying the unit price. A value of 1 (the default) charges per individual unit.

rate_card_id.description: ID of the active rate card currently set as default for this product.

BillingProductSlug.description: URL-safe identifier for a billing product. Lowercase letters and digits, separated by underscores. Must start with a letter.

AdminBillingUnitSubscriptionConfigInput.description: Period covered by one recurring rate and the number of intervals bought per charge. Changing the pricing interval after rate publication or subscription creation requires `confirm_change: true`. Existing rate amounts stay unchanged and apply to the new interval. Existing subscriptions retain their stored terms, but their renewal pricing or eligibility may be affected. When modern and deprecated fields are supplied together, `pricing_interval.unit` must equal `billing_interval` and `intervals_per_charge` must equal `billing_interval_count`; conflicting aliases return 422. If neither pricing-interval field is supplied, the pricing interval resets to one month. If neither charge-count field is supplied, the number of intervals per charge resets to one.

confirm_change.description: Acknowledges that these product changes may affect pricing and subscription renewals. Required to change a pricing interval after rate publication or subscription creation. Does not bypass other validation or migrate subscriptions.

billing_interval.description: Unit the rate-card price is quoted in. When omitted, resets to `month`.

billing_interval_count.description: Number of intervals one charge covers. When omitted, resets to `1`.

pricing_interval.description: Period covered by one published rate. `count` accepts up to 366 days or 36 months or years, and `count` multiplied by `intervals_per_charge` must fit the same unit-specific limit; exceeding either limit returns 422.

intervals_per_charge.description: Number of complete pricing intervals bought by each recurring charge. Renewal duration is pricing_interval.count multiplied by this value.

internal_description.description: Internal notes visible only to Bird staff.

upgrade_description.description: Optional copy shown when offering a plan upgrade. An empty string removes the copy.

label.description: Internal grouping label used to organize products in the admin overview (e.g. SMS, E-mail, Numbers).

billing_unit_size.description: Number of units that form one chargeable block for metered overage. Overage is ceiling-rounded to the nearest multiple of this value before applying the unit price. Defaults to 1 (charge per individual unit).

unit_subscription_config.description: Billing cadence for a `unit_subscription` product, created with the product in one transaction. Omit it to bill monthly, which is also what omitting each of its own fields falls back to.

slug.description: Stable machine-readable commercial product name.

name.description: Display name for staff catalog workflows.

internal_description.description: Internal notes visible only to Bird staff.

upgrade_description.description: Optional copy shown when offering a plan upgrade. An empty string removes the copy.

label.description: Internal grouping label used to organize products in the admin overview (e.g. SMS, E-mail, Numbers). Set to null to remove the label.

billing_unit_size.description: Number of units that form one chargeable block for metered overage. Overage is ceiling-rounded to the nearest multiple of this value before applying the unit price.

rate_card_id.description: Set the default rate card for this product. Must be an active rate card belonging to this product.

status.description: Valid transitions: draft→active, active→deprecated, deprecated→active. Setting status back to draft is not supported.

AdminRevenueMetricKind.description:
Financial measure and its attribution basis.
Current, churned and scheduled plan MRR excludes funding-only deposit commitments.
- `mrr_monthly`: Current monthly-billed paid-plan MRR, excluding removed organizations.
- `mrr_annual`: Current annual-billed paid-plan value divided by twelve, excluding removed organizations.
- `mrr_non_renewing`: Current MRR flagged to stop at period end; a scheduled replacement may follow.
- `mrr_past_due`: Current paid-plan MRR in past-due status; not proof of collectability.
- `mrr_unpriced`: Count of paid-plan subscriptions with no resolved stored price; amount is zero.
- `mrr_accounts`: Distinct organizations contributing priced paid-plan MRR in this currency; amount is zero. An organization with multiple eligible plans is counted once.
- `payg_history`: Trailing 30-day non-recurring wallet charges using the existing charge-date removal policy; not earned or collected revenue.
- `scheduled_unresolved`: Scheduled plans whose commercial-product handover, price or currency cannot be matched unambiguously. Amount is zero; count is the coverage gap.
- `mrr_history`: Estimated charge-period plan MRR on the given UTC day, net of tax. Existing normalization divides periods over 60 days by twelve and uses full net otherwise. Quarterly, multi-year and short upgrade periods can be misnormalized; upgrade deltas can restate earlier days.
- `mrr_wallet_settled`: Estimated charge-period MRR marked settled against the wallet, including approved credit; uses the same duration heuristic and is not cash.
- `scheduled_mrr`: Normalized MRR of plans scheduled to start on the given day, not yet active.
- `scheduled_expansion`: MRR increase from unambiguous same-currency scheduled plan handovers relative to the current plan.
- `scheduled_contraction`: MRR decrease from unambiguous same-currency scheduled plan handovers relative to the current plan.
- `upgrade_charges`: Net plan-upgrade fees posted on the given day; not an effective-date MRR movement.
- `churned_mrr`: Normalized MRR of subscriptions cancelled on the given day; based on their stored price.
- `invoiced_net`: Net debit invoices issued on the given day, excluding void invoices.
- `invoiced_tax`: Customer tax on debit invoices issued on the given day, excluding void invoices.
- `invoiced_gross`: Gross debit invoices issued on the given day, excluding void invoices.
- `invoice_not_due`: Unpaid gross debit invoices with a due date today or later.
- `invoice_overdue_1_30`: Unpaid gross debit invoices one to thirty days past due.
- `invoice_overdue_31_60`: Unpaid gross debit invoices thirty-one to sixty days past due.
- `invoice_overdue_61_90`: Unpaid gross debit invoices sixty-one to ninety days past due.
- `invoice_overdue_90_plus`: Unpaid gross debit invoices more than ninety days past due.
- `invoice_due_unknown`: Unpaid gross debit invoices with no due date.
- `product_charges_net`: Net posted charges attributed to a billing product through complete wallet lines that reconcile to their parent debit, by posting day. Excludes unposted usage. Counts charge postings touching the product, not customers.
- `product_unattributed_net`: Net posted charges without a complete matching product breakdown. Includes recurring fees with no retained wallet lines; never allocate these using traffic shares.
- `charges_net`: All net charges posted to customer wallets on the given day.
- `charges_tax`: Tax on charges posted to customer wallets on the given day.
- `charges_gross`: All gross charges posted to customer wallets on the given day, shown positive.
- `plan_charges_net`: Net wallet charges identified as initial recurring fees, renewals or plan upgrades, including base plans, recurring resources and packages.
- `non_plan_charges_net`: Net wallet charges excluding recurring-fee and plan-upgrade keys; includes usage, overage, one-offs and commitment gaps.
- `charges_missing_tax`: Gross charge amount whose net or tax breakdown is missing; count is affected transactions.
- `provider_funding`: Wallet credits linked by stable identity, amount and currency to successful provider payment intents, by wallet-credit day.
- `invoice_funding`: Wallet credits for staff-recorded invoice payments; not independently bank-verified.
- `unmatched_funding`: Other top-up credits without a matching successful provider intent or staff-recorded invoice payment.
- `wallet_funding_organizations`: Distinct organizations with top-ups in the selected or prior comparison period, per region and currency; amount is zero and day is the period start. This is a whole-period count, not a daily series. Organizations funding multiple currencies appear in each currency.
- `wallet_adjustments`: Signed wallet adjustments; these are not necessarily cash.
- `wallet_refunds`: Signed wallet refund ledger effects; do not add them to provider refunds as a second cash movement.
- `wallet_prepaid`: Sum of positive posted wallet balances, without netting other customers' debt.
- `wallet_debt`: Absolute sum of negative posted wallet balances; may overlap unpaid invoices.
- `wallet_beyond_credit`: Posted wallet debt above approved credit limits, excluding reservations.
- `wallet_credit_limit`: Total approved wallet credit limits; not cash or revenue.
- `wallet_reserved`: Current reserved wallet amounts; not an additional posted expense.
- `provider_refunds`: Confirmed provider refunds by confirmation day, separate from wallet clawbacks.
- `pending_refunds`: Gross refund requests currently pending; not confirmed cash outflows.
- `payment_created`: Provider payment intents created on the given day, including all current outcomes.
- `payment_succeeded`: Created-cohort payment intents currently succeeded; this is not a capture-date series.
- `payment_failed`: Created-cohort payment intents currently failed, declined or blocked.
- `payment_canceled`: Created-cohort payment intents currently cancelled.
- `payment_open`: Created-cohort payment intents whose outcome remains nonterminal.
- `payment_uncredited`: Succeeded intents created in the reporting history without an identity, amount and currency matched wallet credit.

AdminRevenueMetric.description: A native-currency financial measure, optionally converted to the reporting currency. An absent day indicates a current snapshot. reporting_amount is absent when the report's current FX policy cannot provide a rate. product_id identifies the billing product from reconciled wallet lines and is present only for product_charges_net.

day.description: UTC attribution day; absent for current snapshots.

reporting_amount.description: The amount converted using the report's current FX policy; absent when the rate is unavailable.

product_id.description: Billing product identified by reconciled wallet lines; present only for product_charges_net.

product_name.description: Current catalog name for product_id. Absent if the catalog no longer retains that product.

count.description: Number of underlying records when counted. Daily MRR and trailing-charge history use zero because record counts are not supplied. Distinct customers are not implied.

AdminRevenueAccount.description: An organization on a bounded financial leaderboard, with amounts in its wallet currency. Balances are current snapshots.

charges.description: Net wallet charges in the selected period.

funding.description: All wallet top-ups in the selected period, including staff-recorded invoice payments.

AdminRevenueCollectionKind.description: Collection policy that created the lifecycle.

AdminRevenueCollectionStatus.description: Current lifecycle state. An exhausted lifecycle has no remaining automatic retries.

AdminRevenueCollectionOutcome.description: Current outcome of collection lifecycles created on the given day. Counts are independent of currency and do not count individual retries as new lifecycles.

AdminRevenueReport.description: Financial reporting over complete UTC days, except the explicitly requested live_report which covers today up to query time. Period flows and current snapshots remain separate; no amount certifies bank receipt or recognized revenue.

from.description: Selected period start, inclusive.

to.description: Selected period end, exclusive.

comparison_from.description: Start of the immediately preceding equal-length comparison period.

history_from.description: Start of returned daily history, including the trailing-window lookback.

as_of.description: Query time for current snapshots and payment outcome observation.

reporting_currency.description: Currency used for reporting_amount; USD for this report.

missing_currencies.description: Native currencies that could not be converted; the combined reporting-currency total is incomplete.

top_spend_accounts.description: Up to ten accounts per native currency with the largest net charges in the responding region. Empty for global and collection reports.

debt_accounts.description: Up to ten negative-wallet accounts per native currency in the responding region. Empty for global and collection reports. This is a leaderboard, not a complete receivables list.

collection_outcomes.description: Currency-independent collection lifecycle counts, separate from payment-intent attempts.

AdminBillingMrrByCurrency.description: Monthly recurring revenue for a single currency.

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue in this currency. Annual subscriptions are normalized to a monthly figure.

at_risk.description: The portion of this currency's recurring revenue set to cancel at the end of the current period. Still billed this period but lost at renewal, so net forward revenue is mrr minus at_risk.

subscription_count.description: Subscriptions contributing to this currency's recurring revenue.

at_risk_subscription_count.description: Subscriptions in this currency set to cancel at the end of the current period.

AdminBillingSubscriptionStatusCounts.description: Count of active paid subscriptions by status.

AdminBillingPlansSummary.description: Aggregate figures for active paid plan subscriptions across all organizations, narrowed by the same filters as the plan list.

live_report.description: Current priced subscription MRR and today's estimated charge-period MRR, reread at query time. Present only when include_live is true, independently of historical reporting dates. Charge-period MRR uses charge duration to estimate monthly amounts and does not identify uncertain normalization separately.

report.description: Platform plan snapshots, historical MRR and scheduled movements. Present only when reporting dates are supplied. Invoices, wallets and payments are reported by their own billing operations.

mrr_by_currency.description: Monthly recurring capacity-fee revenue per currency. Annual subscriptions are normalized to a monthly figure. Funding-only deposit commitments and subscriptions without a resolved price are excluded.

total_subscriptions.description: Active paid plan subscriptions matching the filters.

total_organizations.description: Distinct organizations with an active paid plan matching the filters.

unpriced_count.description: Subscriptions excluded from recurring-revenue figures because they carry no resolved price.

WalletTransactionType.description:
Wallet transaction type.

- `top_up`: a manual or automatic top-up credit.
- `charge`: a usage or subscription debit.
- `refund`: a refunded payment. It debits the wallet: the credit from the
  original top-up is taken back when the money returns to your card.
- `adjustment`: a positive or negative manual correction.

live_report.description: Today's posted charges, product attribution and wallet funding through query time, with today's trailing non-recurring billed pace. Present only with include_live. from is midnight and to is query time. history_from includes 29 preceding UTC days of charge coverage; funding and product rows cover the adjacent equal-duration comparison period and today. No balance snapshot or account leaderboard is returned.

report.description: Regional wallet funding provenance, charges, PAYG history, current balances and account leaders. Present only when reporting dates are supplied; it covers the whole region regardless of the current page.

AdminVoiceChargeSourceKind.description: Original financial source. Capacity fees have fulfilled payment obligations without a wallet debit.

AdminVoiceChargeReportRow.description: Customer posted charges by product, financial source and native currency. Amounts are exact decimal strings.

source_count.description: Distinct financial sources contributing to this row.

net.description: Posted amount before tax, in native currency units.

tax.description: Recorded tax, in native currency units.

gross.description: Posted amount including tax, in native currency units.

AdminVoiceChargeWalletFinding.description: Missing or inconsistent evidence for a wallet charge.

reason.description: Reason the original financial source cannot be completely attributed.

AdminVoiceChargeCapacityFinding.description: Missing or inconsistent evidence for a capacity payment obligation.

reason.description: Reason the original financial source cannot be completely attributed.

AdminVoiceChargeReportFinding.description: Missing or inconsistent evidence prevents publishing any report amounts.

AdminVoiceChargeReport.description: Regional retained-posting snapshot for Voice and phone-number products. No rates are applied and no accounting records are changed. Full population completeness across regions or historical retention is not certified.

region.description: Region whose financial sources were read.

period_start.description: Inclusive original posting or fulfillment timestamp.

period_end.description: Exclusive original posting or fulfillment timestamp.

organization_ids.description: Applied organization filter; empty means all organizations in this region.

global_as_of.description: Global allocation snapshot time, read after the regional snapshot.

complete.description: Every selected regional financial source has sufficient allocation evidence. False means rows is empty; inspect findings. This does not establish historical global-charge coverage.

source_count.description: Voice financial sources inspected; excludes unclassified sources.

finding_count.description: All unresolved source findings; findings contains at most the first 1000.

historical_coverage_verified.description: Always false for this retained-postings report. Global historical charges without retained wallet or capacity payment references are not checked.

AdminBillingApprovalView.description: Which finance approval requests to return. awaiting_me lists pending requests the current staff member can decide; mine lists the requests they submitted; all lists every request whose kind they can read.

execution_status.description: What the decision did to the record, or null while the request is pending, including while a multi-stage request has only some of its approvals. A display copy refreshed within minutes; the request detail reads the record live.

billed_before_tax.description: Posted charges before tax, grouped by original currency. Null when any retained charge lacks net or tax detail; an empty array means no retained activity.

provider_refunds.description: Confirmed provider refunds in their original currencies, including any refunded tax. Kept separate from charges and wallet clawbacks.

incomplete_charge_count.description: Retained charge records without net or tax detail. A positive count makes billed_before_tax null.

observed_at.description: Regional observation time and exclusive activity cutoff. Separate batches and regions are not a single snapshot.

amount.description: Original provider-funded wallet amount and currency, without conversion to the wallet's current currency.

provenance.description: Derived from legacy history; retained evidence does not establish authoritative ledger posting order.

funding.description: Earliest retained positive provider top-up by posting timestamp, matched to a succeeded payment intent in the same organization and wallet with the same amount and currency. Earlier missing history may exist.

AdminProviderFundingState.description: Funded identifies the first confirmed provider top-up. Not observed means this region has no qualifying posting in complete retained history. Unknown means history or payment identity cannot establish the first funding.

first_funding.description: Confirmed first provider funding when state is funded; null for not_observed or unknown.

derived_funding.description: Derived evidence from legacy history when state is unknown and the retained first candidate matches a succeeded provider payment. Omitted when evidence is missing or ambiguous; does not change state or first_funding.

observed_at.description: Time this regional read was observed, not the provider settlement time.

AdminBillingSubscriptionStatusBreakdown.description: Count of subscriptions by status, including terminal and scheduled states.

AdminBillingPricingModelCount.description: Number of subscriptions for a single pricing model.

AdminBillingSubscriptionsSummary.description: Aggregate figures for subscriptions across all organizations, narrowed by the same filters as the subscription list. The free plan is excluded.

by_pricing_model.description: Subscription counts grouped by pricing model.

total_organizations.description: Distinct organizations with a subscription matching the filters.

AdminBillingSubscriptionCurrencyDriftFix.description: One organization whose diverged subscriptions carry no unit price of their own, so re-stamping the currency is a data fix.

subscription_count.description: How many subscriptions carry the diverged currency.

AdminBillingSubscriptionCurrencyDriftBlo.description: One organization whose diverged subscriptions carry a stored unit price, so each one needs its own pricing decision.

subscription_count.description: How many subscriptions carry the diverged currency.

subscription_ids.description: The diverged subscriptions, one pricing decision each.

AdminBillingSubscriptionCurrencyDrift.description: Subscription currency divergence in this region, split by whether it can be corrected without a pricing decision.

fixable.description: Organizations whose diverged subscriptions carry no unit price of their own (null or zero), so the price is re-resolved each period and re-stamping the currency is a data fix.

blocked.description: Organizations whose diverged subscriptions carry a stored unit price. Re-denominating a priced subscription is a pricing decision, so these are reported and not corrected here.

AdminBillingMrrProductRevenue.description: One product family's share of a day's plan MRR.

unattributed.description: True for subscriptions with no product family. Such an entry carries no family.

family.description: Product family slug, such as email or amb. Absent when unattributed.

name.description: The product family's display name.

booking.description: This family's contracted recurring revenue in USD. The day's total is divided across families with remainders allocated, so they sum exactly to booking.

collected.description: This family's settled (funded) recurring revenue in USD, allocated the same way.

AdminBillingMrrPoint.description: Plan MRR on a single calendar day, summed across every currency into the base currency (USD). Booking counts every recurring charge whose billing period covers the day, including pending/unpaid periods; collected counts only settled (funded) charges.

products.description: Product families on the same day, included only when requested. Their USD amounts sum exactly to booking and collected. Empty when no recurring revenue was recorded.

day.description: The calendar day (UTC) the figures are as of.

booking.description: Contracted recurring revenue for periods covering this day.

collected.description: Settled (funded) recurring revenue for periods covering this day.

AdminBillingMrrTimeseries.description: Platform-wide daily plan MRR over the window, converted to a single base currency (USD) via the latest FX rates. One point per calendar day, oldest first.

series.description: One point per calendar day in the window, oldest first.

AdminBillingPaygProductRevenue.description: One product group's share of trailing 30-day pay-as-you-go revenue.

group.description: Product channel such as sms, voice or numbers. Other products use other; charges without a reliable product attribution use unattributed.

revenue.description: This group's revenue in USD. Fractional conversion remainders are allocated across groups so they sum exactly to the day's total.

AdminBillingPaygPoint.description: Pay-as-you-go revenue for the 30 days up to and including a single calendar day, summed across every currency into the base currency (USD). Counts metered usage, period-end overage, one-time purchases, and minimum-commit shortfalls; excludes plan subscription charges, wallet top-ups, refunds, and credit adjustments.

products.description: Product groups over the same trailing window, included only when requested. Their USD amounts sum exactly to revenue. Empty when no revenue was recorded.

day.description: The calendar day (UTC) the trailing window ends on, inclusive.

revenue.description: Non-subscription revenue charged over the 30 days ending on this day, before tax and without later refunds or credits subtracted. Final for every point but the last, whose window ends on a day still in progress and so keeps rising until that day closes.

AdminBillingPaygTimeseries.description: This region's daily pay-as-you-go revenue run-rate over the window, converted to a single base currency (USD) via the latest FX rates. One point per calendar day, oldest first.

series.description: One point per calendar day in the window, oldest first.

BillingInvoiceType.description: Accounting classification of the invoice. The `debit` value is a standard invoice for an amount you owe us, such as charges, monthly recurring costs, or overage. The `credit` value is a credit note for an amount we owe you, such as a correction or goodwill credit.

AdminBillingInvoiceCore.description: An admin view of a billing invoice, includes organization_id for cross-org listing.

subtotal_net.description: Decimal amount as a string, in major currency units.

due_date.description: When payment is due. Omitted when the invoice was paid in full at issue. A prepaid invoice that still owes money is due on the UTC day it was generated. A postpaid invoice is due at the end of the organization's payment terms, and never before the day it was generated.

tax_in_issuer_currency.description: Total tax restated in the currency of the entity that issued this invoice, when that differs from `currency_code`. Converted at the exchange rate in force on the issue date. Null when no restatement applies.

AdminBillingInvoice.description: An admin view of a billing invoice, includes organization_id for cross-org listing.

report.description: Platform invoiced net amounts, tax, gross amounts and current aging. Present only when reporting dates are supplied; it covers all matching report dates regardless of the current page.

AdminBillingInvoiceBillToAddress.description: Postal fields retained on an issued invoice. Fields may be empty or invalid until verified.

state.description: Retained state, province or region.

country_code.description: Country value retained at issuance. It may be empty or invalid until verified.

AdminBillingInvoiceBillTo.description: Customer name and address retained on this invoice. The address may be incomplete or absent until verified.

company_name.description: Company name retained on this invoice. May be empty when no company name is available.

BillingInvoiceLineItem.description: A single line on a billing invoice.

workspace_id.description: The workspace this line concerns. Null for an org-level charge, such as the plan's recurring fee.

product_id.description: The product this line concerns, or null when the line is not tied to one.

period_start.description: First day of the line's service period (UTC). Absent for lines with no period (for example, adjustments).

period_end.description: Exclusive end of the line's service period: the next period's first day (UTC); the billed last day is the day before. Absent for lines with no period.

quantity.description: Billed quantity for usage lines (for example, number of messages). Absent for flat or subscription lines.

unit_name.description: Unit the quantity is counted in (for example, `message`, `minute`). Absent when the line has no unit.

net_amount.description: This line's amount before tax, as a decimal string in `currency_code` units.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate applied to this line, as a decimal fraction (for example, `0.21` for 21%). Null when no tax applies.

tax_amount.description: Tax charged on this line, as a decimal string in `currency_code` units.

gross_amount.description: This line's total (`net_amount` plus `tax_amount`), as a decimal string in `currency_code` units.

sort_order.description: Position of this line among the invoice's line items, for display order.

AdminBillingInvoiceAllocationSource.description:
How an invoice allocation was made.

- `auto`: unallocated credit paid the oldest open invoice.
- `targeted`: a credit sent for this invoice paid it.
- `staff`: staff recorded a bank receipt or applied a credit.
- `external`: a capacity fee collected outside the wallet paid it.
- `legacy`: a paid amount recorded before allocations existed, with no credit that traces to it.

AdminBillingInvoiceAllocationReversalRea.description:
Why an invoice allocation was reversed.

- `refund`: the payment behind it was refunded.
- `invoice_void`: the invoice was voided.
- `reapplied`: the credit was moved, or the allocation was replaced by a larger one.

AdminBillingInvoiceAllocation.description: One payment allocation on an invoice. It names the wallet credit or capacity payment obligation that paid this amount.

amount.description: Allocated amount as a decimal string in the invoice currency.

wallet_transaction_id.description: The wallet credit that paid this amount. Null for external and legacy allocations.

product_plan_payment_obligation_id.description: The capacity payment obligation that paid this amount. Null unless the source is external.

actor_id.description: Staff user who made the allocation. Null for automatic allocations.

reversed_at.description: When the allocation was reversed. Null while it still pays the invoice.

reversal_reason.description: Why the allocation was reversed. Null while it still pays the invoice.

AdminBillingInvoiceCreditNote.description: The credit-note facet of an invoice detail, what it credits and who requested it. Present on `AdminBillingInvoiceDetail` when the invoice is a credit note.

source_invoice_id.description: Invoice this note credits. Absent on a standalone note.

AdminBillingInvoiceBillToUpdate.description: Replacement customer name and address for this invoice only. The organization billing profile and invoice tax amounts remain unchanged.

po_number.description: Purchase order reference. Pass null to clear.

bill_to.description: Replaces the structured bill-to snapshot and derives the PDF address block from it. A void invoice only permits repair of an incomplete bill-to snapshot, without a purchase-order amendment.

AdminBillingReceiptCandidateID.description: A bank-transfer payment intent ID (`pyi_`) or a bank deposit ID (`bdp_`), as a refusal listed it.

AdminBillingInvoicePayment.description: Request body for recording a bank transfer received into the issuing entity's account for the invoice currency.

amount.description: Payment amount as a decimal string in the invoice currency (e.g. "50.00"). It may exceed what the invoice still owes; the rest pays the organization's other open invoices oldest first.

reference.description: The bank's transaction ID for this transfer, from the statement of the account it was received into. Recording the same reference again for the same invoice and amount returns the existing payment.

not_duplicate_of.description: Payments of the same amount that staff confirmed are different money from this transfer, each named by the ID the refusal listed. These are bank-transfer payment intents, pending or settled; bank deposits into the same account that are still undecided, being applied, held for review or applied in the last 30 days; and undecided deposits not yet matched to an account, which are listed on their currency and amount alone. Every one listed must be named on every receipt it could duplicate. An applying deposit always refuses the receipt, even when named; wait for its credit to finish.

AdminBillingInvoiceCreditApplication.description: Request body for applying an existing wallet credit to an invoice. The credit named by `wallet_transaction_id` must be a top-up or a credit without a billing period, in the invoice currency.
