AdminBillingPaymentReceipt.description: An admin view of a wallet top-up payment receipt; includes organization_id for cross-org listing.

wallet_transaction_id.description: ID of the wallet transaction that funded this top-up.

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string, in major currency units.

payment_method_summary.description: Human-readable payment method summary (e.g. "Visa ending in 4242").

provider_payment_id.description: External provider reference for reconciliation (e.g. Airwallex payment ID).

auto_topup.description: Whether this receipt was generated from an automatic top-up.

AdminBillingProformaDocument.description: An admin view of a pro forma document; includes organization_id for cross-org listing.

document_number.description: Sequential reference to quote as the bank-transfer payment reference (e.g. "PRO-2600001").

description.description: What the prepayment is for.

amount.description: Amount requested by this document.

AdminBillingBankDepositMatchStatus.description: Where the deposit stands. `undecided` has not been decided yet, usually because Airwallex has not settled it. `applying` is being credited to the matched invoice's organization. `applied` paid the invoice. `review` is held for staff with the reason in `match_reason`. `dismissed` is not a customer payment, or was rejected or reversed before it was credited. `reversed` was taken back by the bank after it was credited, and needs a manual clawback.

AdminBillingBankDeposit.description: A bank transfer received into one of Bird Pay's Airwallex Global Accounts, with how it was matched to an invoice.

provider_status.description: Airwallex's status for the deposit, such as `PENDING`, `SETTLED`, `REJECTED` or `REVERSED`.

provider_type.description: Airwallex's type for the deposit. Only `BANK_TRANSFER` can pay an invoice.

global_account_id.description: The Airwallex Global Account that received the deposit.

provider_transaction_id.description: Airwallex's ID for the transaction that moved the money.

receiving_account.description: The IBAN, or account number when there is none, that the receiving entity prints for the deposit's currency. Null until the receiving entity is resolved, or when that entity prints no account in the currency.

amount.description: The amount as a decimal string in the deposit's currency. Null when Bird cannot read it exactly, so it cannot be applied - the currency is unknown, Airwallex sent more decimals than the currency has, or the amount is out of range.

provider_amount.description: The amount exactly as Airwallex sent it.

reference.description: The payment reference the payer wrote on the transfer.

payer_name.description: The payer's name as the bank reported it.

settled_at.description: When Airwallex settled the deposit. Null until it settles.

match_reason.description: Why the deposit is held, dismissed or reversed, such as `amount_mismatch`, `no_invoice_reference`, `possible_duplicate_receipt`, `before_cutover`, `staff` or `reopened`. Null once it is applied.

business_entity_id.description: The Bird entity whose account received the deposit. Null when the receiving account was not resolved.

organization_id.description: The organization of the matched or applied invoice. Null when no invoice was matched.

invoice_id.description: The invoice matched from the reference, or the one the deposit was applied to. Null when no invoice was matched.

invoice_number.description: The number of the invoice in `invoice_id`. Null when no invoice was matched.

wallet_transaction_id.description: The wallet credit the deposit was applied as. Null until it is applied.

decided_by.description: The staff member who last applied, dismissed or reopened the deposit. Null when only the automatic matching decided it.

decided_at.description: When the deposit was last decided. Null while it is undecided.

decision_note.description: The note the staff member gave with their last decision.

parsed_invoice_numbers.description: The invoice numbers read from the reference, whether or not any of them is an invoice of the receiving entity.

AdminBillingBankDepositApplication.description: Request body for applying a held bank deposit to an invoice of the entity that received it.

invoice_id.description: The invoice to pay. It must be issued by the entity whose account received the deposit, in the deposit's currency. The deposit's full amount is credited; any amount the invoice does not owe pays the organization's other open invoices oldest first.

not_duplicate_of.description: Payments of the same amount that staff confirmed are different money from this deposit, each named by the ID the refusal listed. These are bank-transfer payment intents, recorded receipts' keys, or earlier Record payment credits. Every one listed must be named.

note.description: Why the deposit is applied to this invoice.

AdminBillingBankDepositNote.description: Request body for dismissing or reopening a bank deposit.

note.description: Why the deposit is dismissed or reopened.

external_ids.description: Airwallex customer external ids to resolve to Bird organizations.

external_id.description: The Airwallex customer external id, as passed in the request.

organization_id.description: The Bird organization the external id resolved to.

resolutions.description: One entry per external id resolved to an org in this region. Unresolved ids are omitted.

AdminPaymentDisputeDecisionAutomationMod.description: How dispute auto-challenge was running when the decision was recorded. `on` means Bird acted on it. `dry_run` means Bird recorded what it would have done and uploaded nothing, so the row is a rehearsal rather than a response the issuer saw, and a live decision replaces it once the mode is `on`.

AdminPaymentDisputeDecisionAction.description: What Bird decided to do about a dispute at one stage. `challenged` means Bird filed a response, or is still retrying one. `skipped` means the stage no longer awaited a response. `manual` means Bird left the stage to staff, and the decision's reason says why.

AdminPaymentDisputeDecisionTier.description: Which evidence tier backed the challenge. `banned` means the organization is suspended and Bird holds both the suspension statement and consumption figures for the window it cites. `verified` means the purchased balance was consumed between the payment and the dispute, and the payment carries a 3-D Secure outcome with liability shift. `delivered` means the challenge rests on the credited balance without card authentication: a product-not-received claim, whether or not the balance was used, or a consumer dispute over consumed balance whose payment recorded the purchase IP address.

AdminPaymentDisputeDecisionReason.description: Why Bird filed no challenge of its own. `pre_chargeback` means responding would escalate into the chargeback fee, which staff weigh. `stage_unsupported` means the card scheme decides the stage, or the provider reported a stage Bird does not recognise. `reason_type_unsupported` means the issuer's reason is not one Bird's record of consumed balance answers. `no_3ds_evidence` means the payment carries no authentication outcome to cite. `no_usage` means no channel shows the purchased balance being consumed. `due_soon` means the response window closes within a day while the evidence was still unread, so the stage goes to staff before it expires. `error` means the submission failed every attempt it had.

AdminPaymentDisputeDecisionOutcome.description: What became of the dispute at the stage this decision covers. `won` and `lost` are the issuer's verdict, `accepted` means the dispute was conceded, and `escalated` means the issuer pursued the dispute past this stage. The value is the dispute's fate, never whether a Bird challenge succeeded: a skipped, manual, overridden or dry-run decision takes the issuer's verdict too. Counting wins over these values alone counts disputes Bird never contested, so a win rate reads the action, the submission time and the automation mode as well.

AdminPaymentDisputeDecision.description: Bird's own record of what it decided about one dispute at one stage, including the stages it decided not to challenge. The provider stays the source of truth for the dispute itself; a stage carries one decision per automation mode, and a stage staff answered by hand carries none.

stage.description: Dispute stage this decision answers. A stage the provider added since is recorded as it reported it, and lands as `manual` with reason `stage_unsupported`.

automation_mode.description: How dispute auto-challenge was running when the decision was recorded.

action.description: What Bird decided to do.

tier.description: Evidence tier selected when preparing a challenge, including a dry run or an attempt later handed to staff. Null when no tier was selected.

reason.description: Why Bird filed no challenge, or null when it did and when a stage that no longer awaited a response was skipped.

challenge_reason.description: Case the challenge argued to the issuer, or null when Bird filed none.

organization_id.description: Organization the disputed payment belongs to. Bird resolves it from its own payment record, which is what the provider's customer identifier alone does not give.

payment_intent_id.description: Bird's own record of the disputed payment. This is not the provider-side identifier the dispute reports.

submitted_at.description: When the challenge reached the provider. Null on a decision that filed nothing, and on a challenge whose attempts are still outstanding.

attempts.description: Submission attempts spent so far. Three exhausts the budget.

last_error.description: Error from the most recent failed attempt, or null when none failed.

evidence_file_ids.description: Provider file identifiers Bird uploaded for this decision, in upload order. A file is readable through the dispute's own documents only once the challenge citing it is filed, so a decision still retrying lists identifiers the dispute does not yet name. Empty on a decision that uploaded nothing.

request_id.description: Deduplication key the challenge was sent under, to quote when asking the provider what became of a submission. Null before any attempt.

outcome.description: What became of the dispute at this stage, or null while it is not final. It is the issuer's verdict on the dispute rather than a verdict on a Bird challenge.

overridden_by.description: Staff member who overrode the decision, or null when none did. While an override stands, dispute auto-challenge stands down on the whole stage, whichever `automation_mode` recorded the overridden decision; the issuer's verdict still lands in `outcome`, since that records what became of the dispute rather than what Bird chose.

AdminPaymentDisputeDecisionList.description: Every decision Bird holds for one dispute. A dispute carries at most one decision per stage and automation mode, so a stage reviewed in `dry_run` and then decided with automation `on` returns both rows, and the collection is bounded and is not paginated.

data.description: Decisions in the order Bird recorded them. Empty when Bird has decided nothing yet, which is the normal state of a dispute no region could attribute to a payment, one dispute auto-challenge has not reached, and one recorded while the automation was off.

AdminPaymentDisputeAccept.description: Concede a dispute, optionally with a partial refund.

refund.description: Partial refund to offer. Omit or null to accept in full. Accepting a dispute at the RFI stage triggers a full refund regardless.

AdminPaymentDisputeDocument.description: One bundle of evidence files submitted with a challenge.

description.description: What these files show and why they support the challenge.

file_ids.description: Identifiers returned when the evidence files were uploaded.

AdminPaymentDisputeChallenge.description: A challenge submission. Only disputes awaiting a response at the RFI or chargeback stage can be challenged, and at least one evidence document is required.

product_description.description: What the cardholder purchased. Applies at the chargeback stage.

refund_refusal_reason.description: Why a refund is being refused. Applies at the chargeback stage.

AdminPaymentDisputeEvidenceFile.description: A stored evidence file, referenced by identifier when challenging.

file_id.description: Identifier to list under a challenge document.

PlanFinancialBehavior.description: Funding is a spend commitment; a prepaid funding fee credits the shared wallet. Capacity buys included usage without a wallet credit. Payment collection is a separate plan term.

AdminBillingPlanCollectionSource.description: Wallet collection preserves existing plan billing. New draft capacity plans may use wallet or external collection. Billing family validation rejects external collection for legacy Email and new Email Free capacity plans with a 422 `validation_error` on authoring and activation. The new Email family permits capacity only for its zero-fee Free tier; paid tiers require funding and external collection. Activation has no commercial-product allowlist. Collection source cannot change after configuration.

default_interval.description: Default billing cadence for subscriptions to this plan.

Activation requires a plan configuration and checks family financial-behavior consistency without a commercial-product allowlist.

Family validation rejects external collection for legacy Email and new Email Free capacity plans. New Email capacity is limited to the zero-fee Free tier; paid tiers require funding. Funding plans require a draft product. The value cannot change after creation.

AdminBillingOfferStatus.description:
Where the offer is in its lifecycle.

- `draft`: admits no one until it is published.
- `published`: admits a signup only within its redemption window and while it is under its redemption cap.
- `withdrawn`: admits no one; benefits already granted stay in force.

AdminBillingOfferEligibility.description: Which partner provider decides eligibility, and that provider's configuration. The provider validates the configuration when the draft is saved and again at publication.

provider.description: Name of a wired eligibility provider.

version.description: Version of the provider's configuration shape.

config.description: The provider's configuration, in the shape that provider defines. The provider validates it when the draft is created and again at publication.

AdminBillingOfferRefusalReason.description:
Why an offer refused a signup. Signups refused because no offer was open are not counted against an offer, so `no_active_offer` never appears here.

- `verification_invalid`: the partner did not verify the signup's link.
- `not_matched`: the verified email could not be matched to one partner company.
- `not_eligible`: the company does not meet the offer's eligibility policy.
- `existing_organization`: another active Bird organization already holds the company's domain.
- `already_claimed`: the company, or the same person, already redeemed this offer.
- `limit_reached`: the offer had reached its redemption cap.

organizations.description: Signups this offer refused for this reason.

AdminBillingOfferPricing.description: The partner price list the offer bills a product from for new redemptions. A draft may name any rate card; publication, and replacement on a published offer, require an active global rate card for that product, not the product default, in effect now and covering the standard list.

organizations.description: Organizations with an active offer rate card that prices from this list.

max_redemptions.description: The most organizations the offer can grant. Null means no cap.

granted_redemptions.description: Organizations granted the offer so far, the count `max_redemptions` limits.

refused_redemptions.description: Signups this offer refused, counted per reason. Signups refused because no offer was open, including after this one closed or was withdrawn, are not counted.

redeem_until.description: When redemption closes. Null for a standing offer, open until it is withdrawn.

pricing.description: The partner price list each covered product bills new redemptions from.

redemptions_by_rate_card.description: Organizations still priced from each partner price list, per product. After a price list is replaced for new redemptions, existing redemptions stay on the list they were granted, so a product can appear with more than one list.

approved_by.description: Staff member who published the offer. Null until it is published.

approved_at.description: When the offer was published. Null until then.

AdminBillingOfferInput.description: A draft offer's terms. A draft admits no one until it is published.

max_redemptions.description: The most organizations the offer can grant. Null means no cap.

redeem_from.description: When signups can start redeeming the offer.

AdminBillingOfferReplacePricing.description: Replaces a product's partner price list for new redemptions. Existing redemptions keep the list they were granted. `from_rate_card_id` must be the offer's current list for the product, so a request made from stale data is refused with a conflict; reload the offer and retry. On a published offer, `to_rate_card_id` must be an active global rate card for the product, not its default, that prices everything the product's standard list prices; a draft accepts any existing rate card, and is checked when the offer is published.

AdminBillingOfferRedemptionOutcome.description:
What the offer decided for the signup.

- `granted`: the organization was admitted and bills from the offer's partner price lists.
- `verification_invalid`: the partner did not verify the signup's link.
- `not_matched`: the verified email could not be matched to one partner company.
- `not_eligible`: the company does not meet the offer's eligibility policy.
- `existing_organization`: another active Bird organization already holds the company's domain.
- `no_active_offer`: the offer closed or was withdrawn while the organization was being created.
- `already_claimed`: the company, or the same person, already redeemed this offer.
- `limit_reached`: the offer had reached its redemption cap.

increment.description: Billing increment, or null for non-session prices.

unit_price.description: Unit price as a decimal string in the rate card's currency (e.g. "0.10").

The first column is the currency (ISO 4217), followed by one column per pricing dimension, an increment column for session-based products, and a final unit price column with the decimal rate in that row's currency. The header row must name every dimension of the product exactly.

unit_price.description: Unit price as a decimal string in the rate card's currency (e.g. "0.10").

increment.description: Billing increment. Send null to clear.

MinimumCommitPeriodType.description: Billing period of the commitment. The `monthly` period means the committed spend applies to each monthly billing period. We charge any shortfall at the end of each month. The `annual` period means the committed spend applies to a single 12-month window starting at `starts_at`. We charge any shortfall once, at the end of that window.

commitment_net.description: Committed NET spend per period (excluding tax) as a decimal string in major currency units.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Always equals the organization's wallet currency.

ends_at.description: Exclusive end date. Null means the commit is open-ended.

commitment_net.description: Committed NET spend per period (excluding tax) as a positive decimal string in major currency units.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must equal the organization's wallet currency.

ends_at.description: Exclusive end date; when set, it must be after `starts_at` and in the future. Required when `period_type` is `annual`, and must then be exactly 12 months after `starts_at` (Bird charges the annual shortfall once, at the end of that window). Only `monthly` commits may omit it to run open-ended.

plan_product_id.description: ID of the plan product to assign to the organization.

reason.description: Audit reason for the plan assignment (stored in the activity record).

commence_on.description:
The day the new plan starts governing. Omit it to take the date the plan ladder
implies: today for a move up, the end of the current period for a move down. Today
commences the plan now; a later date schedules it and charges nothing until that day.
An active zero-cost or unpriced plan can move to a paid plan from an earlier day within the current
UTC month, with no pending cancellation or plan change. The date must be within the current
billing period, except that an initial zero-cost or unpriced period created at immediate enrollment may start after the chosen
day when there are no earlier service plans for that commercial product or any paid plan fees for that commercial product.
Overage must be enabled. All affected usage meters must use SUM aggregation;
source allowances must be finite, and priced source products must have no usage in that window. Neither plan's metered allowances
may have changed since the chosen day. The paid plan must cover every current usage
product and publish overage prices for its metered products. The full new period is charged
now; usage since the chosen day counts toward the paid allowance when billing.
Existing usage charges or invoices in that window block backdating. Other past dates
are rejected with 422. If the fee was already charged during a failed attempt, retrying
the original date and price can recover the assignment after the month changes,
while the current billing period remains active. When the organization already holds a plan,
a date past the end of its current billing period is rejected too, since it would
leave the outgoing plan's renewals unpriced; a first assignment has no period to
bound and accepts any future day.

Naming a date re-anchors the term to it, which is also what makes the change cost a
full new period rather than the difference between the two plans.

It does not apply when the organization already holds the plan being assigned: that
is a reprice, which takes effect at the next renewal, so a date is rejected with 422.

A scheduled change is charged on the day it commences and is not checked for
affordability now. Fund the wallet before that day, or the charge overdraws it.

unit_price.description: Replaces the plan's rate-card price, for this period and every renewal after it. Omit it to resolve the price from the rate card: the organization's own, falling back to the product's list card. This is the amount for the WHOLE period, so on a yearly plan it is the annual figure. Its currency must match the organization's wallet, and a negative amount is rejected with 422.

description.description: A staff note stored on the subscription: the contract this came from, why this price. Not a place to list the entitlements, which are their own records and can be read directly.

outcome.description: Outcome of the assignment. `created` — the organization had no plan and one was created. `upgraded` — the plan change applied immediately. `scheduled` — a downgrade that takes effect at the end of the current billing period. `pending_topup` — the wallet was short and a top-up against the organization's saved card is processing. `requires_topup` — the wallet was short and no saved card is available, so the change is parked until funds arrive. `repriced` — the organization already held this plan and its recurring price was updated to the negotiated rate, effective at the next renewal. `unchanged` — the organization already held this plan at the resolved price; nothing was modified.

pending_operation_id.description: Identifier of the pending upgrade operation. Present for `pending_topup` and `requires_topup`.

shortfall_amount.description: Amount still needed to fund the upgrade. Present for `pending_topup` and `requires_topup`.

BillingPlanChangePreview.description: Quote for a plan change that shows charges and renewal details before the change is applied.

is_upgrade.description: Which way the change moves on the plan ladder: `true` when the target plan ranks above the current one. It does not say whether a charge applies. Read `gross_amount` for that: a change commencing today can owe a charge whichever way it moves, and can owe nothing when the price difference is zero.

currency_code.description: Currency used for all amounts in this preview.

upgrade_charge.description: Net plan charge due today, before tax: the difference between the two plan prices when the term keeps its billing anchor, or the full new period when the change re-anchors. `null` when nothing is charged for the plan today.

tax_rate.description: Decimal VAT/GST rate applied (for example, `0.21`). `null` when `upgrade_charge` is `null`.

overage_charge.description: Gross overage billed for the period this change closes, when it starts a fresh period rather than keeping the current billing anchor. `null` when the anchor is kept or there is no overage to bill.

gross_amount.description: Total charged today: `upgrade_charge` + `tax_amount` + `overage_charge`. `null` when nothing is charged today.

renewal_amount.description: Gross monthly amount for the new plan at next renewal (net plan price + tax).

effective_date.description: When the new plan starts governing. Now for a change that applies immediately, or the end of the current period for one that is deferred; where the operation accepts a requested commencement day, that day.

renewal_date.description: When the period starting at `effective_date` itself renews. A change that keeps the current billing anchor renews at the current period end; one that starts a fresh period renews one full period after `effective_date`.

AdminBillingInvoiceRecoveryCreditReversa.description: One explicitly reviewed credit and reversal in the same wallet and currency. The later debit must exactly cancel the original credit, have a recorded actor and reason, and contain no billable financial lines. Equal competing credits or debits make the pairing ambiguous and stop recovery.

AdminBillingInvoiceRecoverySource.description: One exact historical wallet deduction or an explicitly reviewed overage refund matching selected historical purchases. Refunds appear as separate negative lines, preserve original money and service dates, and require review_reference even for preview. Unrelated credits and possible manual reversals are refused.

snapshot.description: Fingerprint of the original source and reviewed evidence returned by preview. Required unchanged for issuance.

evidence_reference.description: Review record establishing the purchase or overage refund, omission, service dates and historical tax treatment. For a refund, also establish that it has not been reversed.

tax_rate.description: Optional proven historical tax fraction, such as "0" or "0.21". An unrecorded rate may remain unknown; original net, tax and gross stay unchanged. Supplied rates must agree with recorded tax within the rounding bound established by original event counts.

period_start.description: Proven original service start when absent from the source. Use midnight UTC for evidence with date-only precision.

period_end.description: Proven exclusive service end, supplied together with period_start.

AdminBillingInvoiceRecoveryRequest.description: Exact reviewed sources for one organization and currency, across any historical posting months. Issuance never expands this selection.

charge_month.description: Legacy field accepted for compatibility and ignored. Purchases must predate the automatic invoicing boundary and may span posting months. A selected overage refund can post later when it matches those purchases.

review_reference.description: Approval record for this exact batch. Required for issuance and for previews selecting overage refunds or credit reversals.

expected_amount_due.description: Reviewed amount still payable, as a decimal string in currency_code units. Returned by preview and required unchanged for issuance.

credit_reversals.description: Reviewed original overage credits and their exact full manual debit reversals. All credit and reversal identifiers must be distinct across this array and must not appear in sources. Reused identifiers are rejected with 422. Supplying any pair requires review_reference, including for preview. Ambiguous matches are refused; these adjustments are never invoice purchases.

sources.description: Each wallet_transaction_id must be unique within this array. Duplicate identifiers are rejected with 422.

AdminBillingInvoiceRecoverySourceFact.description: Original posting time and signed invoice contribution for a selected wallet source. Purchases are positive; selected overage refunds negate their original net, tax and gross amounts.

net_amount.description: Signed original net amount in currency units, negative for an overage refund.

tax_amount.description: Signed original tax amount in currency units, negative for refunded tax.

gross_amount.description: Signed original gross amount in currency units, negative for an overage refund.

AdminBillingInvoiceRecoveryPreview.description: Read-only recovery findings. A batch with outstanding review requirements cannot be issued.

invoice_date.description: Current proposed issue date, or the saved issue date of an existing matching recovery invoice.

subtotal_net.description: Selected original net amount in currency units.

tax_amount.description: Selected original tax amount in currency units.

total_gross.description: Selected original gross amount in currency units.

amount_due.description: Expected amount payable in currency units. Absent while source evidence is incomplete.

charge_month.description: Legacy field accepted for compatibility and ignored. Purchases must predate the automatic invoicing boundary and may span posting months. A selected overage refund can post later when it matches those purchases.

review_reference.description: Approval record for this exact batch. Required for issuance and for previews selecting overage refunds or credit reversals.

expected_amount_due.description: Reviewed amount still payable, as a decimal string in currency_code units. Returned by preview and required unchanged for issuance.

credit_reversals.description: Reviewed original overage credits and their exact full manual debit reversals. All credit and reversal identifiers must be distinct across this array and must not appear in sources. Reused identifiers are rejected with 422. Supplying any pair requires review_reference, including for preview. Ambiguous matches are refused; these adjustments are never invoice purchases.

snapshot.description: Fingerprint of the original source and reviewed evidence returned by preview. Required unchanged for issuance.

evidence_reference.description: Review record establishing the purchase or overage refund, omission, service dates and historical tax treatment. For a refund, also establish that it has not been reversed.

tax_rate.description: Optional proven historical tax fraction, such as "0" or "0.21". An unrecorded rate may remain unknown; original net, tax and gross stay unchanged. Supplied rates must agree with recorded tax within the rounding bound established by original event counts.

period_start.description: Proven original service start when absent from the source. Use midnight UTC for evidence with date-only precision.

period_end.description: Proven exclusive service end, supplied together with period_start.

AdminBillingInvoiceRecoveryIssueSource.description: One reviewed purchase or matching overage refund with its preview fingerprint and supporting evidence.

AdminBillingInvoiceRecoveryIssueRequest.description: Exact previewed batch approved for issuance, including its unchanged evidence and payable amount.

sources.description: Each wallet_transaction_id must be unique within this array. Duplicate identifiers are rejected with 422.

AdminBillingOpeningInvoiceCreate.description: Request body for issuing an opening invoice against an organization's uninvoiced subscription charges.

invoice_date.description: The invoice date, which also anchors the payment due date. Set it to the day the charges were made, which may be earlier than today. A future date or one earlier than the latest included charge's actual charge date in UTC is rejected with 422. The calendar month it falls in selects which subscription charges the invoice covers. Charge-month invoices select fees charged in that month, including fees for earlier service periods.

AdminCarrierRateTemplate.description: Template identity and current metadata; retirement preserves every revision.

AdminCarrierRateCarrierRole.description: ingress_carrier identifies an incoming carrier; egress_carrier identifies an outgoing carrier in the pinned routing version.

AdminCarrierRateAssignment.description: Commercial source assignment pinned to a template revision.

supplier_account.description: Source supplier account; not inferred from the carrier.

carrier_slug.description: Exact carrier slug in the published routing version.

plan_key.description: Distinct source plan, trunk or service key.

AdminCarrierRateTemplateSummary.description: Current metadata and current assignment summaries without the mapping definition.

AdminCarrierRateFileSlot.description: rates is the primary tariff file; codes is the optional separate number-plan file.

AdminCarrierRateFormat.description: xlsx selects an unencrypted workbook; delimited selects explicitly configured text.

AdminCarrierRateFileFormat.description: Input adapter and explicit text conventions. Legacy XLS and encrypted workbooks are unsupported.

encoding.description: Text encoding: utf-8, utf-16le, utf-16be, windows-1252 or iso-8859-1. Omit for XLSX.

delimiter.description: One comma, semicolon, tab or pipe. Omit for XLSX.

quote.description: Double quote for delimited escaping. Omit for XLSX.

AdminCarrierRateSectionRole.description: rates provides prices; destination_codes and origin_codes supply exact selectors joined to rate sections.

AdminCarrierRateColumn.description: Select exactly one header or one-based position.

header.description: Exact unique header in the final header row.

position.description: One-based column index; requires a section layout signature.

AdminCarrierRatePredicate.description: Exact row exclusion, retained in exclusion counts.

AdminCarrierRateField.description: Tariff field receiving the configured source value. Charges retain exact decimals; period fields are seconds. currency maps to the published currency code; billing_increment uses the declared separator.

AdminCarrierRateMappingMode.description: from_file requires the configured source; fallback_if_missing selects the fallback only for absent values and also checks that available primary and fallback currencies agree. override replaces a source value with explicit evidence. Currency does not support override.

AdminCarrierRateCell.description: Exact metadata cell supplying a value.

sheet.description: Exact workbook sheet, omitted for delimited text.

AdminCarrierRateSource.description: Select exactly one source. No filename or currency-symbol inference is performed.

fixed.description: Explicit value, including an intentional empty string.

context_key.description: Required key in the upload context.

AdminCarrierRateMapping.description: Explicit tariff field source and precedence rule. from_file forbids fallback. fallback_if_missing requires fallback and selects its value only when source is empty. For currency, an available fallback is also validated when source is populated; the two values must agree. Disagreement produces a conflicting_currency issue and an invalid validation result, returned by the validation endpoint with HTTP 200. An absent fallback value is allowed when the primary currency is present. Invalid present values never trigger fallback substitution. override requires fallback and always selects it as the replacement source; currency overrides are forbidden.

AdminCarrierRateSection.description: One bounded source section. Unknown interior rows fail validation; excluded rows still count against scan limits.

key.description: Unique key referenced by joins.

sheet.description: Exact worksheet name; required for XLSX and omitted for delimited input.

header_rows.description: Rows before data, including the header row.

code_separator.description: Explicit separator for lists of codes.

range_separator.description: Explicit separator between same-width digit bounds.

increment_separator.description: Separator between initial and recurring seconds.

empty_area_allowed.description: Whether an explicitly empty area code can accompany a country code.

AdminCarrierRateJoinCardinality.description: one_to_one requires one exact code match; one_to_many expands one rate to multiple exact code matches.

AdminCarrierRateJoin.description: Exact join from a rates section to a destination or origin code section. Unmatched rows are errors.

AdminCarrierRateZeroPolicy.description: allow retains zero rates; reject reports them as validation errors.

AdminCarrierRatePeriodException.description: Exact zone or destination_code override for billing increments.

key.description: Exact zone or destination-code key.

initial_seconds.description: Initial billable period, independent of the rate denominator.

reason.description: Reason retained with overridden source evidence.

AdminCarrierRateDefinition.description: Versioned carrier tariff mapping. Monetary values remain exact decimal strings in their source currency.

files.description: Exactly one rates file and an optional codes file, in either order.

grouping_separator.description: Optional comma, point or space, distinct from the decimal separator.

date_format.description: Explicit Go reference-time pattern, for example 2006-01-02.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone or UTC; Local is unsupported.

zone_aliases.description: Exact source-zone to canonical-zone aliases; no fuzzy matching.

status_mappings.description: Exact tokens mapped to active, delete, blocked or omit.

AdminCarrierRateTemplateDraft.description: Complete replacement definition and assignments for a new immutable revision.

name.description: Staff label for this template.

description.description: Optional staff context.

AdminCarrierRateTemplateRevision.description: Immutable definition and assignments as saved by the recorded staff actor.

AdminCarrierRateTemplateDetail.description: Current template metadata together with the requested immutable revision.

AdminCarrierRateTemplateSave.description: Append a revision only when the current revision still matches.

AdminCarrierRateTemplateClone.description: Clone an explicit historical revision into a new template identity.

name.description: New template label.

AdminCarrierRateTemplateRetire.description: Retire only if the current revision still matches.

AdminCarrierRateTemplatePin.description: Explicit saved template revision; current is never inferred.

AdminCarrierRateValidationMetadata.description: Supply exactly one saved template revision or unsaved definition, with optional upload context.

context.description: Explicit upload values required by the selected mappings.

AdminCarrierRateValidationUpload.description: Metadata first, followed by distinct named rates and optional codes files. Request files are not retained.

rates.description: Primary file. Total rates and codes bytes must not exceed 20 MiB.

codes.description: Separate codes file, only when declared by the definition.

AdminCarrierRateFileEvidence.description: Original file identity, hash and byte count for reproduction.

AdminCarrierRateSectionResult.description: Full encountered row dispositions for one selected section.

AdminCarrierRateLocation.description: Original source location; empty identifiers mean the failure occurred before that location was known.

row.description: One-based row when available; zero for a file-level finding.

column.description: One-based column when available; zero for a row-level finding.

AdminCarrierRateSelector.description: Exact digit selector or inclusive same-width interval; end is omitted for a single prefix and leading zeros are significant.

AdminCarrierRateValueEvidence.description: Original and normalized field values and the rule selecting them.

overwritten.description: Present when a supplied value was replaced, including an empty value.

AdminCarrierRateRecord.description: Bounded normalized preview record. Omitted end dates are open-ended; absent optional charges remain unknown.

recurring_charge.description: Exact source-currency amount; no rounding or currency conversion.

initial_charge.description: Exact source-currency amount; no rounding or currency conversion.

connection_charge.description: Exact source-currency amount; no rounding or currency conversion.

rate_seconds.description: Rate denominator or billing period in seconds; these quantities remain distinct.

initial_seconds.description: Rate denominator or billing period in seconds; these quantities remain distinct.

recurring_seconds.description: Rate denominator or billing period in seconds; these quantities remain distinct.

AdminCarrierRateIssue.description: Validation diagnostic with original source location.

AdminCarrierRateValidation.description: Complete-file validation evidence and bounded preview, never a full tariff deck or approved liability. valid requires complete and no errors. template_revision appears only for saved definitions.

context.description: Upload values supplied to this validation.

max_age_days.description: Freshness policy in days. Pricing operations that depend on this book warn or fail when its active version is older than this.

active_version.description: Version number of the currently active version, or null when no version has been activated yet.

activated_at.description: When the currently active version was activated.

fresh.description: Whether the active version is within the book's freshness policy. False when no version is active.

max_age_days.description: Freshness policy in days. Defaults to 45 when omitted.

AdminInferenceCostMeterKind.description:
Provider usage component priced by the exact deck row.
- `input_tokens`: uncached input tokens.
- `output_tokens`: output tokens.
- `cache_creation_5m_tokens`: input tokens written to the five-minute cache.
- `cache_creation_1h_tokens`: input tokens written to the one-hour cache.
- `cache_read_tokens`: cached input tokens read.
- `web_search_requests`: hosted web searches.

AdminInferenceCostUnitQuantity.description: Number of meter units bought by one unit_cost. Finance supplies an exact power of ten from one through one trillion; this denominator is not a rate or a monetary amount.

dims.description: Exact dimensions of the imported cost row. No wildcard or neighbor fallback.

AdminInferenceCostAdmission.description: Exact Billing cost-book mapping for observed invocation facts. The provider, requested_model, returned_model, request_profile, service_tier and inference_geo values must not contain leading or trailing Unicode whitespace; values are matched without trimming. Maximum input tokens must be at least the minimum; valid_until must be later than valid_from; observed_at must not be in the future. Violations return 422.

provider.description: Exact provider identity used by the invocation owner.

requested_model.description: Exact requested model identifier; no alias expansion.

request_profile.description: Exact versioned request profile, including supported hosted tools.

inference_geo.description: Exact provider-reported inference geography; an explicitly reported empty string is distinct from missing.

source_url.description: Published supplier or approved contract HTTPS URL with a nonempty host and no username or password. Other URI schemes, hostless URLs and embedded credentials are rejected with 422.

minimum_input_tokens.description: Inclusive bound on uncached plus cache-write plus cache-read input tokens.

maximum_input_tokens.description: Inclusive bound on uncached plus cache-write plus cache-read input tokens.

observed_at.description: When the source was observed; must not be later than server time.

valid_until.description: Exclusive effective boundary, strictly later than valid_from.

rates.description: Exactly one row for each of the six meter kinds; duplicate or missing meters return 422.

source_note.description: Free-text provenance note supplied at import, such as the rate load the file came from.

approved_by.description: ID of the admin user who activated this version.

inference.description: Optional immutable inference admissions for this deck. Activation authorizes use only for matching observed invocation facts and the declared half-open effective interval. Omitted on legacy decks.

versions.description: All versions of the book, newest first.

csv.description: The CSV content to import. The header names currency (ISO 4217), every pricing dimension of the product, unit_cost (the decimal cost in that row's currency), and source (the row's provenance). Export writes that order; import accepts any header order. Session-based products may add an optional trailing increment column carrying the carrier's billing increment per row ('{initial_s}/{continuation_s}', blank for per-second rows). Inference exports prepend a separate two-cell record: '#bird-cost-book-inference-v1' followed by the frozen admission array as CSV-escaped JSON. This record is outside the product-dimension namespace. Re-import restores and validates the array against the imported cost rows. An offered metadata record or column must contain exactly one nonempty array; empty, malformed, duplicate or conflicting admission metadata is rejected. Earlier exports with an inference column containing JSON in exactly one data row remain accepted when inference is not a product dimension; otherwise that column remains ordinary dimension data. Do not combine embedded admissions with a nonempty request inference array. Each import creates a new draft version wholesale.

source_note.description: Free-text provenance note for the new version, such as the rate load the file came from.

inference.description: Optional immutable inference admissions for this deck. Activation authorizes use only for matching observed invocation facts and the declared half-open effective interval. May instead be restored from embedded CSV admission metadata; supplying both a nonempty request array and embedded admissions returns 422. Omitted on legacy decks. Session-based decks cannot carry inference admissions. Entries with the same provider, requested model, returned model, request profile, service tier and inference geography must not overlap in both input-token range and effective interval; either violation returns 422.

rows.description: Number of cost rows imported into the new draft version.

unit_cost.description: Unit cost as a decimal string in the row's currency (e.g. "0.0165").

source.description: Carrier or route provenance for the cost row.

increment.description: The carrier's billing increment for session-product cost rows, or null for non-session products and rows costed per exact second.

pct_change.description: Percent change of the unit cost against the matching row in the previously activated version. Null when the prior version has no matching row.

use_increment.description: Whether the book's product is session-based, i.e. whether cost rows may carry a billing increment.

prices.description: All cost rows of the version, with the percent change against the previously activated version.

AdminMarginFloorDial.description: One recorded change to a product's margin floor. Rows are appended, never edited, so the floor a past quote was judged against stays readable.

floor_bps.description: The floor this change sets, in basis points of the offered price.

model_floor_bps.description: The cost model's own floor at the moment the change was asked for. What made the change a concession, or not.

reason.description: Why the floor was moved. Mandatory when the change loosens the model floor, absent otherwise.
reason.example: Matching a competing bid on EU SMS pricing for the Riverstone renewal

status.description: `active` is the current dial; `pending_approval` is waiting on a second signature because it loosens the model floor; `rejected` was declined; `superseded` was replaced by a later change. An `active` dial past its `expires_at` has lapsed and no longer moves the floor.

decided_by.description: The approver who cleared or declined the change. Null until decided, and on a change that never needed approval.

decision_note.example: Approved for this renewal cycle only

expires_at.description: When the dial stops moving the floor. Always set on a concession, because a floor below the model floor has to lapse; optional on a floor at or above the model floor, which may stand until it is replaced.

AdminProductMarginFloor.description: One product's whole floor position: what the cost model says, what an operator dialled on top of it, which of the two is in force, and any change still waiting on a decision.

model_floor_bps.description: The cost model's floor. Null when finance has never set one, in which case every priced line clears the floor.

effective_floor_bps.description: The floor quotes are actually judged against: the dial in force when there is one, else the model floor, else 0.

active_dial.description: The product's current dial. Still reported once it has lapsed, so the operator can see what expired and when. Check `expires_at` against `effective_floor_bps` to tell a live dial from a lapsed one.

pending_dial.description: A requested change waiting on a second signature. Present only for a change that loosens the model floor.

AdminMarginFloorDialCounts.description: The pending floor-change counters for the signed-in staff member. Pending and needs-me are separate because they answer different questions: one is the queue, whoever may clear it, the other is this caller's workload. A caller can never decide a change they requested themselves, and deciding needs the deal-approver grant.

pending_total.description: Floor changes waiting on a second signature, whoever may clear them.

needs_me.description: Pending changes this caller can decide right now.

min_margin_bps.description: Minimum margin in basis points of the offered price. Offers below this floor need a second approver.
Minimum margin in basis points of the offered price.

AdminMarginFloorDialRequest.description: Set a product's margin floor. Raising it, or restoring it to the model floor, takes effect immediately. Lowering it below the model floor is a concession: it needs a reason and an expiry date, and routes to the deal approvers instead.

floor_bps.description: The floor to set, in basis points of the offered price.

reason.description: Why the floor moves. Required when the value is below the model floor.
reason.example: Matching a competing bid on EU SMS pricing for the Riverstone renewal

expires_at.description: When the floor reverts to the model floor. Required when the value is below the model floor, so a concession cannot outlive the deal it was granted for; optional above it, where an omitted date means the floor stands until it is replaced. Must be in the future.

AdminMarginFloorDialDecision.description: The second signature on a floor change that loosens the model floor.

approve.description: True clears the change and puts it in force; false declines it and leaves the previous floor standing.

note.description: What the approver wants on the record. Required when declining.
note.example: Approved for this renewal cycle only

AdminSalesBoundRepairBlockedReason.description:
- `deployment_disabled`: Bound identity repair is disabled in this deployment.
- `writer_unavailable`: The native writer does not report bound repair support.

AdminSalesRecoveryMatchField.description:
- `email`: An exact normalized email matches the retained submission.
- `phone`: An exact normalized phone matches the retained submission.

AdminSalesRecoveryEvidenceKind.description:
Evidence tied to the retained source identity.
- `inbound_email` means retained correspondence for staff review; it does not independently verify identity.
- `verified_account_link` means an Auth-verified inquiry account link.
- `original_submission` is only available for explicit correction of an already-bound demo link, with the source acquisition ID as its reference; it proves the retained submission, not mailbox ownership, identity verification or sending consent.
- `verified_signup_account` means the signup email remains verified by its active account and can be reviewed for the original qualification. Submit the exact `reference` from the recovery response's `evidence` entry whose `kind` is `verified_signup_account` as `evidence_reference`; do not derive it from the email address or user ID.

reference.description: For inbound_email, a message key in this source conversation. For verified_account_link, the user UUID on this source's retained verified account link. For verified_signup_account, the opaque retained verification proof reference for the original qualification; copy this exact value into evidence_reference. For original_submission, this source's acquisition ID. Read the source evidence with its existing access permissions.

AdminSalesRecoveryResumeBlockedReason.description:
- `deployment_disabled`: The requested identity recovery is disabled in this deployment.
- `rejected_source`: The source was rejected.
- `excluded_source`: The source is excluded from CRM delivery.
- `retained_evidence_required`: The original supporting evidence is not retained.
- `original_intent_required`: The original delivery intent is missing.
- `identity_receipt_unavailable`: The original identity receipt cannot currently be inspected.
- `identity_receipt_missing`: The original identity receipt is missing.
- `identity_receipt_expired`: The original identity receipt is outside its recovery window.
- `identity_receipt_mismatch`: The receipt disagrees with the retained source or decision.
- `identity_requires_repair`: The original contact relationship requires repair.
- `identity_erased`: The original identity was erased.
- `identity_unavailable`: An original source identity is unavailable.
- `delivery_identity_requires_repair`: Retained delivery claims disagree with the original contact.
- `legacy_delivery_unconfirmed`: An earlier provider identity operation remains unconfirmed.
- `lifecycle_recovery_required`: This source must resume through its original lifecycle recovery workflow.

AdminSalesRecoveryBlockedReason.description:
- `deployment_disabled`: New identity recovery requests are disabled for this deployment.
- `resolution_recorded`: A resolution is already retained for this source.
- `source_already_linked`: The source already has a CRM lead.
- `rejected_source`: The source was rejected.
- `excluded_source`: The source is excluded from CRM delivery.
- `retained_evidence_required`: Required source evidence is not retained.
- `original_intent_required`: No original delivery intent is retained.
- `lifecycle_recovery_required`: This source requires its lifecycle recovery workflow.
- `crm_identity_conflict`: CRM contact or lead relationships require repair.
- `crm_unavailable`: Current CRM identity evidence is unavailable.
- `delivery_identity_requires_repair`: Retained delivery claims do not permit an available contact selection.
- `verified_signup_required`: The signup requires current verified Auth identity evidence.
- `original_qualification_not_held`: The original signup qualification is not held for identity recovery.

AdminCrmPersonIdentifier.description: CRM person TypeID. Responses return the TypeID. A bare UUID is still accepted as input until the CRM typed-ID transition closes.

AdminCrmLeadIdentifier.description: CRM lead TypeID. Responses return the TypeID. A bare UUID is still accepted as input until the CRM typed-ID transition closes.

AdminSalesBoundIdentityRepair.description: Exact old and explicitly selected replacement relationships. The previous IDs must match current_company_id, current_person_id and current_lead_id from the same recovery view. The outer selected_person_id must equal person_id. Existing records are never merged or deleted. When create_lead is true, a new lead is created for this same retained source and lead_id and lead_revision must be omitted. previous_company_id is the submission's current_company_id; omit it only when that source has no company binding, because the CRM lead can have a different current company and previous_lead_revision fences that record. previous_person_id can differ from the CRM lead's current person, and previous_lead_id is the source binding being corrected. company_id is the selected replacement lead's company, or an explicitly selected existing company for a new lead; a relationship or existence mismatch returns 409. person_id is the selected exact-email candidate and must equal the replacement lead's person. lead_id must come from that person's current recovery candidates, belong to company_id and differ from previous_lead_id; equal IDs return 400. When create_lead is omitted or false, both lead_id and lead_revision are required; omitting either returns 400 Bad Request. Stale previous IDs or native record revisions return 409 Conflict; refresh the recovery view and review the current relationships before retrying.

create_lead.description: Explicitly create the replacement lead using the retained submission and selected person/company.

previous_lead_revision.description: Current native revision of previous_lead_id, read from the currently linked CRM lead.

lead_revision.description: Native revision of lead_id from the current recovery candidate lead. Omitted when create_lead is true.

person_revision.description: Native revision of person_id from the current recovery candidate.

AdminSalesRecoveryRelationship.description: Reviewed association to an existing person or a separate person using the permitted source fields.

AdminSalesRecoveryState.description:
- `accepted`: The review is retained and its identity decision awaits application.
- `resuming`: The identity decision is applied; original CRM delivery is still pending.
- `completed`: The original CRM delivery receipt and all retained conversation history are confirmed.
- `conflict`: Delivery is held until the original relationship can be reviewed again.

AdminSalesRecoveryConflictReason.description:
- `crm_identity_unavailable`: The original CRM identity is unavailable.
- `crm_identity_changed`: The retained identity relationship changed.
- `crm_identity_receipt_expired`: The committed identity receipt expired before recovery completed.
- `original_intent_required`: The original manual delivery intent is missing.

bound_repair.description: Immutable original reviewed repair choice; a created lead is reported separately in lead_id once applied.

reason.description: Recorded review reason, or null when inbound-email evidence requires content permission the caller does not have.

AdminSalesLifecycleRecoveryState.description:
Current progress of the original sales decision.
- `pending` means the original CRM change is awaiting confirmation.
- `prospect_pending` means the original qualification is preparing its contact and lead.
- `resume_pending` means a reviewed resumption has been accepted and awaits completion.
- `completed` means the original CRM outcome is confirmed.
- `conflict` means the original decision needs staff review.

identity_resolution_id.description: Recorded identity resolution for this exact source. The enclosing lifecycle blocked_reason reports whether it is acceptable; copy it unchanged into the resumption's members.

AdminSalesLifecycleOperationState.description:
Evidence for the original qualification's CRM effect.
- `not_attempted` means no original write attempt was recorded.
- `absent` means the exact original effect is not recorded; the remaining source and access conditions still determine whether it can resume.
- `applied` means the exact original effect has been confirmed.
- `expired` means its result is no longer retained and cannot safely be repeated.
- `erased` means the source identity or affected record has been erased.
- `unreconciled` means available evidence cannot establish the original outcome.
- `unavailable` means native CRM writes are unavailable in this deployment, so the original outcome cannot be inspected; restore native CRM before reviewing again.
- `preconditions_changed` means the lead no longer matches the original decision's required state or ownership.

AdminSalesLifecycleRecoveryBlockedReason.description:
Reason the original qualification cannot currently resume. Absent when resumption is available.

- `deployment_disabled`: qualification recovery is disabled for this deployment.
- `original_members_changed`: the current review no longer contains exactly the original source members; review the current sources again.
- `member_requires_separate_review`: an original source no longer satisfies the common identity or eligibility checks and needs separate review.
- `identity_resolution_requires_review`: a saved contact association conflicts with the current verified signup evidence and needs review.
- `identity_resolution_required`: an original source has no bound lead or saved contact association; save its association first.
- `original_qualification_not_held`: the original qualification is not in the held conflict state required for resumption.
- `original_qualification_busy`: the original qualification still has an active execution lease; inspect again after it settles.
- `verified_signup_required`: current verified signup evidence is required before resumption.
- `legacy_operation_unreconciled`: an earlier qualification attempted a legacy CRM write whose outcome has not been reconciled; another write cannot be authorized from the retained evidence.
- `original_operation_erased`: the original native CRM operation was erased and cannot authorize resumption.
- `original_operation_expired`: the original native CRM receipt expired; its prior outcome cannot be established from that receipt.
- `original_operation_unreconciled`: the original native CRM outcome cannot be confirmed; resumption cannot authorize a replacement write.
- `original_operation_unavailable`: the original native CRM outcome cannot be inspected because native CRM writes are unavailable in this deployment; restore native CRM before reviewing again.
- `original_operation_preconditions_changed`: the current lead status, reason, or owner no longer matches the original operation's preconditions; resumption cannot overwrite those changes.

admission_state.description: Confirms acceptance of this exact reviewed request; completion is reported separately in state.

failure.description: Current hold or failure message for the original command; absent when no message is retained.

current_resumption_id.description: Current accepted resumption for the original decision. May differ from this receipt after a later reviewed resumption.

AdminSalesLifecycleRecovery.description: Recovery state of a lifecycle command. owner_id is the original intended CRM owner, as a member TypeID; resumption does not replace this owner with the reviewing staff member.

failure.description: Current hold or failure message for the original command; absent when no message is retained.

AdminSalesAcquisitionRecovery.description: Recovery review for one source. CRM identifiers are TypeIDs. current_company_id is the source's current company binding, to copy to bound_repair.previous_company_id when present; it is omitted when the source has no company binding. current_person_id and current_lead_id are the current person and lead bindings, to copy to bound_repair.previous_person_id and bound_repair.previous_lead_id; both are present when can_repair_bound_link is true. resume_person_id is the original contact from the retained receipt or the original existing-contact selection, omitted when the original separate-person decision has not yet created a contact.

can_repair_bound_link.description: An already-bound demo link may be explicitly reviewed for correction. This is not permission to send or verification of mailbox ownership.

can_resume.description: Whether the held resolution can resume its original identity decision after current evidence and contact checks. This does not confirm CRM delivery.

resume_identity_pending.description: The original identity decision has not yet been applied. Resuming retries that same decision against the reviewed contact state; a separate-person decision may create its originally authorized contact.

AdminSalesIdentityResolutionCreate.description: When `evidence_kind` is `verified_signup_account`, copy `lifecycle_command_id` from `lifecycle.command_id` in this acquisition's recovery response. It identifies the original qualification being resolved. Omit it for inquiry delivery recovery. `selected_person_id` is required when binding an existing exact-email person and omitted when creating a separate person; for a bound repair it must equal `bound_repair.person_id`.

excluded_source_fields.description: Excluded phone remains in the immutable submission but cannot match, create or update a person or become a durable person claim.

evidence_reference.description: The retained evidence reference returned by the recovery view. For verified_signup_account, copy the exact reference from the evidence entry with that kind; do not derive a value from the email address or user ID. For original_submission, use this source's acquisition ID.

identity_resolution_id.description: Exact identity resolution shown for this source in the reviewed qualification.

AdminSalesLifecycleResumptionCreate.description: Copy `command_id` from the `lifecycle` section of the reviewed identity recovery response. It identifies the original qualification to resume.

expected_command_revision.description: Exact `command_revision` from that same `lifecycle` section. A changed command is stale and requires a fresh review.

expected_recovery_revision.description: Qualification recovery revision from the lifecycle section of the reviewed source; the source identity recovery revision is not interchangeable.

members.description: Complete set of source records shown for the original decision. Omitting a source or changing its reviewed identity resolution prevents resumption.

AdminSalesReopeningBlockedReason.description:
Reason the current rejection cannot be reopened; absent when the review permits reopening.
- `fresh_inbound_required`: no retained inbound evidence is newer than the latest rejection; wait for fresh inbound intent.
- `lifecycle_unsettled`: a related lifecycle command still has an unsettled outcome; reconcile it before reopening.
- `review_all_rejected_sources`: the review does not contain a current rejection for every grouped source; review the complete source group.
- `source_restricted`: a source is excluded, suppressed, handed off or belongs to a banned organization; resolve the restriction before reviewing again.
- `native_crm_required`: the native CRM writer or required reopening capability is unavailable; restore it before retrying the review.
- `source_task_reopening_unavailable`: source-only task reopening is not enabled in this deployment; wait for a compatible deployment to enable it.
- `lead_identity_changed`: grouped sources point to different CRM leads; review their identity links before reopening.
- `native_revision_unavailable`: the linked lead has no usable native revision to fence the write; restore a current native CRM record before reviewing again.
- `lead_status_changed`: the linked lead is no longer in the rejected status; inspect its current state instead of reopening this rejection.
- `review_status_unavailable`: the native CRM catalog has no New lead status to target; restore that status before reviewing again.

AdminSalesReopeningEvidenceKind.description: Retained evidence accepted by the current reopening review.

channel.description: Retained inbound channel.

AdminSalesRejectionHistory.description: `reopened_by` identifies the lifecycle command that completed the reopening, not the staff user.

AdminSalesLifecycleState.description: Pending changes are still being reconciled; a conflict needs staff attention.

reason.description: Recorded reopening reason, or null when shared Inbox email evidence requires content permission the caller does not have.

history.description: The latest retained rejection generations, newest first.

expected_recovery_revision.description: Copy recovery_revision from the current reopening review for this acquisition. Submit it with an evidence_kind and evidence_reference pair from that same review.

evidence_kind.description: Copy kind from the selected entry in the reopening review's evidence list. Use the reference from that same entry as evidence_reference.

evidence_reference.description: Copy reference from the same reopening review evidence entry as evidence_kind. The pair must still be present in the current review when submitted.

AdminSalesProspectDecisionAction.description:
- `qualify`: create or reuse a CRM lead and assign its owner.
- `reject`: retain the prospect in review history without qualification.

reason.description: Optional explanation for rejection.

owner_id.description: Required CRM member for qualification, as a member TypeID or the bare UUID accepted until the CRM typed-ID transition closes.

entry_point_id.description: Optional compatibility value; must match the CRM source derived from the prospect signup or demo request.

action.description: Staff decision, qualify, reject or explicit reopen.

state.description: Reconciliation state, pending, completed or conflict.

owner_id.description: CRM member TypeID of the owner chosen for a qualification. A legacy stored value that is not a UUID is returned unchanged.

crm_lead_id.description: CRM lead TypeID. A legacy stored value that is not a UUID is returned unchanged.

AdminSalesProspectVerdict.description: Good means sales should pursue the prospect; Bad means research established a poor fit. Insufficient information means research could not establish enough reliable facts to decide.

period_start.description: First UTC day represented by the daily series, or the requested start when the range is too long for daily series.

period_end.description: End of the daily range. The supplied created_to date ends at the following midnight; otherwise the current UTC day is partial.

daily_complete.description: Whether the daily series cover the full selected arrival-date range. False without created_from or when more than 90 daily buckets would be needed. Totals always cover all matching arrivals.

total.description: All visible arrivals matching the active filters, before pagination.

good.description: Matching arrivals with a current readable Good verdict.

bad.description: Matching arrivals with a current readable Bad verdict.

insufficient_information.description: Matching arrivals whose current readable verdict needs more information.

queued.description: Matching arrivals whose verified assessment owner has admitted queued research.

processing.description: Matching arrivals whose verified assessment owner has admitted research with an active lease.

total_daily.description: The total count by UTC arrival day, beginning at period_start. Empty for ranges longer than 90 days.

good_daily.description: The good count by UTC arrival day, beginning at period_start. Empty for ranges longer than 90 days.

bad_daily.description: The bad count by UTC arrival day, beginning at period_start. Empty for ranges longer than 90 days.

insufficient_information_daily.description: The insufficient information count by UTC arrival day, beginning at period_start. Empty for ranges longer than 90 days.

queued_daily.description: The queued count by UTC arrival day, beginning at period_start. Empty for ranges longer than 90 days.

revision.description: Immutable SHA-256 identity of the configured prompt text.

research_prompt.description: Prompt instructions saved or used for live research. Load into the editor and save to restore.

created_at.description: First recorded time for this distinct prompt. Restoring a previous prompt does not change this timestamp.

created_by_user_id.description: Staff editor when known. Absent for the built-in prompt or legacy settings without attribution.

prospect_id.description: One retained prospect to research using the proposed prompt.

research_prompt.description: Proposed instructions for this test only. They are not saved or published.

AdminSalesProspectPromptTestHeartbeat.description: The test is still connected. This event makes no claim about research progress.

AdminSalesAIOutputKind.description:
Retained output owner.
- `research_assessment`: Prospect research assessment published by a background research run.
- `research_prompt_test`: Candidate assessment from an explicit manual prompt test; does not publish or replace the saved assessment and is not a customer outcome.
- `meeting_preparation`: Private meeting brief from a meeting-preparation attempt; does not prove booking or attendance.

attempt.description: Producing meeting-preparation attempt; absent for research.

research_run_id.description: Exact research execution; absent for meeting preparation.

output_revision.description: Digest of the exact successful owner output and its revision identity; never its body.

AdminSalesAIJudgment.description: Explicit staff judgment of one completed retained output; independent of approval and delivery.

AdminSalesAIReviewReason.description: Optional stated reason for the output judgment; absence means not recorded.

AdminSalesAIOutputReview.description: A retained judgment of an exact output. For research assessments and prompt tests, source_id identifies the canonical research subject and can differ from the requested thread_id. For meeting preparation, source_id identifies the requested conversation.

rubric_version.description: Explicit usefulness rubric version. A review does not approve or execute an action.

actor_id.description: Staff member who submitted this review. Absent after that identity is erased.

reviewable.description: Whether new reviews are admitted by this deployment; current staff and output authority are still required. Existing reviews remain readable while publication is disabled.

rubric_version.description: Explicit usefulness rubric version. A review does not approve or execute an action.

review.description: Latest retained review by revision. Absent when this output has no retained review.

AdminSalesAssessmentSummary.description: Research progress and the current AI verdict. The verdict is omitted when no current usable result exists, including research without a completed result, stale or legacy results, and unavailable linked assessment evidence. A failed run does not produce a Bad verdict.

state.description:
Research work state: not_scheduled when no work exists, paused when work
is outside the active rollout or has not been admitted, queued while
waiting to retry, collecting while gathering evidence, assessing during
AI research, ready after completion, failed after research cannot
complete, or unavailable when research or its result cannot be used.
State describes progress independently of verdict; paused or failed work
can retain a current verdict from a completed run.

verdict.description: Current usable AI verdict. Omitted when no result exists, the result is stale or from a legacy policy, or linked assessment evidence is unavailable. A ban does not by itself remove an existing verdict.

explanation.description: Short AI explanation of the current verdict. Omitted when the verdict is absent, the result has no explanation, or the prospect is banned.

assessed_at.description: Time the stored result was assessed, including a stale or legacy result. Omitted when no stored result exists.

eligible_at.description: Earliest research eligibility time for scheduled work. Omitted when no research work exists.

stale.description: The stored result no longer matches the current research request or linked evidence. A stale result has no verdict or recommendation.

banned.description: Sales exclusion or an organization ban prevents a recommendation. An existing current verdict can remain visible.

recommended.description: A current Good result eligible for sales consideration. Does not create a lead.

prompt_revision.description: Exact configured prompt used for this verdict. Omitted for results recorded before prompt attribution and when no usable verdict is returned.

output_review.description: Present only for the candidate `assessment` when its exact output has a retained successful prompt-test run identity. The target kind is `research_prompt_test`; it does not review the live `current_assessment`.

subject_id.description: Current canonical research subject resolved from the selected prospect.

current_assessment.description: Authoritative live research result read after the test finishes.

assessment.description: Transient candidate result. This does not replace the live verdict or create a lead.

prompt_revision.description: SHA-256 of the normalized proposed prompt evaluated in this test.

model.description: Configured research model used for this test.

AdminSalesProspectPromptTestError.description: The test could not finish. No candidate verdict is available.

message.description: A safe explanation of the failure that does not reveal prospect evidence or provider diagnostics.

AdminSalesProspectPromptTestEvent.description: One research test event. The event name identifies its payload: heartbeat carries an empty object, complete carries the transient research result, and error carries a safe failure message with no candidate result.

revision.description: SHA-256 identity of the exact configured prompt. Send as expected_revision when saving.

research_prompt.description: Instructions used for subsequent prospect research.

default_research_prompt.description: Built-in instructions available when resetting the prompt.

updated_at.description: Time the saved prompt last changed. Absent when no prompt has been saved.

updated_by_user_id.description: Staff user who last changed the saved prompt. Absent for changes made before editor attribution was recorded.

updated_by_email.description: Current email of the last editor, when available.

research_prompt.description: Instructions for subsequent research. Existing verdicts remain unchanged.

expected_revision.description: Current prompt revision read by the editor. A changed revision returns 409. Omission preserves compatibility with older clients without concurrent-edit protection.

AdminAcquisitionKind.description: The event that created this acquisition.

AdminAcquisitionConsent.description: Whether valid consented attribution was present at acquisition.

AdminAcquisitionDeliveryStatus.description: CRM delivery state. Failed inquiries retry daily until expiry; not_applicable covers signups and excluded inquiries.

platform.description: Advertising platform supplied with the touch or derived from paid-source and native campaign metadata during capture.

account_id.description: Native advertising account captured with the attributed visit.

ad_id.description: Native ad identifier, scoped by platform and account.
