DemoConversationStatus.description: `open` is the initial state after acceptance. `qualifying` gathers demo requirements. `question` awaits the requester's question. `handoff` stops automation and leaves the conversation with sales.

source.description: Whether the organization was created during continuation or explicitly selected afterward. Neither value independently assigns acquisition revenue credit.

organization.description: Omitted until an authorized organization is explicitly associated.

prospect_decision_available.description: Whether current source relationships support a new manual decision, independently of research availability. Present on the prospect review list and individual signup or inquiry reads. Permission, exclusion and decision rules still apply when submitted.

sales_rejected.description: Whether Sales explicitly rejected this prospect. Present on the prospect review list and individual signup or inquiry reads.

source_detail.description: Page or campaign submitted with a sales inquiry. This contact-form field is distinct from consented browser attribution.

business_email.description: Email domain is outside the personal-provider list; this does not verify the company.

crm_lead_id.description: CRM lead TypeID. A legacy stored value that is not a UUID is returned unchanged.

crm_person_id.description: CRM person TypeID. A legacy stored value that is not a UUID is returned unchanged.

demo_conversation_status.description: Conversation state on an individual acquisition read. Omitted from list responses and when no unexpired demo conversation is available.

demo_phone_suppressed.description: Whether automated phone follow-up has stopped. Populated only on an individual acquisition read with an unexpired demo conversation.

inquiry_link.description: Verified inquiry identity and optional organization association. Present only on an individual, retained inquiry read after authentication. Omission does not establish a customer association. This relationship does not assign founding campaign credit.

duplicate_key.description: Opaque key for grouping message copies with the same content and structured participants, including copies from different mailboxes. Requires admin:crm read access, like the message content. Treat the key as opaque.

AdminSalesMailboxStatus.description: Connection state. `active` enables synchronization and sending, subject to staff access and send checks; it does not guarantee that synchronization is complete. `reconnect_required` means Google authorization was rejected, so synchronization and new sends require the owner to complete a new OAuth connection attempt. `disconnected` means the owner disconnected the mailbox or lost eligible staff access; stored credentials are removed and synchronization and new sends stop. To connect again, restore eligible staff access if needed and complete a new OAuth connection attempt. Retained correspondence remains available through the message-summary and content-reveal permissions in all three states.

reference.description: Echo as sender_reference with the selected channel in shared reply or template-send requests. A changed sender is rejected so the client can refresh the catalog.

shared_senders.description: Available shared senders. Echo the selected reference as sender_reference in a shared reply or template-send request. Unavailable channels are omitted.

pending.description: Another shared reply or recent Gmail send currently prevents a new Gmail submission for this contact. This does not block shared replies or saving drafts. Unknown Gmail outcomes do not hold this admission guard.

activity_version.description: Snapshot of contact activity. Keep this version while drafting and echo it to mail-send, shared reply or template-send requests. Omitted when no eligible contact identity exists. E01009 requires refreshing and reviewing the conversation before a new send.

AdminSalesMailSend.description: Send either a new email with subject or a reply with reply_to. Replies use the retained subject, prefixed with Re: unless it already begins with that prefix (case-insensitive).

signature_hash.description: Signature version reviewed before sending. Required for new sends; may be omitted only when replaying a send accepted before signature support.

reply_draft_id.description: Optional declared AI draft source. Send admission validates the same conversation and channel and records the accepted draft attempt and body match when available. This does not imply sending or delivery; missing optional capture remains unknown.

activity_version.description: Echo activity_version from the compose response loaded when drafting. On E01009, refresh the conversation, review new activity and submit with a new idempotency key.

subject.description: Subject for a new email. Omit when reply_to is provided.

reply_to.description: Retained message to reply to. Omit subject. The reply uses the retained subject, prefixed with Re: unless it already begins with that prefix (case-insensitive), and retains the source threading headers.

AdminSalesMailSendReceiptState.description: queued awaits dispatch for up to five minutes, then is cancelled if it has not started; dispatching has been claimed and may be submitting to Gmail. provider_accepted means Gmail acknowledged the send and local conversation handoff is pending. unknown means submission may have succeeded; reconciliation continues without resending for up to 24 hours after dispatch begins. Time spent queued before dispatch does not count toward this deadline. Poll getAdminSalesMailSend while in these states. completed means Gmail accepted the send or it was verified in Sent mail, and local conversation handoff finished; it does not mean the recipient received it. Sent history is captured by mailbox sync. failed means Gmail explicitly rejected submission; cancelled means submission was prevented before calling Gmail. unconfirmed means mailbox access was removed or the 24-hour reconciliation deadline passed; the email may have been sent, so check Gmail Sent before deliberately starting a new message. erased means customer erasure removed the payload. completed, failed, cancelled, unconfirmed and erased are terminal; none automatically resends an email.

AdminSalesMailSendReceipt.description: Durable Gmail send outcome. The optional message_id identifies the exact retained Sent message to use as reply_to for a follow-up; it is omitted until captured or when no longer available to this conversation.

signature_hash.description: Signature version reviewed before sending. Retained with a pending send for safe retries.

reply_draft_id.description: Optional declared AI draft source. Send admission validates the same conversation and channel and records the accepted draft attempt and body match when available. This does not imply sending or delivery; missing optional capture remains unknown.

week_start.description: Monday 00:00 UTC that starts the week.

email.description: Address of the seller's most recently updated mailbox.

from.description: Start of the first returned week.

to.description: Exclusive end of the counted range.

sellers.description: Sellers with at least one outbound copy, ordered by total descending.

AdminSalesMailboxReadiness.description: Your current ability to connect a work mailbox. Eligible permits connecting or reconnecting; verify_work_email requires verifying your work address; access_repair requires help restoring mailbox access; unavailable means mailbox configuration is unavailable. Connection status is reported separately.

readiness.description:
The accepted task host’s current ability to use Calendar.

- `eligible` means the host can use an active Calendar connection.
- `verify_work_email` means the host must verify their work address.
- `access_repair` means the host’s work identity or task-handover permission needs repair.
- `unavailable` means Calendar configuration or the accepted booking context is unavailable.

connections.description: Active Calendar connections for the accepted host. Empty unless readiness is eligible.

AdminSalesCalendarObservationMeetStatus.description:
Google's conference-creation status, separate from the Calendar operation result.

- `pending` means Google is still creating the conference link.
- `success` means Google created the conference link.
- `failure` means conference creation failed. It does not mean the Calendar booking failed; inspect the operation state separately.

recovered.description: True when this receipt was recovered by checking the exact Google event after an uncertain operation result.

start_at.description: When booking or rescheduling, start must be strictly after the server time and no more than 366 days in the future.

end_at.description: When booking or rescheduling, end must be strictly after start_at and no more than eight hours after it.

time_zone.description: Recognized IANA time zone name or UTC. The server-local zone name Local is not accepted.

attested.description: Confirm that this buyer agreed to the selected meeting time.

previous_operation_id.description: Exact preceding operation; required for changes and replacing a cancelled current booking.

expected_etag.description: Exact quoted Google event ETag from the current review; required for reschedule and cancellation.

AdminSalesCalendarState.description:
State of this meeting operation, separate from the current meeting and attendee responses. A reason can accompany queued, dispatching, unknown or refused operations; it is absent after an applied result.

- `queued` means the request is accepted and awaits current permission and availability checks. Poll this operation; do not submit a replacement.
- `dispatching` means the operation is committed for delivery to Google. Its result is not yet confirmed; it may retain an earlier retry reason. Keep polling the same operation.
- `unknown` means Google may have applied the operation. Exact-event reconciliation continues; do not create another request to resolve the uncertainty.
- `applied` means Google confirmed this operation. Inspect the current meeting before making another change; this receipt does not establish attendance.
- `refused` means this operation was rejected. Review its reason and obtain a fresh meeting review before submitting a corrected request. An existing meeting is unchanged by a refused change.

AdminSalesCalendarReason.description:
Why an operation is waiting, uncertain or refused. Dispatching can retain the earlier queued retry reason while delivery is being confirmed. Absent after an applied result.

Queued operations retry their current checks; keep polling the same operation.

- `calendar_access_unavailable` means the host’s current Calendar access could not be checked.
- `predecessor_unavailable` means the earlier meeting could not be checked.
- `availability_unavailable` means the requested time’s availability could not be checked.
- `admission_unavailable` means current booking permission could not be checked.

Refused operations need a fresh review before a corrected request.

- `review_expired` means the reviewed request expired before delivery.
- `calendar_grant_changed` means the host’s Google connection changed after review.
- `predecessor_changed` means the earlier meeting no longer matches the reviewed request.
- `slot_unavailable` means the selected time is no longer available.
- `admission_changed` means current permission or booking context no longer permits the request.
- `provider_refused` means Google rejected the requested operation.

Unknown operations may already have changed Google. Keep polling the original operation rather than submitting a replacement.

- `event_identity_conflict` means an existing Google event conflicts with the requested event identity.
- `provider_outcome_unknown` means Google may have applied the operation but its result could not be confirmed.
- `provider_event_mismatch` means Google’s response does not match the retained request.
- `reconciliation_access_unavailable` means the original Google account is unavailable for checking the result.
- `provider_observation_unavailable` means the exact Google event could not be read to confirm the result.
- `provider_event_changed` means the exact Google event no longer matches the retained request.
- `reconciliation_required` means repeated uncertain results require continued reconciliation at a reduced retry rate.

cancelled.description: Whether the exact event was cancelled when last successfully inspected.

AdminSalesCalendarConnectionState.description:
Readiness of this account's Calendar connection for new meeting work.

- `active` means Calendar is enabled with the required Google scopes. Booking still checks current host eligibility and availability.
- `disabled` means Calendar use was disabled for this connection. Complete fresh Calendar consent to enable it again.
- `needs_consent` means the current Google grant lacks required Calendar scopes. Complete explicit Calendar consent; Gmail consent alone is insufficient.
- `reconnect_required` means the credential or connected work identity needs repair. Reconnect Calendar with the current work account.
- `disconnected` means the shared Google grant is disconnected or awaiting revocation. Complete fresh consent after disconnect reconciliation finishes.
- `unavailable` means Calendar is enabled for this connection but new Calendar work is disabled for the service. Wait for the service to be enabled; another consent attempt does not resolve this state.

revision.description: Current shared Google grant revision. Send it as expected_revision when disconnecting this Google account.

generation.description: Current Calendar enablement generation. Send it as expected_generation when disabling Calendar for this connection.

mail_connected.description: This Google connection also serves your work mailbox.

last_error.description: Latest connection problem. With state disconnected, revocation_unconfirmed means Google revocation is still being retried; local access is disabled and fresh consent remains unavailable until revocation is confirmed.

readiness.description:
Your current ability to connect a work Calendar. Connection status is reported separately.

- `eligible` means you can connect or reconnect Calendar.
- `verify_work_email` means you must verify your work address; connections are returned empty until then.
- `access_repair` means your work identity or task-handover permission needs repair.
- `unavailable` means Calendar configuration or the Calendar service is unavailable.

connections.description: Your Google connections. Empty while readiness is verify_work_email; this does not establish that no connection exists.

html.description: HTML signature configured for this mailbox in Gmail.

hash.description: Signature version to include when sending the reviewed reply.

AdminSalesSignupWorkStateFilter.description: Signup work population selected before pagination.

AdminSalesSignupWorkOwnerState.description: Initiating staff user confirmed, multiple possible initiators, or insufficient evidence.

AdminSalesSignupWorkState.description: Known unanswered inbound, currently verified clear, or unavailable evidence. Waiting may retain a known fact while freshness is unavailable.

name.description: Retained signup contact name.

email.description: Retained signup contact email.

owner_user_id.description: Staff user who initiated accepted outreach, only when ownership is assigned.

owner_email.description: Staff directory email identifying the initiating seller, including former staff when retained. Absent when display enrichment is unavailable.

outreach_at.description: Retained provider time of the first known target outreach. Absent when provider evidence is unavailable.

latest_inbound_at.description: Latest retained classified customer inbound in the known outreach interval.

latest_outbound_at.description: Latest retained provider timestamp of an outbound to this exact signup target.

waiting_since.description: First known unanswered inbound after outreach. Absent when that interval cannot be established.

last_activity_at.description: Latest retained work activity, which may include an accepted outreach intent.

unavailable_reason.description: Empty when current source evidence is verified; otherwise the reason current or clear cannot be certified.

observed_at.description: Last complete or explicitly unavailable work observation.

valid_until.description: Current evidence freshness deadline, when established.

discovery_complete.description: A recent full accepted-target traversal completed.

history_complete.description: Historical accepted-target evidence has complete retained coverage.

source_complete.description: The known population has current identity and mailbox evidence. Assessed only when include_total is true; false also means this population-wide check was not requested.

count_exact.description: True only when include_total is true and the requested total covers the complete selected population. False means total is unavailable or was not requested.

observed_at.description: Last discovery observation, when available.

traversed_at.description: Last complete accepted-target traversal, when available.

AdminSalesDemandMilestone.description:
Milestones use retained evidence within each arrival's observation window.
Missing or unsupported evidence remains unknown.

- acknowledged: A confirmed shared-channel message whose intent is neither a
  staff reply nor an AI reply or follow-up, excluding handoff notices. Its time
  is the first confirmation observed by the owning send flow, not delivery.
- response: A confirmed shared-channel staff reply, AI reply or AI follow-up,
  or a provider-sent connected-mail message for the exact source. Shared-channel
  timing uses first confirmation; connected mail uses the provider send time.
- delivery_confirmed: An explicit delivered event matched by message reference
  and channel to a shared-channel response. Provider acceptance is insufficient.
- buyer_reply: A received, source-correlated SMS or WhatsApp message, or a
  connected-mail reply with retained direct ancestry and buyer classification.
  Shared-inbox email and voice activity do not establish this milestone.
- qualified: A native Qualified status transition attributed to the source,
  or its committed agent qualification effect. Current status alone is insufficient.
- opportunity: A committed agent pursuit effect linking the source to a native
  opportunity, including an existing opportunity. It does not prove a new deal or win.
- help_accepted: A retained human handover acceptance event for an exact task and
  request tied to the source. A handover request, task completion or booked meeting
  alone is insufficient.
- production_email: The linked organization's retained non-onboarding accepted
  Email message evidence. Available only for signup cohorts; it does not prove delivery.
- provider_funded: An actual provider-funded wallet posting for the explicitly
  linked organization, independently of plan selection. Requires a generation
  created with include_funding and current Finance read permission.

- agreement_signed: An immutable execution with a recorded signing time,
  already recorded by the activity cutoff. Requires an exact prior source
  pursuit and captured opportunity-to-deal link at signing, with the same
  retained organization. External executions are staff-recorded evidence.
  Available only with include_commercial and current CRM, Deals and Contracts
  read permissions.
- billing_adopted: Explicit Contracts adoption of an exact retained version,
  with the same association at adoption time. Does not claim billing application,
  payment or revenue. Available only with include_commercial and current CRM,
  Deals and Contracts read permissions.

- billing_applied: Billing's first recorded successful application of an exact
  contract version and intent revision, confirmed after pricing, regional wallet
  and Global terms acknowledgement. Forward-recorded capture can omit legacy or
  mixed-writer applications; it is not a first-ever claim. Does not establish
  product usage, payment or revenue. Requires include_commercial and current
  CRM, Deals and Contracts read permissions.

The observed time is the earliest retained qualifying evidence in the window,
not a lifetime-first event. Selecting a milestone unavailable for the generation
returns 422.

AdminSalesDemandObservationState.description:
Evidence for a milestone within an arrival’s observation window.
- `observed`: a retained authoritative event establishes the milestone.
- `not_observed`: provider funding only; complete history across all relevant regions establishes no qualifying funding in the window.
- `unknown`: retained evidence does not establish the milestone or a complete negative result. Missing, unavailable and incomplete histories remain unknown, including non-funding milestones.

AdminSalesDemandMaturity.description: Defaults to all, including arrivals whose observation horizon is incomplete. Mature selects arrivals with a complete observation horizon; immature selects arrivals still within that horizon. This filter changes the population used by counts and rows.

AdminSalesDemandState.description: Pending is queued for capture; building is collecting or waiting for evidence; ready has a completed observation cohort. Stale requires a replacement because retained sources, identity, or the calculation version changed. Failed cannot complete; reason cohort_limit means the arrival population exceeded 100,000. Pending and building do not mean an empty population.

reason.description: Empty when no reason applies. regional_queue_pending and regional_evidence_pending indicate incomplete regional work; evidence_unavailable indicates a retryable evidence-owner failure. source_changed or calculation_changed requires a replacement generation. cohort_limit means the requested cohort exceeded 100,000 arrivals and failed. evidence_limit means retained evidence exceeded the processing limit; the report failed without publishing partial results. Creation reuses a terminal failed generation until expiry; narrow the period instead of retrying the same definition. A ready response with replacement_cohort_limit or replacement_evidence_limit retains the last complete report after a failed update; no replacement is still running.

milestone.description: Selected milestone whose retained observations this group summarizes.

id.description: Stable group identity within this generation and dimension.

value.description: Exact source or product value, Monday date for an arrival week, or captured commercial seller member TypeID or unassigned. Empty identifies the unknown group. A seller group value is accepted as commercial_seller.

immature.description: Arrivals whose observation horizon is still incomplete at the retained cutoff.

timed_observed.description: Observed arrivals with a retained timestamp within their observation window, used by median_seconds.

median_seconds.description: Median seconds from arrival to the retained observed milestone. Absent when no timed observations exist; not a time-to-conversion estimate for unknown or unobserved arrivals.

arrival_from.description: Inclusive instant at local Monday midnight for an arrival-week group. Absent for other dimensions. The snapshot's arrival period still bounds the population.

arrival_to.description: Exclusive instant at the next local Monday midnight for an arrival-week group. Absent for other dimensions.

unique_outcomes.description: Present for commercial milestones. Distinct contracts represented in observed arrival rows, counted once within this filtered cohort or group. Each arrival retains its earliest observed outcome. The same contract can appear in several source or seller groups; never add group counts as economic credit or revenue.

AdminSalesDemandGroupPage.description: Total is present only for ready responses requested with include_total=true. When the parameter is false or absent, or the generation is not ready, Demand omits total rather than returning null.

AdminSalesDemandKind.description: Arrival population: inquiry selects retained demo-request submissions; signup selects retained user signup arrivals, not organization creations. Both kinds expose the communication and CRM milestones. Signup additionally supports production_email. Either kind can include provider_funded when funding evidence is requested with Finance permission.

AdminSalesDemandReportDefinition.description: The resolved arrival cohort and optional evidence modes used by this report.

from.description: Inclusive arrival cutoff, no earlier than 90 days before the request. Must precede to by at most 90 days.

to.description: Exclusive arrival cutoff, no later than the later of 24 hours after the request or the end of the current day in the selected timezone. Must follow from by at most 90 days.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to choose and display the arrival period.

observation_days.description: Days after each arrival allowed for milestone observation.

include_funding.description: Whether this report includes provider funding evidence. A true value requires current Finance read permission in addition to CRM read.

include_commercial.description: Whether the report includes recorded agreement signing and billing adoption. Absent on earlier responses; treat as false. A true value requires current Deals and Contracts read permission in addition to CRM read.

unique_outcomes.description: Present for commercial milestones. Distinct contracts represented in observed arrival rows, counted once within this filtered cohort or group. Each arrival retains its earliest observed outcome. The same contract can appear in several source or seller groups; never add group counts as economic credit or revenue.

AdminSalesDemandCommercialEvidence.description: Exact retained execution and application metadata for the arrival's earliest observation of this milestone. Requires a committed pursuit, a captured opportunity-to-deal link valid at the outcome time, and the same retained organization. Outcome-time seller attribution is optional: missing, non-member, unbound or erased owner history remains unknown without excluding the commercial outcome. Signing, adoption and first recorded Billing application are distinct; none establishes payment, revenue or product usage. Applied history is forward-recorded only, without a first-ever claim for legacy or mixed writers. Counts remain arrival counts; unique_outcomes deduplicates represented contracts. Captured seller attribution is historical linkage, not target credit or a current assignment.

signed_at.description: Signing time recorded in the immutable execution; may precede its recording time.

recorded_at.description: Execution recording time, no later than the report activity cutoff. Does not claim first billing application.

applied_version_id.description: First forward-recorded Billing application for this contract, with no first-ever claim for legacy or mixed writers. Mutually exclusive with adopted_version_id.

application_revision.description: Exact Billing intent revision acknowledged with the recorded application.

application_recorded_at.description: Database-clock sample taken after the successful Billing receipt committed, at or before the report activity cutoff. The observation marker can commit later, so a rebuilt generation may then include that earlier receipt. This is neither the application time nor the marker's commit time.

seller_member_id.description: Captured CRM workspace-member TypeID owning the opportunity at this outcome, not an Auth user TypeID. Supported by an immutable member-to-user binding and no seller-erasure fence. Absent when unassigned or unknown; consult seller_known.

seller_known.description: True when retained CRM history establishes the owner or unassigned state at this outcome. False for missing, non-member, unbound or erased owner history; the commercial outcome remains available. Never inferred from current ownership, matching emails or equal UUIDs.

commercial.description: Present only for an observed agreement_signed, billing_adopted or billing_applied milestone. The containing milestone key selects the meaning; billing_adopted includes adopted_version_id, and billing_applied includes applied_version_id, application_revision and application_recorded_at. Absent for unknown observations and all other milestones.

AdminSalesDemandReport.description: Total is present only for ready responses requested with include_total=true. When the parameter is false or absent, or the generation is not ready, Demand omits total rather than returning null. Aggregate population, excluded, immature and counts values are available only for ready GET responses or ready create responses requested with include_total=true. Pending, building, failed and stale responses, and create responses without include_total, use zero for population, excluded and immature and an empty counts array to represent unavailable aggregates; these placeholders do not establish an empty cohort or zero outcomes. Captured and evaluated remain processing progress, not finalized aggregate results.

replacement_snapshot.description: Set by create when it returns a completed report while preparing a newer generation. Snapshot-specific GET reads always return empty and do not inspect replacement work. Use create with the same definition to request a refreshed report and obtain its replacement snapshot; an empty GET value does not mean no replacement is being prepared.

reason.description: Empty when no reason applies. regional_queue_pending and regional_evidence_pending indicate incomplete regional work; evidence_unavailable indicates a retryable evidence-owner failure. source_changed or calculation_changed requires a replacement generation. cohort_limit means the requested cohort exceeded 100,000 arrivals and failed. evidence_limit means retained evidence exceeded the processing limit; the report failed without publishing partial results. Creation reuses a terminal failed generation until expiry; narrow the period instead of retrying the same definition. A ready response with replacement_cohort_limit or replacement_evidence_limit retains the last complete report after a failed update; no replacement is still running.

calculation_version.description: Version of the milestone calculations used by this generation.

from.description: Inclusive arrival cutoff, no earlier than 90 days before the request. Must precede to by at most 90 days.

to.description: Exclusive arrival cutoff, no later than the later of 24 hours after the request or the end of the current day in the selected timezone. Must follow from by at most 90 days.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to choose and display the arrival period.

observation_days.description: Days after each arrival allowed for milestone observation.

include_funding.description: Include provider funding evidence. Creating or reading this report requires current Finance read permission in addition to CRM read.

include_commercial.description: Include recorded agreement signing and explicit billing adoption. Requires current Deals and Contracts read permission in addition to CRM read on creation and every report read, comparison and export. Unprovable historical association remains unknown.

AdminSalesIntakeCoverageState.description:
- `not_started`: No retained-source check has completed or started.
- `reconciling`: A bounded retained-source traversal is in progress.
- `scanned`: The last bounded traversal completed without unavailable retained messages; freshness is reported separately.
- `partial`: Retained messages could not be exposed for Sales intake in the current traversal, or the last completed traversal when no check is in progress.
- `unavailable`: The source could not be inspected, admission failed, or the retained window elapsed before completion.

AdminSalesIntakeSourceCoverageFailureCod.description:
- `source_unavailable`: The configured mailbox could not be inspected.
- `admission_failed`: Retained messages could not be admitted to Sales intake.
- `retained_window_elapsed`: The source retention boundary advanced beyond an unfinished check.

source_name.description: Current configured mailbox display name. Empty when the mailbox has no display name or its current metadata is unavailable.

source_address.description: Current configured mailbox address. Empty when its source metadata is unavailable.

stale.description: No recorded attempt, or the latest attempt is more than five minutes old. A recent failed attempt remains unavailable.

retained_from.description: Latest known retained-source boundary; older message coverage is unknown. This boundary may be from an earlier attempt when the source is unavailable. Omitted when no boundary is known.

last_attempt_at.description: Latest recorded check attempt, including a failed attempt. Omitted before the first recorded attempt.

last_completed_at.description: When the last bounded traversal finished; completion does not establish provider acceptance or CRM delivery. Omitted before the first completed traversal.

last_completed_from.description: Beginning of the last completed retained-source window. Omitted before the first completed traversal.

last_completed_through.description: End of the last completed retained-source window. Newer messages are outside that completed check.

unavailable_count.description: Retained messages that could not be exposed for Sales intake in the current traversal, or the last completed traversal when no check is in progress. This is not a count of all missing inbound messages.

failure_code.description: Omitted when no failure is recorded.

sources.description: The complete configured Sales mailbox set. Empty means no configured sources, not verified coverage of other intake channels.

AdminSalesInboundSource.description:
Where the conversation entered. `demo_request` is the website demo form;
`inbound` is a contact who wrote to a sales channel directly.

AdminSalesOwnerState.description: Whether a recent CRM read confirms an owner, confirms no owner, or cannot determine ownership.

AdminSalesOwner.description: CRM ownership of a conversation. The id is the CRM member TypeID of the owner, present only when assigned.

name.description: Owner display name, when available.

checked_at.description: Time of the most recent ownership read. Absent before the first read.

AdminSalesDisposition.description: Whether the conversation is in the active inbox or retained as rejected history.

AdminSalesLifecycleSummary.description: Latest recorded lifecycle result for a sales conversation, including a separately reviewed reopening.

crm_lead_id.description: CRM lead TypeID. A legacy stored value that is not a UUID is returned unchanged.

id.description: Thread identifier. Stable for the life of the lead conversation.

source.description: Origin of the representative identity. Use sources for all origins in a grouped conversation.

sources.description: Distinct origins of all identities in this conversation, including the representative.

latest_customer_message.description: Latest retained non-voice customer message across this conversation's identities, shortened to 280 characters. External CRM email is excluded.

latest_customer_message_at.description: Time of the displayed retained customer message.

current_status.description: Short AI-inferred label for where the conversation stands, such as who holds the next action. Refreshed asynchronously and on a best-effort basis after new messages, so it can lag the transcript by a minute or more and keeps its previous value when a refresh fails. In a grouped conversation it is the label inferred from the most recent message among its identities. Absent until first inferred.

owner.description: Read-only CRM ownership of the representative conversation. Stale and failed reads are unavailable.

channels.description: Channels this thread has carried. Order is not significant.

waiting_since.description: First inbound message still waiting for a person to reply. Absent when no message is waiting.

crm_outreach_at.description: Latest email a Sales team member exchanged with this contact in the CRM. It counts as a reply for waiting_since and unread_inbound. Absent when the CRM has none on record.

unread_inbound.description: Inbound messages that arrived after the most recent reply a person sent, in Bird or through CRM email. An automated send does not clear it, because it answers nothing.

draft.description: Current staff draft; may be empty when suggesting a reply from the conversation.

prompt.description: Staff writing instruction. Does not authorize sending or changing the conversation.

expected_updated_at.description: Updated time from the conversation being reviewed. Changed context requires refreshing before retrying.

activity_version.description: Compose activity version. Required when including a connected-mailbox message.

reply_to.description: Selected connected-mailbox message to include as evidence. The message must still be readable for this conversation.

AdminSalesAIExecutionOutcome.description:
Recorded outcome of a retained agent attempt, research execution, conversation qualification or synchronous reply-assist invocation. Admission failures describe the attempt when it finished; inspect its owner for current availability. Returned inference output is distinct from confirmed owner acceptance and does not prove a customer effect. Execution comparisons report known non-acceptance through their separate acceptance coverage. Execution-cost records do not report acceptance coverage or an acceptance flag; their outcome alone cannot establish owner acceptance.

- `unfinished` means a background draft claim was captured without a completed receipt. It does not prove a worker is still running, a returned output, or accepted publication.
- `running` means admission was captured but no finish was recorded. It does not prove a worker is still active or establish owner acceptance.
- `interrupted` means a later attempt recorded this unfinished attempt as interrupted.
- `inference_failed` means the inference request failed.
- `decision_failed` means the decision could not be validated or applied.
- `stale` means the decision no longer matched the accepted input.
- `decision_accepted` means the decision was saved.
- `deployment_disabled` means deployment capability was disabled before the decision could be saved.
- `policy_changed` means a newer policy prevented the decision from being saved.
- `policy_inactive` means the policy was stopped or expired before the decision could be saved.
- `response_deadline_passed` means the current input deadline passed before the decision could be saved.
- `provider_unavailable` means inference configuration became unavailable before the decision could be saved.
- `sender_changed` means the configured sender changed before the decision could be saved.
- `decision_configuration_changed` means the configured model, effort or prompt changed before the decision could be saved.
- `coverage_unavailable` means named human coverage became unavailable before the decision could be saved.
- `buyer_reply_requires_followthrough` means a buyer reply required human follow-through before the decision could be saved.
- `attempt_limit` means the attempt limit prevented the decision from being saved.
- `source_unavailable` means the source became unavailable before the decision could be saved.
- `research_wait` means the retained decision awaits current research.
- `followthrough_unavailable` means the deployment cannot execute the required buyer follow-through.
- `followup_unavailable` means follow-up capability is disabled by policy or unavailable in this deployment.
- `context_limit` means the retained conversation exceeds the bounded decision context.
- `input_unavailable` means the expected inbound input or follow-up anchor is missing or cannot authorize this work.
- `followup_window_missed` means no permitted sending window remains before the follow-up deadline.
- `turn_limit` means the policy limit for automated conversation turns has been reached.
- `research_unavailable` means required current research cannot be obtained within the permitted research attempt.
- `native_intent_changed` means the retained CRM command no longer matches the current input and admission.
- `qualification_evidence_changed` means the evidence authorizing qualification is no longer current.
- `native_action_refused` means the CRM owner definitively refused the proposed action under current authority.
- `human_takeover` means human handling, a pause or an opt-out prevents the scheduled follow-up.
- `human_required` means a continuation required human handling instead of proceeding with meeting coordination.
- `anchor_changed` means the confirmed message anchoring the follow-up no longer matches its retained proof.
- `newer_activity` means newer contact or conversation activity invalidated the retained automated outreach.
- `signup_unavailable` means signup welcome is disabled by policy or unavailable in this deployment.
- `signup_help_denied` means the signup owner no longer authorizes disclosure of the retained help evidence.
- `signup_help_changed` means the retained signup help evidence changed before the action could proceed.
- `signup_help_unavailable` means a reply requiring signup help lacks the matching authorized help-send context.
- `recipient_opted_out` means the current recipient preference forbids the signup outreach.
- `source_changed` means the signup source identity or recipient no longer matches the retained welcome.
- `meeting_unavailable` means meeting booking is enabled on the policy but Calendar booking is unavailable in this deployment.
- `meeting_offer_expired` means the retained meeting offer expired before its reply could be sent.
- `pursuit_admission_changed` means current native authority no longer admits the proposed opportunity pursuit.

- `returned` means an owner runner returned an output; acceptance or publication is a separate owner decision.
- `failed` means an owner runner did not complete successfully; retained call usage can still be present.

effort.description: Requested reasoning effort. Empty means the owner did not set an explicit effort.

prompt_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the instructions used by this program.

tool_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the declared tool and output contract.

contract_version.description: The owner's immutable execution contract version.

AdminSalesAIProgramIdentity.description: Immutable executed program identity. Digests cover the actual instructions and declared tool contract. No customer evidence or prompt body is copied. This staff operation has no autonomous enrollment-policy revision.

AdminSalesInferenceCostState.description:
- `estimated`: All admitted meter quantities were observed; amount is a supplier estimate.
- `source_unconfigured`: No Billing cost-book reader was wired.
- `facts_missing`: Required provider identity, tier, geography or call time was unreported.
- `usage_missing`: At least one required quantity was missing or invalid.
- `unsupported_usage`: Observed usage cannot be represented by the admitted meter contract.
- `mapping_missing`: No exact active rate admission covered this call.
- `mapping_ambiguous`: Multiple active product cost books matched the call.
- `source_unavailable`: The bounded optional Billing read did not succeed.
- `invalid_snapshot`: The retained rate snapshot could not be calculated.
- `not_captured`: Historical call receipt has no cost observation.
- `snapshot_limit`: The complete rate snapshot exceeded the bounded optional receipt size.

unit_cost.description: Frozen CSV rate in major currency units per unit_quantity, before multiplication. No FX conversion.

amount.description: Exact supplier estimate in the snapshot currency. Absent for any unpriced state; never an invoice amount.

missing_meters.description: Observed missing or invalid quantities for an admitted snapshot. Absent when no specific missing meter was recorded.

AdminSalesAgentInferencePurpose.description:
Extensible vocabulary for a model call's role in Sales execution. A listed purpose does not establish captured receipt coverage, and receipt capture is best-effort, so a missing receipt leaves execution evidence unknown.
- `first_response`: Prepares the first demo response from the submitted form evidence.
- `knowledge_plan`: Identifies the product information needed to answer the retained buyer message.
- `buyer_answer`: Prepares a response and proposed action from buyer evidence and retrieved product information.
- `meeting_interpretation`: Interprets the buyer's request to arrange, select, change or cancel a meeting.
- `meeting_preparation`: Prepares private meeting facts, questions and unknowns from retained buyer evidence; it does not coordinate a booking or send a message.
- `research`: Researches a retained prospect for an assessment or explicit prompt test. A provider response alone does not publish an assessment.
- `staff_reply_draft`: Asynchronous staff reply drafting. Retained attempts describe generation; copying, editing and sending have separate owner evidence. Missing capture remains unknown.
- `conversation_qualification`: Collects facts for staff review in the existing conversation qualification flow.
- `company_research`: Global market-research company/profile generation; accepted profile publication is separate from observed model calls and does not prove CRM fill.
- `crm_research`: Market-research profile generation for a CRM company; the accepted profile is separate from observed model calls and does not prove a CRM fill.
- `staff_reply_assist`: One staff-requested synchronous enhance/rewrite invocation; returned text is not delivery.
- `sheet_research`: Initial whole-sheet generation; acceptance records run finalization rather than the producer of every streamed row.
- `sheet_cell`: One admitted cell research attempt; saved result acceptance is distinct from staff use, review or CRM fill.

AdminSalesAgentInferenceOutcome.description: Whether the provider call returned a structurally valid response. Returned does not mean the proposed decision passed domain validation or an effect occurred.

AdminSalesAgentInferenceUsage.description: Raw provider token counters. Missing fields are unknown; reported zero remains zero. Cache counters are separate components, not extra output tokens. No billed cost is inferred. A separate optional cost receipt uses exact admitted rates.

started_at.description: Actual provider HTTP attempt start; absent in older receipts.

provider_request_id.description: Provider response request identifier when returned.

request_profile.description: Exact versioned request shape and hosted tool profile.

service_tier.description: Actual provider-reported service tier; never inferred from request defaults.

model.description: Model requested by the configured Sales execution owner.

returned_model.description: Exact model identifier returned by the provider. Absent when the response omitted it.

duration_milliseconds.description: Elapsed time around this provider call attempt, including transport and response decoding. It is part of the attempt wall time, not additional time.

provider_http_status.description: Provider HTTP response status when observed; absent for a transport failure or an unrecorded status.

stop_reason.description: Provider stop reason when returned; absent when unreported.

accepted_result.description: True means the owning workflow confirmed this exact result. False means no confirmed acceptance receipt, not a proved rejection. It does not prove staff approval, CRM fill, delivery, human usefulness or a customer effect.

key.description: The execution identifier within its owning source.

started_at.description: When the owner admitted the captured execution.

finished_at.description: When the execution finished. Absent when completion was not captured.

report_complete.description: Whether the captured call report is complete. Absent when no report was captured.

AdminSalesAIOwnerExecution.description: One retained owner attempt, including failures and interruptions. A missing identity or report is unknown, never a zero-call run. The owner run's attempt count is the denominator for capture coverage. Returned output, explicit staff interactions and provider delivery are separate facts. Monetary call fields require deal-cost read permission.

execution.description: Optional retained invocation receipt. Each request is a distinct inference, not an idempotent output replay. Absent when optional capture was unavailable; missing capture does not mean no invocation occurred. Returned output is not a send or usefulness judgment; monetary details require the separate authorized receipt view.

draft.description: Suggested reply text for staff to review. No message has been sent.

native_messages.description: Number of retained sales messages supplied as evidence.

context_truncated.description: Older messages or excess message text were excluded to bound the context.

mail_message_included.description: The selected connected-mailbox message was included as evidence.

channel.description: Channel the reply is written for. Email, SMS or WhatsApp.

AdminSalesReplyDraftStatus.description: Queued and running drafts are still being written.

status.description: What the agent is doing now, or was doing when it stopped.

recent_searches.description: The latest web search queries, oldest first.

url.description: Page the agent consulted.

title.description: Page title, when the source gave one.

executions.description: Retained attempt receipts. Compare length with attempts; missing capture remains unknown.

status.description: Queued and running drafts are still being written.

draft.description: Proposed reply for staff to review. Present when the draft succeeded. Sending it remains a staff action.

sources.description: Public pages and Bird documentation the agent consulted.

basis_updated_at.description: Conversation updated time the draft was written from. A later conversation update means new activity arrived after the draft.

failure_reason.description: Why the draft failed. Present when the draft failed.

completed_at.description: When the draft succeeded or failed.

AdminSalesReplyDraftSendOwner.description:
Authoritative send owner:
- `shared`: the Sales shared-channel message owner.
- `gmail`: the connected personal mailbox send owner; its actor-authorized receipt read supplies status.

AdminSalesReplyDraftBodyMatch.description:
Match against the accepted draft result at send admission:
- `exact`: the submitted body equals the result after the shared sender's surrounding-whitespace normalization, or byte-for-byte for Gmail.
- `edited`: the caller declared this draft as a source but the submitted body differs. This does not identify who or what made the edit, or prove that the draft caused the final content.

AdminSalesReplyDraftSendState.description:
Current evidence state:
- `queued`: the shared owner accepted work for dispatch.
- `ambiguous`: shared dispatch may have happened; no new send is implied.
- `accepted`: the provider accepted the shared message, without recipient delivery proof.
- `delivered`: the shared owner retained provider delivery confirmation.
- `failed`: the shared owner retained a definitive failure.
- `suppressed`: the shared owner prevented sending.
- `unavailable`: the exact retained shared message or body proof is unavailable.
- `owner_read_required`: Gmail admission is retained; read the referenced send through getAdminSalesMailSend under its existing actor authority.

execution_key.description: The draft's accepted execution lease at this send admission. Failed or superseded draft attempts are never attributed.

reference.description: Exact shared-message key or typed SalesMailSendID. For Gmail, use getAdminSalesMailSend under its existing actor authority to read provider status.

admitted_at.description: When the send was durably queued, not when it was delivered.

confirmed_at.description: First confirmation retained by the shared message owner, when available. Provider acceptance does not establish recipient delivery. Absent for Gmail and unavailable evidence.

receipts.description: Most recent captured send admissions for this exact draft. Capture is optional; missing receipts are unknown, not zero sending.

truncated.description: More than 50 retained admissions exist for this draft. This is not a capture-completeness indicator.

AdminSalesReplyDraftInteractionKind.description:
Explicit staff interaction reported by the composer, not delivery or review quality.
- `copied_to_composer`: the existing composer accepted the draft text.
- `edited_in_composer`: a staff edit changed that copied text.

AdminSalesMeetingBriefState.description:
Whether a meeting brief is planned, being prepared or available to read.
- `scheduled`: Preparation is scheduled for the accepted meeting and has not started.
- `pending`: Preparation has started; no completed brief is available yet.
- `ready`: The brief reflects the current meeting and customer information and is available to read.
- `unavailable`: No brief is available. Preparation may be unscheduled, unsuccessful or unable to retry. This state alone does not confirm whether another attempt is scheduled.
- `stale`: The meeting or customer information changed. The outdated brief is hidden until current information can be checked and a valid brief is available.

AdminSalesMeetingBriefTopic.description:
Topic of an excerpt from retained buyer evidence. A cited excerpt records what the buyer supplied; it does not independently verify that statement.
- `goal`: The buyer's stated objective, desired outcome or problem to solve.
- `product`: Products, capabilities or use cases named by the buyer.
- `scale`: Stated workload, message volume, audience size or other usage quantities; not inferred company size.
- `timeline`: Stated timing, deadlines or implementation windows.
- `decision_process`: Stated participants, evaluation, approval or purchasing steps; not inferred buying authority.
- `context`: Other relevant buyer background outside the five discovery topics. Context is optional and is not a required unknown when absent.

reference.description: Exact retained buyer-message key or form field reference supporting this quote.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the referenced buyer evidence.

AdminSalesMeetingBriefUnknownTopic.description: A discovery topic for which the brief has no supported fact. goal means the buyer's desired outcome; product means the product or workflow they want to use; scale means their expected volume or scope; timeline means their intended timing; decision_process means how and by whom a purchase will be decided. Optional background context is not a required discovery topic.

AdminSalesMeetingBrief.description: Private meeting preparation from retained buyer evidence. Facts and suggested questions are returned only while the brief is current and ready.

output_review.description: Present only when this exact disclosed output has a retained successful owner identity.

reason.description:
Why a current brief is not available. Empty when no blocking reason applies.
- `preparation_not_scheduled`: No preparation is recorded for the current meeting.
- `preparation_attempt_limit`: The preparation attempt limit has been reached.
- `preparation_unavailable`: Preparation could not produce or verify a current brief. This reason alone does not indicate whether another attempt is scheduled.
- `retained_evidence_unavailable`: Retained buyer evidence is incomplete or exceeds the preparation limit. No partial brief is disclosed.
- `meeting_evidence_changed`: The retained buyer evidence or meeting details no longer match the prepared brief.
- `meeting_or_authority_changed`: The meeting or the authority required for preparation changed; the retained brief is withheld.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the meeting, such as Europe/Amsterdam or UTC.

AdminSalesAIConfigurationKey.description: Stable digest of the captured admission configuration; observed returned-model evidence is excluded.

key.description: Stable retained execution identity; each retry has its own key.

finished_at.description: Retained completion timestamp. Omitted when no completion was recorded; this does not prove the worker is currently active.

report_complete.description: Absent when no report was retained; false when capture was incomplete. Does not promise all quantities were reported.

calls.description: Calls in execution order; at most three for agent decisions and twelve for the existing research owner. Empty with missing report_complete means unknown, not zero invocations.

AdminSalesAIComparisonUseCase.description:
The retained execution's owner program, separate from an input obligation.
- `form`: Initial demo-form inference.
- `buyer_message`: Buyer-message continuation.
- `scheduled_followup`: Scheduled buyer follow-up.
- `signup_welcome`: Signup welcome inference.
- `qualified_pursuit`: Qualified prospect pursuit.
- `meeting_reply`: Meeting coordination response.
- `meeting_preparation`: Private meeting preparation; its attempt receipt does not prove booking or attendance.
- `research_assessment`: Background prospect assessment.
- `research_prompt_test`: Explicit manual prompt test; does not publish an assessment.
- `unknown_agent`: Historical agent attempt without a captured program identity.
- `conversation_qualification`: Captured attempts from the existing conversation fact-collection flow; staff qualification remains a separate decision.
- `staff_reply_assist`: Captured synchronous enhance/rewrite invocations, distinct from draft use and manual delivery.

known_amount.description: Exact sum of retained supplier estimates in this currency, including failures and retries.

calls.description: Observed calls with this unpriced cost state.

incomplete_executions.description: Captured executions whose call report is absent or incomplete. Their unknown calls cannot be counted or treated as free.

useful_outputs.description: Explicit useful human reviews in this configuration, not verified customer effects.

missing_reasons.description: Unpriced observed calls by retained cost state, including historical not_captured. Sorted by state; each state appears at most once.

cost_per_useful_output.description: Total estimated cost of all executions in this group divided by useful_outputs, rounded to six decimal places. Present only when every report is complete, every observed call is priced, exactly one currency exists, and useful_outputs is positive. The exact numerator and denominator remain available. This is cost per reviewed-useful output, not customer ROI.

version.description: Captured instruction version or immutable research prompt revision.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the effective static instruction when captured. Absence is unknown and is never filled from current settings.

model.description: Immutable requested model; absent for uncaptured historical identity.

source_policy_revision.description: Enrollment policy captured alongside the attempt; may differ for meeting preparation.

policy_version.description: Captured agent or research policy contract version.

prompts_reported.description: Whether the admission owner reported the effective prompt fingerprints. Captured version-only research identities remain in prompts when false.

prompts.description: Exact captured prompt identities, in stable order. Empty means unknown, not an empty prompt.

returned_models.description: Sorted distinct model identifiers actually returned by captured provider calls across this admitted configuration. These observations are evidence, not part of the configuration key or grouping identity. Empty means no identifier was reported; returned_model_calls gives its coverage.

known_total.description: Sum of explicitly reported values. Zero with no reporting calls does not establish zero usage.

reported_calls.description: Calls that reported this counter; the denominator is analytics.model_calls in input activity and calls in an execution comparison group. Missing attempts may contain additional unobserved calls.

AdminSalesAIExecutionQualityMetrics.description: Explicit output judgments for captured executions in this configuration group and started-at window. Retries count separately; these are not selected-input counts or causal quality estimates.

eligible_outputs.description: Captured executions with a retained output eligible for explicit review. Research and meeting outputs require publication to be enabled or an existing retained judgment, in addition to their output and retention checks. Each retry output counts separately. No-output failures remain in execution totals and are excluded from this quality denominator.

reviewed_outputs.description: Eligible executions with an explicit latest review. Each execution counts once regardless of review replacements.

useful_outputs.description: Eligible executions whose latest explicit judgment is useful.

needs_changes_outputs.description: Eligible executions whose latest explicit judgment is needs_changes.

not_useful_outputs.description: Eligible executions whose latest explicit judgment is not_useful.

unreviewed_outputs.description: Eligible executions without an explicit review. Historical approvals do not supply reviews.

useful_delivered_replies.description: Eligible executions with an explicit useful judgment, accepted output and confirmed reply delivery. Counts accepted executions in this group, not selected inputs, sales or commercial outcomes.

AdminSalesAIInterventionReason.description:
Stated reason for changing handling or approving a decision.
- `unknown`: the operator did not record a reason.
- `quality`: concern about the AI output’s quality.
- `customer_request`: the customer requested a change in handling.
- `policy`: a policy requirement prompted the intervention.
- `coverage`: seller staffing, availability or responsibility prompted the intervention.
- `technical`: a technical issue prompted the intervention.
- `other`: the recorded reason does not fit another category.

executions.description: Captured agent attempts, research runs, conversation qualification receipts and synchronous reply-assist receipts in this group. Retries count separately; missing admission receipts cannot be counted.

finished_executions.description: Captured executions with a valid finish timestamp. An unfinished receipt is not proof of an active worker.

reported_executions.description: Captured executions with an execution report, including empty and partial reports.

complete_reports.description: Execution reports marked complete by their owner. Complete does not mean success.

calls.description: Observed provider call attempts in captured reports; excludes unknown calls from missing reports.

failed_calls.description: Observed calls whose recorded outcome is failed. Refused decisions remain visible in outcomes.

returned_model_calls.description: Observed calls that supplied a nonempty provider-returned model identifier.

model_milliseconds.description: Sum of measured provider call milliseconds; partial reporting remains partial.

accepted_results.description: Captured executions with positive result acceptance proof from their owner. Research requires an accepted assessment revision. This is not staff approval, delivery or customer effectiveness.

acceptance_reported_executions.description: Captured executions whose current owner acceptance is known. Subtract from executions for unknown acceptance, including unfinished reply-assist receipts, qualification confirmation failures and older qualification receipts without proof. Completed non-acceptance may be stale; it is not a staff rejection.

confirmed_replies.description: Exact accepted agent attempts with a retained delivered message receipt and nonempty provider reference.

confirmed_qualifications.description: Exact accepted agent attempts with a retained matching qualified CRM effect receipt.

recorded_human_handoffs.description: Exact accepted agent attempts with a retained matching handoff request receipt; not proof a seller accepted or completed it.

accepted_assessments.description: Research runs with an immutable accepted assessment revision; prompt tests cannot increment this count.

review_supported.description: True for use cases with a supported decision or output-review owner. This describes review capability, not current publication permission; disabled research or meeting publication excludes unreviewed outputs from quality counts while preserving retained explicit judgments.

outcomes.description: Counts keyed by the retained agent-attempt, research-run, conversation-qualification or synchronous reply-assist outcome. Includes refusals, failures, interruptions and unfinished work; the counts sum to executions. A recorded outcome is not a verified customer effect.

source_lifetime_interventions.description: Retained handling events for sources represented in this group, over each source's retained lifetime. A source in multiple configurations appears in each; do not sum groups or attribute these events causally to a model. Reviews are separate.

data.description: One page of configuration groups. Per-group execution and call denominators are independent of page size; this page is not a cohort total.

AdminSalesDemoAgentInputKind.description: The real event or scheduled obligation that initiated this input.

eligible_outputs.description: Completed attempts with a retained decision for selected inputs. No-output failures are excluded from this quality denominator and remain in attempt/failure totals.

reviewed_outputs.description: Eligible attempts with an explicit latest review; each attempt counts once regardless of review replacements.

useful_outputs.description: Reviewed outputs whose latest explicit judgment is useful.

needs_changes_outputs.description: Reviewed outputs whose latest explicit judgment is needs_changes.

not_useful_outputs.description: Reviewed outputs whose latest explicit judgment is not_useful.

unreviewed_outputs.description: Eligible outputs without an explicit review. Historical approvals do not supply reviews.

useful_delivered_replies.description: Selected inputs whose accepted attempt is explicitly useful and whose reply has confirmed delivery; this is not a sale or commercial outcome.

prompt_version.description: Accepted-attempt version or latest-attempt version where no attempt was accepted. Without a decision only one distinct reported admission prompt version is attributable; absent when unknown or ambiguous.

model.description: Requested model from the same attributed attempt decision or its immutable admission snapshot when no decision exists; absent when unknown and not proof of an invocation.

attempts.description: All attempts for these inputs. Earlier retries may have used another model.

unattributed_inputs.description: Inputs missing either attributed model or prompt version.

quality.description: Explicit output reviews for attempts belonging to this same received-input cohort. Group attribution describes the input; earlier attempts may use different model versions. Useful rate is useful_outputs divided by reviewed_outputs and is unknown when reviewed_outputs is zero.

AdminSalesAICostStatus.description: unavailable until sourced provider pricing and relevant usage have been retained.

AdminSalesAIMeetingPreparationCoverage.description: separate_attempts_excluded means brief preparation has no input-obligation timestamp and is outside this received-input cohort.

ongoing_inputs.description: Inputs without a retained terminal state or a completed reply-only obligation. Native actions remain ongoing after reply delivery until their owner records a terminal state.

finished_inputs.description: Inputs with a retained terminal state or a reply-only obligation with confirmed delivery; this is not a count of successful sales outcomes.

attention_inputs.description: Inputs matching the same operational attention predicate used by the rows.

confirmed_qualifications.description: Inputs with matching native qualification receipts and a lead reference; multiple inputs may reference the same lead.

recorded_human_handoffs.description: Inputs with recorded native handover requests; not accepted handovers or completed tasks.

reported_attempts.description: Attempts with a retained execution report; denominator is summary.attempts.

complete_reports.description: Attempts whose retained report says every measured call is included.

model_calls.description: Observed provider calls in retained reports; attempts lacking a report may have made additional calls.

failed_model_calls.description: Observed calls that returned an error.

model_milliseconds.description: Sum of measured provider-call durations, distinct from full-attempt wall time.

unattributed_inputs.description: Inputs missing either an attributed model or prompt version.

unrepresented_meeting_preparation_attemp.description: Retained brief preparation attempts associated with selected inputs. These attempts are outside summary and usage totals.

groups.description: Descriptive input attribution by kind, source kind, immutable enrollment policy and accepted-or-latest attempt version and model; not causal model lift.

groups_truncated.description: More than 100 groups exist in the selected population. Use the group cursors to inspect every group; summary totals remain independent of the group and input pages.

groups_next_cursor.description: Pass as group_starting_after for the next group page. Null when no next group page exists.

groups_prev_cursor.description: Pass as group_ending_before for the previous group page. Null when no previous group page exists.

groups_refresh_cursor.description: First-group anchor; pass as group_ending_before to read preceding groups. Null only for an empty group page. Refresh the full view to reflect changes to existing groups.

source_lifetime_interventions.description: Retained handling events across the full lifetime of distinct source conversations represented by the selected inputs, grouped by stated reason. Events are deduplicated across inputs; these counts are not events during the received-input date window or causal outcomes of a model version. Historical events before capture are unknown.

quality.description: Explicit output reviews for attempts belonging to the same selected received-input cohort. Useful rate is useful_outputs divided by reviewed_outputs and is unknown when reviewed_outputs is zero.

inputs.description: Enrolled demo forms in first_response, or retained agent obligations matching every filter in all_inputs, including forms without a stored input.

attempts.description: All recorded attempts for selected forms or inputs, including retries. Separate meeting-preparation attempts are excluded.

failed_attempts.description: Inference failures, invalid decisions or interrupted attempts.

completed_attempts.description: Attempts with valid start and finish timestamps; the latency denominator, not successful sales outcomes.

confirmed_replies.description: Selected forms or inputs with a delivered reply and nonempty provider reference.

attempt_p50_milliseconds.description: Median recorded wall time across finished attempts. Absent when none have a valid recorded duration.

attempt_p95_milliseconds.description: 95th percentile recorded wall time across finished attempts. Absent when none have a valid recorded duration.

ongoing.description: Recorded input is neither terminal nor a reply-only obligation with confirmed delivery. Native actions can remain ongoing after a reply is delivered. This is not a model-running indicator.

confirmed_qualification.description: A matching retained native receipt confirms qualification and a lead reference.

recorded_human_handoff.description: A native receipt records a handover request; it does not establish acceptance or completion.

effect_state.description: Last recorded native receipt state; inspect the run for current owner state.

source_name.description: Current retained source name or email when no name was provided.

state.description: Last retained conversation or blocked state; inspect the run for current execution readiness.

model.description: Requested model from the accepted attempt in all_inputs or the latest attempt when none was accepted. Its decision takes precedence; without a decision its immutable admission snapshot supplies configuration. Absent when neither retained a model. This is not proof of a call.

prompt_version.description: Prompt version from the same attributed attempt. Its decision takes precedence; without a decision the admission snapshot supplies a version only when all reported instruction entries agree. Absent for unknown or multiple possible versions. This does not prove a prompt ran.

scope.description: Absent for the legacy first-response view; all_inputs for the retained input cohort.

AdminSalesDemoAgentMode.description: Maximum permitted handling mode for newly enrolled demo forms.

created_from.description: Inclusive start of the signup cohort. A newly enabled or changed cohort must start at most seven days before publication. Unchanged bounds from the current enabled welcome policy can be republished as they age.

created_before.description: Exclusive end of the signup cohort. Must be after created_from, including when disabled. When enabled, no later than policy expiry.

enrollment_limit.description: Maximum signup enrollments under this policy revision.

max_age_minutes.description: Maximum signup age at enrollment. The welcome is then scheduled in the permitted sending window and may be sent after this age, subject to its response deadline and policy expiry.

subject.description: Exact welcome email subject, without line breaks.

body.description: Exact welcome email text, without model rewriting.

initial_stage_id.description: Exact published opportunity stage UUID. Required when enabled; the native owner checks writable metadata again.

task_due_minutes.description: Discovery task due interval, fixed when the pursuit is prepared.

enabled.description: Permit meeting coordination for accepted discovery work under the current handling mode. Disabled by default.

duration_minutes.description: Duration of each offered meeting slot.

preparation_enabled.description: Automatically schedule a private host brief 24 hours before the confirmed meeting starts, or immediately if it starts sooner, using retained buyer evidence. Up to three attempts per current booking. Requires the enclosing agent policy and meeting coordination to be enabled under a current compatible policy. Disabled when absent or false.

first_response_minutes.description: Time in minutes allowed to start the first response after demo enrollment or the scheduled signup welcome time. Policy expiry still applies; signup age is checked at enrollment.

followthrough_enabled.description: Allows handling later buyer replies under this policy.

reply_minutes.description: Maximum age in minutes of a buyer reply before a new action may start. Must be positive when follow-through is enabled; zero when no reply budget is configured.

max_turns.description: Maximum buyer replies and scheduled follow-ups handled after the initial form or signup welcome. Must be positive when follow-through is enabled; zero when no turn budget is configured.

qualification_enabled.description: Allows evidenced qualification when follow-through is enabled.

followup_enabled.description: Allows scheduled email follow-ups after confirmed delivery. Requires buyer follow-through.

followup_minutes.description: Minimum time after confirmed delivery before another follow-up. The normalized default is 1440 minutes. Ignored while follow-ups are disabled; numeric bounds apply only when enabled.

max_followups.description: Maximum proactive follow-ups for an enrolled conversation. Must not exceed max_turns when followup_enabled is true. The normalized default is one; counts toward the total turn limit. Ignored while follow-ups are disabled; numeric bounds apply only when enabled.

followup_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the Monday–Friday sending window.

followup_start_hour.description: First permitted local hour, inclusive. The normalized default is 9. Ignored when both follow-ups and signup welcomes are disabled; numeric bounds apply when either is enabled.

followup_end_hour.description: Last permitted local hour, exclusive; must be later than the start. The normalized default is 17. Ignored when both follow-ups and signup welcomes are disabled; numeric bounds apply when either is enabled.

signup_welcome.description: Signup welcome cohort and exact message. Omission disables new signup enrollment. Requires buyer follow-through and the shared sending-hours window.

pursuit.description: Optional qualified-lead pursuit policy. Absent means disabled.

AdminSalesAIUseCaseMode.description: Whether this use case uses a model, uses deterministic owner behavior, is not implemented, or lacks an inspection adapter.

text.description: Shared system instructions from the active prompt builder. Excludes invocation context and credentials.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 of the exact displayed prompt text.

configured.description: The actual model adapter is configured. Does not establish live provider health, a worker's deployment version, policy eligibility, or authorization to execute an effect.

settings_revision.description: Revision of the saved settings used to construct this prompt.

knowledge.description: Supported public source owners, not an inventory or a freshness assertion. Exact source versions are retained on individual answers.

observed_at.description: When this API instance read these settings. Not a provider-health or worker observation.

policy_revision.description: Current published agent policy revision. Zero means unpublished.

policy_enabled.description: Stored policy switch. Expiry and runtime admission still apply.

AdminSalesDemoAgentPreviewMeetingBlocked.description: Why meeting readiness is false. Omitted when ready; candidate preview evaluates its selected coverage.

deployment_ready.description: The compatible Sales API and intake deployment has been enabled for this capability.

policy.description: The current published policy when reading settings, or the proposed unpublished policy when previewing changes. Absent only when reading settings before the first publication.

provider_available.description: The configured provider is wired. This is not a successful inference probe.

coverage_available.description: The configured fallback is eligible staff and the CRM coverage owner currently admits that person. This check does not establish that the policy is enabled or admitting work. Coverage is checked again for each source and effect.

enrolled_count.description: Retained enrolled demo requests and signups across all policy versions. Publication changes stop pending effects from earlier versions.

followthrough_ready.description: The deployment can handle buyer replies, research and native outcomes. False means follow-through cannot be published.

followup_ready.description: Whether the deployed decision and execution owners support scheduled follow-ups. Does not probe model inference or delivery.
