signup_welcome_ready.description: Whether the deployed owners can admit signup welcomes under a published policy. Does not probe model inference or delivery.

pursuit_ready.description: Whether compatible runtime and native owners support qualified-lead pursuits. No booking or commercial outcome is implied.

meeting_ready.description: Compatible meeting owners and the selected coverage's current permission to use retained email agreement are available. Does not assert the future accepted host's Calendar grant or live availability; absent on older services.

meeting_preparation_ready.description: Whether compatible owners can prepare private meeting briefs from retained buyer evidence. Enabling preparation also requires meeting_ready for the selected coverage; publication returns 503 when either readiness condition is false. Does not probe inference or guarantee a ready brief for any booking.

mode.description: Maximum permitted handling mode. A published approval policy cannot be upgraded to automatic by conversation controls. Human mode and pause remain available.

expires_at.description: Publication expiry, at most thirty days from now.

first_response_minutes.description: Time in minutes allowed to start the first response after demo enrollment or the scheduled signup welcome time. Policy expiry still applies; signup age is checked at enrollment.

followthrough_enabled.description: Allows handling later buyer replies under this policy. Omission disables follow-through.

reply_minutes.description: Maximum age in minutes of a buyer reply before a new action may start. Must be positive when follow-through is enabled; omission is zero.

max_turns.description: Maximum buyer replies and scheduled follow-ups handled after the initial form or signup welcome. Must be positive when follow-through is enabled; omission is zero.

qualification_enabled.description: Allows evidenced qualification when follow-through is enabled. Omission disables qualification.

followup_enabled.description: Allows scheduled email follow-ups after confirmed delivery. Requires buyer follow-through; omission disables follow-ups.

followup_minutes.description: Minimum time after confirmed delivery before another follow-up. Defaults to 1440 minutes. Ignored while follow-ups are disabled; numeric bounds apply only when enabled.

max_followups.description: Maximum proactive follow-ups for an enrolled conversation. Defaults to one; counts toward the total turn limit and must not exceed max_turns when follow-ups are enabled. Ignored while follow-ups are disabled; numeric bounds apply only when enabled.

followup_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the Monday–Friday sending window.

followup_start_hour.description: First permitted local hour, inclusive. Defaults to 9. Ignored when both follow-ups and signup welcomes are disabled; numeric bounds apply when either is enabled.

followup_end_hour.description: Last permitted local hour, exclusive. When follow-ups or signup welcomes are enabled, this must be later than followup_start_hour; an invalid window returns 422. Defaults to 17. Ignored when both follow-ups and signup welcomes are disabled; numeric bounds apply when either is enabled.

signup_welcome.description: Signup welcome cohort and exact message. Omission disables new signup enrollment. Requires buyer follow-through and the shared sending-hours window.

pursuit.description: Optional qualified-lead pursuit policy. Absent means disabled.

expected_revision.description: Current handling revision reviewed by the requester; zero means a retained signup has no conversation yet.

qualification_effect_key.description: Exact retained qualification receipt, when continuing agent-created discovery work.

name.description: Explicit new opportunity name. Supply with initial_stage_id, or select opportunity_id instead.

opportunity_id.description: Exact existing opportunity selected for reuse. Its original Lead and commercial fields are preserved.

AdminSalesDemoAgentRunState.description:
Current demo-agent progress. A retained send takes precedence over an attempt outcome; current blocking controls take precedence over work that has not been sent.

- `pending` is the initial state before an attempt starts.
- `running` means an inference attempt has started without a recorded finish.
- `interrupted` means a later attempt recorded an unfinished attempt as interrupted.
- `inference_failed` means the latest inference attempt failed.
- `decision_failed` means the latest decision could not be validated or applied.
- `stale` means the latest decision no longer matched the accepted input.
- `decision_accepted` means the decision was saved.
- `needs_approval` means the retained decision requires staff approval, including any proposed reply, qualification or human-work request.
- `queued` means a reply is waiting for send admission.
- `ambiguous` means the send outcome is uncertain and requires reconciliation.
- `accepted` means the delivery provider accepted the send.
- `delivered` means delivery was confirmed.
- `failed` means the send failed.
- `suppressed` means the queued send was stopped before sending.
- `blocked` means a current admission check prevents new work; `blocked_reason` identifies the check.
- `handoff` means the conversation requires human handling, not that a recipient accepted a task.
- `paused` means staff paused automation.
- `human` means staff selected human replies.
- `deployment_disabled` means the latest decision encountered disabled deployment capability.
- `policy_changed` means the latest decision encountered a newer published policy.
- `policy_inactive` means the latest decision encountered a stopped or expired policy.
- `response_deadline_passed` means the latest decision exceeded its input deadline.
- `provider_unavailable` means the latest decision encountered unavailable inference configuration.
- `sender_changed` means the latest decision no longer matched the configured sender.
- `decision_configuration_changed` means the latest decision no longer matched the configured model, effort or prompt.
- `coverage_unavailable` means the latest decision encountered unavailable named human coverage.
- `buyer_reply_requires_followthrough` means the latest decision encountered a buyer reply requiring human follow-through.
- `attempt_limit` means the latest decision encountered the inference attempt limit.
- `source_unavailable` means the latest decision encountered an unavailable source.
- `research_wait` means the retained decision awaits current research.
- `followthrough_unavailable` means the deployment cannot execute the required buyer follow-through.
- `decision` means a decision is retained for the current input.
- `reply_queued` means a response to the buyer awaits its sending outcome.
- `effect_pending` means a native action awaits confirmation.
- `waiting_human` means human work is outstanding.
- `effect_complete` means the native action's owner confirmed completion.
- `superseded` means a newer input replaced the work.
- `scheduled` means a follow-up is waiting for its original due time.
- `exception_review` means a separate human-work proposal awaits fresh approval.
- `exception_pending` means an approved exception awaits its task receipt.
- `exception_waiting_human` means the exception's confirmed human work remains open.
- `exception_complete` means the owner confirmed the exception task is complete.
- `pursuit_preparing` means the opportunity proposal is being prepared.
- `pursuit_review` means that exact proposal awaits approval.
- `pursuit_pending` means the approved opportunity action awaits its native receipt.
- `pursuit_waiting_human` means discovery work remains open on the confirmed opportunity.
- `pursuit_complete` means the discovery task is complete, not that a sale was won.
- `meeting_pending` means the booking, rescheduling or cancellation outcome is pending or unknown.
- `meeting_complete` means Calendar confirmed the requested booking, rescheduling or cancellation. Inspect the meeting plan for the exact outcome; none proves attendance.
- `meeting_human` means meeting coordination requires human handling.
- `meeting_unavailable` means meeting booking is enabled on the policy but Calendar booking is unavailable in this deployment.

AdminSalesAgentCoverageKind.description:
Authority that supplied the accountable human when this work was admitted.
- `policy`: the published policy fallback supplied the accountable human because no lead owner was recorded.
- `lead_owner`: the recorded CRM lead owner supplied the accountable human.

user_id.description: Active accountable staff user at admission; this snapshot does not assign ownership or prove current availability.

lead_id.description: Retained source lead at admission, absent before source-owned lead creation.

lead_revision.description: CRM revision checked at admission, absent when no lead existed.

version.description: Version of this instruction's execution contract, separate from the enrollment policy contract.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the exact static system instruction text.

coverage.description: Accountable human and source owner snapshot captured before this attempt. Meeting preparation retains the accepted booking attempt snapshot; its lead revision describes booking admission, not a fresh claim. Absent after staff identity erasure or for attempts or originating bookings admitted before coverage capture.

program.description: Admitted input program. Configuration is not proof that any model call occurred.

policy_revision.description: Policy publication that admitted this attempt.

source_policy_revision.description: Original source enrollment policy. A renewed meeting preparation may be admitted by a later policy.

model.description: Requested model configuration captured before inference; returned model remains on each observed call.

provider.description: Provider reported by the configured inference owner. Absent when that owner does not expose inspection.

prompts_reported.description: Whether the configured inference owner supplied the admitted program's instruction fingerprints.

prompts.description: Static instructions available to this attempt. A branch can finish without invoking them; measured calls remain separate. No customer evidence or prompt bodies are included.

complete.description: Whether every decision step returned an accounting report. This does not assert that usage counters or a valid decision were returned.

calls.description: Measured model call attempts, in execution order. An empty complete report means no model call was made.

AdminSalesDemoAgentAttemptOutcome.description:
Recorded outcome of one demo-agent attempt. Admission failures describe the attempt when it finished; inspect the run for current availability.

- `running` is the initial state before a finish is recorded.
- `interrupted` means a later attempt recorded this unfinished attempt as interrupted.
- `inference_failed` means the inference request failed.
- `decision_failed` means the decision could not be validated or applied.
- `stale` means the decision no longer matched the accepted input.
- `decision_accepted` means the decision was saved.
- `deployment_disabled` means deployment capability was disabled before the decision could be saved.
- `policy_changed` means a newer policy prevented the decision from being saved.
- `policy_inactive` means the policy was stopped or expired before the decision could be saved.
- `response_deadline_passed` means the current input deadline passed before the decision could be saved.
- `provider_unavailable` means inference configuration became unavailable before the decision could be saved.
- `sender_changed` means the configured sender changed before the decision could be saved.
- `decision_configuration_changed` means the configured model, effort or prompt changed before the decision could be saved.
- `coverage_unavailable` means named human coverage became unavailable before the decision could be saved.
- `buyer_reply_requires_followthrough` means a buyer reply required human follow-through before the decision could be saved.
- `attempt_limit` means the attempt limit prevented the decision from being saved.
- `source_unavailable` means the source became unavailable before the decision could be saved.
- `research_wait` means the retained decision awaits current research.
- `followthrough_unavailable` means the deployment cannot execute the required buyer follow-through.
- `followup_unavailable` means follow-up capability is disabled by policy or unavailable in this deployment.
- `context_limit` means the retained conversation exceeds the bounded decision context.
- `input_unavailable` means the expected inbound input or follow-up anchor is missing or cannot authorize this work.
- `followup_window_missed` means no permitted sending window remains before the follow-up deadline.
- `turn_limit` means the policy limit for automated conversation turns has been reached.
- `research_unavailable` means required current research cannot be obtained within the permitted research attempt.
- `native_intent_changed` means the retained CRM command no longer matches the current input and admission.
- `qualification_evidence_changed` means the evidence authorizing qualification is no longer current.
- `native_action_refused` means the CRM owner definitively refused the proposed action under current authority.
- `human_takeover` means human handling, a pause or an opt-out prevents the scheduled follow-up.
- `anchor_changed` means the confirmed message anchoring the follow-up no longer matches its retained proof.
- `newer_activity` means newer contact or conversation activity invalidated the retained automated outreach.
- `signup_unavailable` means signup welcome is disabled by policy or unavailable in this deployment.
- `signup_help_denied` means the signup owner no longer authorizes disclosure of the retained help evidence.
- `signup_help_changed` means the retained signup help evidence changed before the action could proceed.
- `signup_help_unavailable` means a reply requiring signup help lacks the matching authorized help-send context.
- `recipient_opted_out` means the current recipient preference forbids the signup outreach.
- `source_changed` means the signup source identity or recipient no longer matches the retained welcome.
- `meeting_unavailable` means meeting booking is enabled on the policy but Calendar booking is unavailable in this deployment.
- `meeting_offer_expired` means the retained meeting offer expired before its reply could be sent.
- `pursuit_admission_changed` means current native authority no longer admits the proposed opportunity pursuit.

source.description: Form or the retained inbound message key supporting the fact.

ready_for_review.description: The AI has gathered basic details for staff review. This is not a qualified lead decision.

needs_human.description: A person was requested or automated engagement could not continue.

AdminSalesDemoAgentAction.description:
Proposed action; inspect its outcome before treating work as completed.

- `reply` proposes a customer response for normal send admission.
- `human` asks for human handling and does not establish an accepted handover.
- `qualify` proposes qualification supported by current evidence and research.
- `handover` proposes requesting human ownership through the task workflow.

actor_id.description: Reviewing staff identity; absent after identity erasure.

source_revision.description: Conversation revision at review admission; the review does not change automation or authorize execution.

identity.description: Immutable configuration captured when the attempt was admitted, including failed or interrupted work. Absent for historical attempts; never reconstructed from current settings.

execution.description: Recorded inference calls and provider usage. Absent for attempts made before accounting or by a worker that did not report it.

finished_at.description: Absent until this attempt finishes or a later attempt records its interruption.

input_key.description: The form, buyer reply or scheduled follow-up evaluated by this attempt.

summary.description: Internal explanation of the proposed action.

blocked_reason.description: Why the proposed action cannot currently proceed.

quality_review.description: Latest explicit staff judgment for this exact attempt. Absent when unreviewed; approval alone never creates a judgment.

reviewable.description: This completed attempt has a retained output eligible for explicit review. Current authority, source retention, conversation revision and latest review are checked again on mutation.

DemoConversationMessageState.description:
Current delivery or transcript state:
- `queued`: waiting for a send attempt or channel readiness.
- `ambiguous`: provider acceptance could not be confirmed; reconciliation is required before another attempt.
- `accepted`: the provider accepted the message, but delivery is not yet confirmed.
- `delivered`: the provider confirmed delivery.
- `failed`: the provider reported a terminal failure.
- `suppressed`: the message will not be sent because automation or phone messaging was stopped.
- `received`: an inbound reply or authoritative staff message recorded in the conversation.

state.description: Current sending state. Accepted and ambiguous sends reconcile after a stop; they cannot be recalled.

category.description: Sending category used for recipient preferences. Signup welcomes use marketing.

surface.description: Sales mailbox selected for this message.

recipient.description: Exact recipient mailbox for the approved message.

created_at.description: When this immutable message was prepared.

AdminSalesAgentPursuitPlan.description: Prepared pursuit. CRM identifiers are TypeIDs, except initial_stage_id, which is the catalog UUID of the stage. opportunity_id is an explicitly selected existing opportunity, absent when preparing a new one. task_id is an existing qualification task to continue, and request_id the exact pending qualification request to supersede, when present.

requested_by.description: Staff requester for an explicit proposal; absent on automatic preparation. The executing principal remains the Sales agent.

AdminSalesDemoAgentEffectState.description:
Handover state. Task completion is reported separately by `task_completed`.

- `requested` means help was requested but no recipient has accepted.
- `accepted` means the recipient accepted the handover.
- `returned` means the requested work was returned to its requester.
- `canceled` means the original handover request was canceled.
- `superseded` means a different request replaced the original handover.
- `erased` means the native owner removed the referenced source or record; retained identifiers are withheld.

AdminSalesDemoAgentEffectReceipt.description: Native CRM effect receipt. lead_id is a CRM lead TypeID, present for qualified effects; source-only handovers may have no lead. opportunity_id is the exact opportunity, as an opportunity TypeID, confirmed by the native action receipt. task_id and request_id are the task and handover request TypeIDs.

qualified.description: The native CRM owner atomically qualified the confirmed lead.

task_completed.description: Current completion of the real task, independent of handover acceptance.

AdminSalesDemoAgentInputState.description:
- `scheduled` means a follow-up is waiting for its due time.
- `pending` means the input awaits evaluation.
- `research_wait` means the retained decision awaits research.
- `decision` means a decision was retained for this input.
- `needs_approval` means a person must approve the exact proposed action.
- `reply_queued` means a customer response awaits its sending outcome.
- `effect_pending` means a native action awaits a confirmed outcome.
- `waiting_human` means human work remains outstanding.
- `effect_complete` means the native action's owner confirmed completion.
- `blocked` means the input cannot currently proceed.
- `superseded` means a newer input replaced this work.
- `exception_review` means a separate human-work proposal awaits fresh approval; the original reply decision remains unchanged.
- `exception_pending` means the approved exception awaits its native task receipt.
- `exception_waiting_human` means the exception has confirmed human work that remains open.
- `exception_complete` means the native owner confirmed completion of that exception task.
- `pursuit_preparing` means the exact opportunity and task proposal is being prepared.
- `pursuit_review` means that proposal requires explicit approval.
- `pursuit_pending` means the approved pursuit awaits its native receipt.
- `pursuit_waiting_human` means the opportunity exists and discovery work remains open.
- `pursuit_complete` means the native owner confirmed discovery task completion, not a sale or meeting attendance.
- `meeting_pending` means the booking, rescheduling or cancellation outcome is pending or unknown.
- `meeting_complete` means Calendar confirmed the requested booking, rescheduling or cancellation. Inspect the meeting plan for the exact outcome; none proves attendance.
- `meeting_human` means meeting coordination requires human handling.

AdminSalesSignupHelpState.description: Whether current customer access and domain state could be read. Denied means access could not be established; unavailable means the check could not finish.

domain_id.description: The same domain referenced by the retained decision. Omitted unless current access is available.

ready.description: Whether the current domain configuration has verified DKIM, DMARC and its active return path. Omitted unless current access is available. This does not establish email delivery.

observed_at.description: When current owner state was read or the read failed. This read does not start a new DNS verification.

checked_at.description: Last DNS verification check time reported by the domain owner. Omitted when unknown or current access is unavailable.

AdminSalesAgentMeetingState.description:
- `clarification` means the buyer must clarify their meeting request.
- `declined` means the buyer declined meeting coordination.
- `offered` means exact slots are prepared; the separate send receipt establishes delivery.
- `pending` means booking, rescheduling or cancellation awaits approval or processing, not confirmation.
- `unknown` means the provider outcome remains unresolved.
- `booked` means Calendar confirmed the exact owned event; it does not establish attendee acceptance or attendance, or replace a current Calendar observation.
- `cancelled` means Calendar confirmed cancellation of the exact existing event; a later external restoration requires a fresh current observation.
- `rescheduled` means Calendar confirmed the selected replacement time for the exact existing event; inspect current Calendar state for later changes.
- `needs_human` means coordination requires human handling.

AdminSalesAgentMeetingSlotID.description:
Identifier within one immutable meeting offer.
- `1` is the first offered slot.
- `2` is the second offered slot.
- `3` is the third offered slot.

time_zone.description: IANA timezone used to present the offer to the buyer.

input_key.description: Retained input that prepared these exact slots; preparation does not prove message delivery.

expires_at.description: Latest time this offer may be selected; booking still requires current admission.

input_key.description: Retained buyer input that produced the original booking.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone retained on the original booking.

AdminSalesAgentMeetingPlan.description: Meeting coordination state. task_id is the accepted discovery task, as a CRM task TypeID, that owns the meeting host.

reason.description: Current coordination or booking refusal reason when present.

rescheduling.description: Original booking for the replacement-time offer and selected rescheduling request, not rescheduling confirmation.

cancellation.description: Exact existing booking selected for cancellation, not cancellation confirmation.

selection.description: Buyer's selection within the retained offer, when present.

deadline.description: Latest time this input can start its planned action. A separate human-work exception may be accepted while the published policy remains active; a pursuit has no customer-facing send.

blocked_reason.description: Why this retained input currently needs attention.

anchor_message_key.description: The exact delivered outbound message that a scheduled follow-up follows.

anchor_confirmed_at.description: When delivery of the anchor message was confirmed.

due_at.description: Original scheduled send time for a welcome or follow-up, within permitted working hours. Later holds do not reset it.

send_intent.description: Exact prepared welcome message. A template-based welcome has no model attempt.

signup_help_observation.description: Current domain setup for a retained signup-help decision, read independently of that decision.

pursuit.description: Exact prepared opportunity and discovery task choice; preparation alone confirms no native effect.

coverage_user_id.description: Published policy fallback for unclaimed work. Each attempt's identity records the actually admitted accountable human when available.

source_kind.description: Original acquisition type, including inquiry for enrollments created before signup support.

expected_review_id.description: Latest review ID, or explicit null for the first review. Current output ownership is revalidated before replay.

expected_revision.description: Current conversation revision from the revision field returned by getAdminSalesAutomation (GET /admin/sales/inbound/{thread_id}/automation), using the same thread_id as this review request. New reviews require that conversation revision to remain current even when the selected attempt has not changed; other conversation activity requires refreshing the review form. Exact retained request replay is checked before this revision fence.

expected_review_id.description: The quality_review.id for this attempt returned by getAdminSalesDemoAgentRun (GET /admin/sales/inbound/{thread_id}/agent-run), or null when that attempt has no quality_review. A replacement appends a new review and conflicts if another review has intervened.

AdminSalesAutomationMode.description: Whether this demo conversation uses human replies, reviewed AI replies, or automatic AI replies.

AdminSalesAutomationState.description: Current execution state for this conversation identity.

AdminSalesAutomationAction.description:
The exact action authorized by a reviewed proposal.
- `reply` approves the retained customer message.
- `qualify` approves evidenced qualification through the native owner.
- `handover` approves a handover request, not its acceptance.
- `human` approves creation of covered human work.
- `pursue` approves an owner-prepared opportunity and discovery task.
- `meeting_reschedule` approves the selected replacement time for the exact existing booking, not rescheduling confirmation.
- `meeting_cancel` approves cancellation of the exact existing booking, not cancellation confirmation.
- `meeting` approves the selected booking request, not booking confirmation.

input_key.description: Exact identity of the retained input or scheduled welcome for the proposed action.

body.description: Exact proposed message, empty when only a native action is proposed.

action.description: Absent on older reply-only proposals.

summary.description: Internal action explanation, never customer reply text.

send_intent.description: Exact prepared welcome message. A template-based welcome has no model attempt.

pursuit.description: Exact prepared opportunity and discovery task choice; preparation alone confirms no native effect.

AdminSalesAIHandlingOperation.description: A handling change or approval; neither is an output quality rating.

actor_id.description: Acting staff identity; absent after identity erasure.

input_key.description: Exact input affected when known; absent for source-wide handling changes without a retained current input.

paused.description: Whether new automation work is paused for this identity.

available.description: Whether this conversation can change handling. AI execution also requires a configured qualifier.

automatic_allowed.description: Whether Automatic handling is permitted by the enrollment policy ceiling. True when no current demo-agent enrollment exists, without requiring a published policy. For an enrolled source, true only when the current policy matches the enrollment revision, is enabled and uses Automatic mode. This does not indicate conversation availability or AI execution readiness.

revision.description: Current conversation revision required when changing handling or approving a reply.

last_intervention.description: Latest retained handling change or approval. Absent when no intervention has been recorded.

paused.description: Pause new automation work while keeping the selected handling mode.

expected_revision.description: Conversation revision shown to the operator.

intervention_reason.description: Operator-reported reason for this handling decision. Omission records unknown; this is not an output usefulness review.

input_key.description: Exact retained input identity shown with the proposed action.

expected_revision.description: Conversation revision shown with the proposed action.

expected_action.description: Exact action shown in the reviewed proposal. Omission permits only a reply; native and meeting actions require an explicit match.

intervention_reason.description: Operator-reported reason for this handling decision. Omission records unknown; this is not an output usefulness review.

AdminSalesExternalEmailState.description: Coverage of readable Attio email metadata. `checked` means all eligible identity lookups completed within the reported bounds, including when no person or emails matched; it does not establish that all mailbox activity is synchronized to Attio. `partial` means a lookup limit, ambiguous identity, or upstream failure prevented complete coverage. `unavailable` means the integration is not configured, authorization prevents the lookup, or the lookup failed without readable results; `reason` distinguishes these conditions. `not_applicable` means the contact has no email address to query. Any state can contain no events.

id.description: Opaque identity for deduplicating Attio metadata. This is not a Bird message ID.

sent_at.description: When the email was sent, or when the summarized interaction occurred.

interaction_summary.description: True for a first or latest email interaction from the person record. Direction, subject and full history are unavailable for these summaries.

actor_name.description: Workspace member associated with an interaction summary; not necessarily the sender.

subject.description: Subject only when the Attio credential may read it. Message bodies are never returned.

person_url.description: Verified Attio person record URL when available.

reason.description: Machine-readable explanation of incomplete coverage.

checked_at.description: When Bird began evaluating this enrichment request, including local authorization or configuration checks that prevent a remote lookup.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound of the metadata lookup.

through.description: Exclusive upper bound of the metadata lookup.

AdminSalesCRMReference.description: Reference to a CRM lead, person, company or owner. The id is that record's TypeID, or the owner's member TypeID; a legacy stored value that is not a UUID is returned unchanged.

AdminSalesInboundMessage.description:
One message in the staff transcript. Unlike the visitor's own confirmation page,
this carries the message text: the mailbox and senders on this conversation are
Bird's, so staff operating the intake are reading Bird's own correspondence.

body.description: Message text. Absent when the provider retains the body and Bird did not store it.

author_name.description: Who sent a staff message. Present only on a message a person sent, and currently names the sales team rather than the individual, because the sender is not recorded.

DemoContactStatus.description: Whether the contact is suitable, unsuitable, or could not be confirmed.

reason.description: Reason for the validation result.

suggestion.description: Suggested correction for the requester to review.

can_submit.description: Whether neither contact has been identified as unsuitable. Unconfirmed contacts can be submitted for follow-up.

demo_submissions.description: Original demo form submissions associated with these conversation identities. Cold inbound contacts have no submissions.

identities.description: Original inbox identities grouped by a uniquely verified CRM person. Replies and personal drafts retain their original identity.

external_email.description: Present when enrichment is external_email or all, including failed lookups. Omitted when another enrichment is selected.

messages_before_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; present when older messages exist. Pass as messages_before to load the previous page.

history_truncated.description: The channel history read stopped at a result or time limit. More retained history may exist; this flag does not establish that additional messages exist.

history_unavailable_channels.description: Sales channels whose retained history could not be loaded.

history_unavailable.description: At least one sales channel history could not be read. The transcript may be incomplete.

messages.description: Retained channel history and queued replies, oldest first. Check history flags for incomplete results.

messaging_consent.description: Whether the contact consented to phone messaging about this request.

phone_suppressed.description: Whether automated phone follow-up has stopped.

reply_channels.description:
Channels a staff reply may use on this thread right now. A channel is absent
when its own preconditions are unmet, so a client offers only what is listed
rather than deciding eligibility itself.

AdminSalesEmailState.description: original contains the stored email. preview contains an unsent message and must not be presented as delivered content. pending means content is not ready and may be retried. unavailable means the original cannot currently be retrieved; retry later, without substituting a reconstructed message. expired means the channel retention period has ended and retrying cannot restore the original.

source_identity_id.description: Original inbox identity to which this note belongs.

disabled_reason.description: Why lead creation is unavailable for this contact, independently of staff permissions.

managed_automatically.description: This demo inquiry is created and synchronized automatically.

person_id.description: CRM person TypeID. A legacy stored value that is not a UUID is returned unchanged.

lead_id.description: CRM lead TypeID. A legacy stored value that is not a UUID is returned unchanged.

can_qualify.description: Whether an existing linked lead can be qualified.

reason.description: Required explanation for rejecting the conversation.

unqualified_reason_id.description: Current CRM rejection reason, required when rejecting a linked lead.

crm_lead_id.description: CRM lead TypeID. A legacy stored value that is not a UUID is returned unchanged.

reply_reason.description: Why a typed WhatsApp reply is unavailable.

template_reason.description: Why an approved WhatsApp template cannot be sent.

template_send.description: Sales sends require the template ID and an explicitly selected approved language. Slug lookup and default-language fallback are not supported by this endpoint. Components contain the filled values for that selection.

preview.description: The rendered template preview retained with the conversation.

activity_version.description: Echo the compose activity_version captured when drafting. Omission preserves legacy behavior without an activity freshness check. On E01009, refresh and review the conversation before sending with a new idempotency key.

sender_reference.description: Echo the selected shared_senders reference from compose. Omission selects the existing conversation sender automatically; a supplied reference must still match that sender.

reply_draft_id.description: Optional declared AI draft source. Send admission validates the same conversation and channel and records the accepted draft attempt and body match when available. This does not imply sending or delivery; missing optional capture remains unknown.

activity_version.description: Echo the compose activity_version captured when drafting. Omission preserves legacy behavior without an activity freshness check. On E01009, refresh and review the conversation before sending with a new idempotency key.

sender_reference.description: Echo the selected shared_senders reference from compose. Omission selects the existing conversation sender automatically; a supplied reference must still match that sender.

AdminSalesDocumentState.description: draft: editable authored content. in_review: content is pinned and cannot be edited. changes_requested: returned content may be edited or resubmitted. approved: independently reviewed content; saving creates a new draft. archived: read-only content that cannot receive comments.

AdminSalesDocumentCategory.description: Sales Studio proposals, mutual action plans and outreach documents.

review_revision.description: Content revision pinned by the most recent review request. May remain after withdrawal or a decision; absent before review or after editing. It is not an active-review identity.

review_quote_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of quote inputs pinned by the most recent review request. Absent for unquoted documents or when no quote review pin exists. May remain after withdrawal or a decision.

review_stale.description: True when the attached quote differs from the retained review_quote_fingerprint, including after a decision or withdrawal. Computed on list and detail; false when no quote review pin exists. Does not indicate an active review by itself.

current_review_id.description: ID of the active request_review event. Present only while a current review request exists; cleared by withdrawal, completed review, archive or edits. Partial shared approval votes retain it. Approve and request_changes must supply this exact ID as expected_review_id.

approval_request_id.description: Most recent shared approval request. Retained after decisions, withdrawal and edits. Absent for documents that have only used legacy reviews.

viewer_has_authored.description: Whether the authenticated caller authored any immutable revision of this document. Derived from full revision history, not the latest updater or review actor. True callers cannot independently review this document.

id.description: Nonblank identifier, unique within the document. The service limits this value to 100 UTF-8 bytes; maxLength also bounds characters.

title.description: Optional block title, up to 200 characters. Omission is stored as an empty string. Empty strings are omitted from responses.

body.description: Optional authored text, up to 20,000 characters. Omission is stored as an empty string. Empty strings are omitted from responses. Counts toward the document aggregate UTF-8 byte limit.

blocks.description: At most 100 ordered blocks. Block IDs must be unique within the document.

AdminSalesDocumentContent.description: Ordered authored blocks using schema version 1. Across all blocks, the combined UTF-8 bytes of title and body must not exceed 1,000,000. This aggregate byte limit is enforced by the service independently of the 2,500,000-byte HTTP body limit.

quote_id.description: Optional existing quote on deal_id. A quote from another deal returns 422. Omit for an unquoted document.

AdminSalesDocumentCreate.description: Create a Sales Studio draft. Deal, optional quote, and kind cannot change after creation. Any associated quote must belong to the selected deal.

AdminSalesDocumentAction.description: request_review: pin current content and attached quote for review. withdraw: return an active review to draft. request_changes: independently return reviewed content for editing. approve: independently approve the pinned content and unchanged quote snapshot. archive: make a document read-only outside active review. No action grants quote approval, signature, delivery or billing authority.

AdminSalesDocumentReviewAction.description: approve: independently approve the active review. request_changes: independently return the active review for editing. Both actions require expected_review_id.

note.description: Reason for requesting changes. Required and nonblank for request_changes on a document with an approval_request_id; optional for legacy reviews.

expected_review_id.description: Required for approve, request_changes or withdraw. Must match current_review_id from the document being reviewed.

AdminLegalClauseCategory.description: The clause's category in the library.

key.description: Permanent identifier that templates and quote rounds reference.

retired_at.description: When the clause was retired. Null while it is in use.

AdminLegalClause.description: A clause in the Legal library.

label.description: Short name a seller picks the fallback by.

body.description: Markdown with {{variable}} placeholders. The supported variables are `{{customer_name}}`, `{{customer_address}}`, `{{issuing_entity_name}}`, `{{issuing_entity_address}}`, `{{starts_on}}`, `{{ends_on}}`, `{{term_months}}`, `{{notice_days}}`, `{{payment_terms_days}}`, `{{cola_pct}}`, `{{commit_amount}}`, `{{commit_period}}`.

AdminLegalClauseFallback.description: A pre-approved deviation a seller may pick without review.

entity_id.description: Business entity this body is for. Omit or send null for the common body, used when the issuing entity has no body of its own.

standard.description: Markdown with {{variable}} placeholders. The supported variables are `{{customer_name}}`, `{{customer_address}}`, `{{issuing_entity_name}}`, `{{issuing_entity_address}}`, `{{starts_on}}`, `{{ends_on}}`, `{{term_months}}`, `{{notice_days}}`, `{{payment_terms_days}}`, `{{cola_pct}}`, `{{commit_amount}}`, `{{commit_period}}`.

AdminLegalClauseBody.description: The clause text for one issuing entity. Each entity, and the common body, appears at most once per version.

key.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Cannot change after creation.

AdminLegalClauseCreate.description: Create a clause with its first draft version.

AdminLegalVersionStatus.description: draft: editable and publishable. in_review: awaiting Legal review and locked. active: the approved version; at most one per clause or template. superseded: a formerly active version. rejected: refused in review; terminal.

mandatory.description: A template slot for this clause cannot be removed from a quote round while this version is pinned.

custom_allowed.description: Whether a seller may propose custom text. False makes the fallback ladder exhaustive.

change_note.description: What changed from the previous version. Empty when none was given.

approval_request_id.description: The shared approval request for the latest publish. Null until the version is first published.

activated_at.description: When Legal approved the version. Null until approved.

AdminLegalClauseVersion.description: One version of a clause. Only a draft can be edited; a published version never changes text.

version.description: The template version that places the clause.

status.description: Status of that template version, either active or in review.

AdminLegalClauseTemplateUse.description: An unretired template whose active or in-review version places the clause.

templates.description: Templates whose active or in-review version places this clause, one entry per template version. A clause cannot be retired while this list is non-empty.

AdminLegalClauseDetail.description: A clause with its version history and the templates that place it.

AdminLegalClauseVersionUpdate.description: Replace the content of a draft clause version.

key.description: Permanent identifier for the template.

is_default.description: Whether this is the default template. At most one unretired template is the default.

retired_at.description: When the template was retired. Null while it is in use.

AdminOrderFormTemplate.description: An order-form template in the Legal library.

AdminOrderFormFact.description: The quote fact a slot condition reads.

equals.description: prepaid or invoiced for payment; true or false for auto_renew and has_commit; a quotable product slug for product_quoted.

AdminOrderFormCondition.description: The slot appears only when the fact equals this value.

AdminOrderFormSection.description: Which order-form section the clause belongs to. Recorded on the template version and read from a round's pinned version. `legal_terms` is for standing terms, `services_notes` for notes on the Services table, and `specific_terms` for the order-form specific terms.

clause_key.description: Key of the clause this slot places.

condition.description: When the slot applies. Null places the clause on every order form.

AdminOrderFormSlot.description: One clause position in a template. A clause appears at most once per template.

key.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Cannot change after creation.

AdminOrderFormTemplateCreate.description: Create an order-form template with its first draft version.

change_note.description: What changed from the previous version. Empty when none was given.

approval_request_id.description: The shared approval request for the latest publish. Null until the version is first published.

activated_at.description: When Legal approved the version. Null until approved.

AdminOrderFormTemplateVersion.description: One version of an order-form template. Only a draft can be edited.

AdminOrderFormTemplateDetail.description: An order-form template with its version history.

AdminOrderFormTemplateVersionUpdate.description: Replace the slots of a draft template version.

organization_id.description: The organization the deal is for. Null for a prospect that has no organization yet.

prospect_name.description: Display name of the prospect. Empty once the deal is bound to an organization.

issuing_entity_id.description: The Bird business entity that issues a prospect deal's order form. Always null on an organization's deal, which uses the organization's own business entity.

template_id.description: The order-form template the deal's new quote rounds pin. Null until the deal's first round adopts the library's default template or staff choose one.

organization_id.description: The organization the deal is for. Omit for a prospect and set prospect_name instead.

prospect_name.description: Display name of the prospect. Required when no organization is set.

owner_user_id.description: The staff member who owns the deal. Defaults to the caller.

currency_code.description: Deal currency. Defaults to EUR.

issuing_entity_id.description: The Bird business entity that issues a prospect deal's order form. Rejected when organization_id is set, since an organization's deal uses its own business entity.

AdminDealMarginBand.description: Margin band of an offer against its margin floor. `negative` means the offer prices below cost, `thin` that the margin is positive but below the floor, `healthy` that the margin clears the floor.

unit_cost.description: Unit cost as a decimal string. Only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

floor_price.description: The lowest offer that still meets the product's margin floor, as a decimal string. Cost-derivable (equals the unit cost at a 0 bps floor), so only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

margin_bps.description: Margin of the checked offer in basis points of the offer. Cost-derivable given the caller-supplied offer, so only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

band.description: Margin band of the checked offer against the product's floor.

verdict.description: Whether the offer can be self-approved (`ok`) or needs a second approver (`needs_approval`).

cost_book_version_id.description: The active cost book version the check was computed against.

stale.description: Whether the cost book's active version is older than its freshness policy.

explanation.description: Human-readable summary of how the verdict was reached. Margin and floor numbers appear only for callers allowed to see raw route costs.
explanation.example: Margin 2667 bps clears the 500 bps floor (cost version v3, fresh).

updated_by.description: Staff user who last set the signatory.

updated_at.description: When the signatory was last set.

AdminDealFamily.description: Pricing family of a quote section and its products. The family fixes how lines are quantified and billed: `usage` prices per message or event, `session` per minute with a billing increment, `recurring` as a fee per unit per catalog billing period, `one_time` as a single fee per occurrence, and `plan` as a platform plan subscription.

field.description: The dimension key, as used in a line's dims.

label.description: Display label for the dimension.

BillingPricingModel.description:
How this product is priced.

- `plan`: it comes with the organization's subscribed plan, with usage tracked
  against that plan's included allowance.
- `metered`: it is billed per unit beyond any included allowance.
- `rate_card`: the per-unit price varies by attributes of the usage, such as
  destination, instead of being flat.
- `unit_subscription`: it is a standalone add-on billed as its own recurring
  subscription, independent of the plan.
- `custom`: a pricing arrangement that does not fit the other models.
- `counter`: usage is recorded without enforcing a spending cap or blocking
  requests.

AdminDealQuotableProduct.description: A product available for quoting. `pricing_interval` and `intervals_per_charge` are present together only when `family` is `recurring`. `plan_commercial_product_id` and `plan_interval` are present together only when the product has a plan configuration.

slug.description: Stable identifier of the product.

name.description: Display name of the product.

dims.description: The product's pricing dimensions, in display order.

patterns.description: The dimension sets a usage, session, or plan overage line may state, one per rate-card matching pattern, in the order the price resolver tries them; the first pattern with a matching row wins. The line's dimensions must equal exactly one of them. Empty when the product has no matching spec.

intervals_per_charge.description: Pricing intervals in one recurring billing period; present only when `family` is `recurring`.

data.description: The products a deal can quote, ordered by pricing family.

AdminDealDims.description: Pricing dimension values for a line, keyed by the product's pricing dimensions. A subset is accepted when the remaining dimensions follow the product's catalog rows.

AdminDealIncrement.description: Billing increment for a per-minute line — how call duration rounds up when billed.

initial_seconds.description: Seconds billed for the first increment of a call.

continuation_seconds.description: Seconds billed for each increment after the first.

AdminDealCatalogRow.description: One dimension combination of a product's default rate card, priced in the requested currency when the card prices it there.

labels.description: Display label for each value in dims, keyed by the same dimension.

unit_price.description: The catalog unit price as a decimal string in the requested currency. Absent when the row has no price in that currency.

increment.description: For per-minute products, the billing increment the row carries.

data.description: The product's catalog rows in the requested currency.

AdminDealStaffName.description: A staff member's display identity, resolved for rendering on deal surfaces.

email.description: The staff member's login email, used as their display name.

owner_user_id.description: Reassign the deal to another staff member.

organization_id.description: Bind a prospect deal to an organization. One-way; a deal already bound to a different organization is rejected.

issuing_entity_id.description: Set on a prospect deal only; null clears it. Must be null or omitted alongside organization_id, since binding the deal to an organization clears it.

template_id.description: The order-form template new quote rounds pin. Must be unretired and have a published version. Switching it also re-pins the deal's latest round when that round is a draft, keeping its selections by clause key; a submitted round keeps the template it was reviewed against. Null clears the choice, so the next round adopts the library's default template; it also unpins the deal's latest round when that round is a draft, dropping its clause selections, while a submitted round keeps its pin. Setting it answers 409 while order forms are disabled.

rates.description: Display-only FX rates keyed by currency pair, such as EURUSD.

as_of.description: The date the FX rates were taken, as YYYY-MM-DD.

meta_rebate_pct.description: Assumed Meta rebate applied to the WhatsApp tariff, as a percentage.

AdminDealQuoteCommitPeriodType.description: How a minimum commit settles. `monthly` floors each period at the greater of the commit and actual spend, so a shortfall is topped up every month; `annual` settles once as a year-end true-up against cumulative spend.

AdminDealQuoteCommit.description: Minimum spend the customer commits to. The only commercial term that provisions: accepting the quote compiles it into a billing minimum commit.

amount.description: Committed spend per period, as a positive decimal string of at most 999999999999.999999 with at most six decimal places, in the deal's currency.

term_months.description: How many months the commitment runs for.

AdminDealQuoteSupport.description: Support commitment, recorded and fulfilled manually. Billing carries no support product, quota or SLA construct, so the tier is the name used in the order form rather than a catalog reference.

tier.description: The agreed support tier, as named in the order form.

notes.description: Caveats on the tier that the order form spells out.

AdminDealQuotePaymentTerms.description: How the customer settles. Recorded for the proposal pack and the close checklist; neither value changes billing behaviour, and a credit limit is set through the wallet rather than on the quote.

AdminDealQuoteTerms.description:
Commercial terms of the quote round, alongside its prices. A quote may state none of them. Amounts are decimal strings in the deal's own currency, which the deal fixes. The contract terms are the period (`starts_on` and `term_months`, with the derived `ends_on`), `auto_renew`, `notice_days`, `payment_terms_days`, `cola_bps` and `credit_limit`; a template round's order form prints them.

A read states every term, so `null` means the quote carries none.

validity_days.description: How long the quote stands after it is sent. Zero when unstated.

starts_on.description: First day of the contract period.

term_months.description: Length of the contract in whole calendar months from `starts_on`, which it requires.

ends_on.description: Last day of the contract, inclusive, derived from `starts_on` and `term_months`. Null until both are stated. It is the day before billing's last period boundary, which falls on the start's day of the month or, when the final month lacks that day, on the month's last day.

auto_renew.description: Whether the contract renews at the end of its period.

notice_days.description: Days before the contract ends by which either party must give notice not to renew.

payment_terms_days.description: Days after an invoice is issued that payment is due. An invoiced quote states 1 to 180 days, the most a contract can record.

cola_bps.description: Cost-of-living adjustment in basis points; 300 is 3.00%.

credit_limit.description: The most an invoiced customer may owe, as a positive decimal of at most 999999999999.999999 with at most six decimal places, in the deal's currency. Required at submit when `payment` is `invoiced`. Execution takes it for the contract when the round is template-backed; for a quote without a template, Finance supplies it at execution.

approval_request_id.description: Most recent approval request for this quote, retained after completion. Omitted for quotes that have not entered shared approval.

returned_note.description: Explanation from the approval stage that returned this quote for changes. Omitted unless the quote was sent back.

cost_book_version_ids.description: The cost book version pinned per product when the round was opened. Margins stay reproducible against these versions after costs move.

approved_by.description: The staff member who approved the quote.

notes.example: Round 2 after volume commitment moved up.

template_version_id.description: The order-form template version the round is pinned to; its clause selections derive from this version. Null for a round with no order form, such as one opened before order forms were enabled.

order_form_artifact_id.description: The round's stored order form, an `order_form_pdf` artifact. Null until it is stored; a round pinned to a template cannot be marked `sent` before then.

signing_authorized_by.description: The staff member holding `admin:contracts` write who authorized the round for signature because no approver held that authority. DocuSign completion records the contract as them. Null until someone authorizes the round.

signing_authorized_at.description: When `signing_authorized_by` authorized the round. Null until someone authorizes the round.

data.description: All quote rounds of the deal, newest first.

source_quote_id.description: The quote to copy lines and assumptions forward from. Defaults to the deal's latest round.

title.description: Section heading as it appears on the quote and the proposal. Unique within the quote.

sort_order.description: Display position of the section, following the order sections were submitted in.

AdminDealIncludedLanding.description: How included units are honored once the deal is live. `fold_in` lowers the contractual unit price so the inclusion is built into the billed rate; `credit` keeps the offered price as the billed rate and grants the inclusion's value as a one-time account credit at go-live. `entitlement` grants included units per plan period and applies only to a metered product included in its plan section. The metered product must appear in the selected plan product's `entitled_product_ids`.

group_id.description: The retired blend the line belongs to. Null for a standalone line.

product_id.description: The priced product. Every line carries either a product or a grant key, never both.

product_name.description: Display name of the priced product.

grant_key.description: For grant lines, the quota or entitlement being granted instead of a priced product.

dims_display.description: Human-readable rendering of the line's pricing dimensions, such as the destination country's name.

quantity.description: Committed monthly quantity in the section's unit — events, minutes, units, or fee occurrences; the granted value on a grant line. Null on a retired blend's member, whose group carried the volume.

current_price.description: The customer's current unit price as a decimal string. Null when unknown.

offer.description: Offered unit price as a decimal string. Null when the line carries no offer, such as the WhatsApp member of a retired blend.

offer_increment.description: For per-minute lines, the billing increment as initial and continuation seconds. Null for other lines.

included_qty.description: Units included at no charge, valued at the offered price when the quote is checked against margin floors.

sort_order.description: Display position of the line within its section, following the order lines were submitted in.

AdminDealLineGroup.description: A retired blended SMS and WhatsApp price, kept readable until every quote holding one is re-priced.

kind.description: How the group's single price was split across its member lines. `blend` covered a country's SMS and WhatsApp traffic.

offer.description: The single offered unit price covering all member lines, as a decimal string.

quantity.description: Total committed monthly volume the group price covers.

sections.description: The quote's sections in display order.

lines.description: The quote's stored lines in display order, section by section.

groups.description: Blended SMS and WhatsApp prices a quote held before blends were retired. A quote with any group cannot be submitted, sent or signed until its usage section is replaced with explicit lines, which removes them. A new round copies its source round's groups, so it stays blocked until re-priced the same way.

AdminDealOfferEvaluation.description: A line's offered price checked against the line's unit cost and the product's margin floor.

offer.description: The offered unit price as a decimal string.

margin.description: Per-unit margin of this offer against its cost basis as a decimal string. Null when the unit cost is missing. Cost-derived, so only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

margin_bps.description: Margin in basis points of this offer. Cost-derived, so only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

band.description: Margin band of this offer against its floor. Null when the margin cannot be evaluated.

below_floor.description: Whether this offer prices below its margin floor.

coordinates.description: The number of costed combinations (for example each country) the line covers, not counting its own row or combinations another line on the quote prices first.

worst.description: The combination the line's cost and margin come from, keyed by pricing dimension. The line's own dimensions when its own row costs the most, otherwise the costliest covered combination.

line_id.description: The stored line this row was computed from. Null for what-if rows that are not persisted.

country_code.description: The line's country dimension value. Null for lines without one (grants, country-less products).

offer.description: The line's offered unit price as a decimal string. Null when the line carries no offer.

unit_cost.description: The unit cost the offer is checked against, as a decimal string. A WhatsApp line's cost is net of the Meta rebate, and a line leaving a pricing dimension open is costed at its costliest covered combination. Null when the pinned cost book prices nothing for the line. Only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

list_price.description: The product's list price for the line's dimensions as a decimal string. Null when no list price matches.

margin.description: Per-unit margin (offer minus unit cost) as a decimal string. Null when the margin cannot be evaluated. Cost-derived, so only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

margin_bps.description: Margin in basis points of the offer. Cost-derived, so only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

margin_total.description: Monthly margin (per-unit margin times monthly volume) as a decimal string. Cost-derived, so only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

savings.description: Per-unit savings against the customer's current price as a decimal string. Null when the current price is unknown.

savings_total.description: Monthly savings (per-unit savings times monthly volume) as a decimal string.

offer_eval.description: The offer's floor evaluation against the line's unit cost. Null when the line carries no offer.

band.description: The offer's margin band against the product's floor. Null when there is no band to report: the line carries no offer, its unit cost is missing, or its family is not priced yet.

below_floor.description: Whether the line's offer needs a second approver: it prices below its margin floor, or it cannot be evaluated because the unit cost is missing or the family is not priced yet. False for a line without an offer, though such a line can still hold the quote back: submit refuses a usage line without one (a retired blend's WhatsApp member among them), and a grant line still routes the quote to a second approver.

flags.description: Data gaps on the line, such as a missing cost or list price. `retired_blend` marks a member of a blended SMS and WhatsApp price, which must be replaced with explicit lines before the quote can be submitted, sent or signed.

coverage.description: Set when a usage line leaves a pricing dimension open, such as WhatsApp marketing across every country, and the cost book prices at least one combination it covers. Its cost and margin are the costliest of its own row and those combinations. Null or absent for a line that names every dimension, or whose covered combinations have no cost. Cost-derived, so only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

monthly_volume.description: Total committed monthly volume from usage-family lines and legacy lines without a family, excluding session volumes and recurring, one-time and plan quantities.

margin_total.description: Monthly margin subtotal for usage and recurring products billed every one calendar month, excluding one-time fees and other billing periods as a decimal string. Null when no line is evaluable. Cost-derived, so only present for callers allowed to see raw route costs.

savings_total.description: Monthly savings subtotal for usage and recurring products billed every one calendar month with a known published list price, excluding one-time fees and other billing periods as a decimal string.

fixed_total_over_term.description: Total of every plan, recurring and one-time fee over the round's contract term, as a decimal string in the deal's currency; the amount the order form prints as due over the term. Null when the round states no term, no fixed-fee line, or its term amounts cannot be computed (a missing price or quantity, an indivisible term, an unquotable product).

AdminDealQuoteDetail.description: A quote round with its stored content plus the pricing computed on read.

computed_lines.description: Per-line pricing derived from the pinned cost versions, the active list prices, and the quote's assumptions. Computed on read, never stored.

AdminDealQuoteTermsUpdate.description: A patch of the quote round's commercial terms, in the shape a read returns less the derived `ends_on`, so a read without it can be echoed back. Omitting a member leaves it unchanged and sending a value replaces it. Sending `null` clears the member, except `validity_days`: it is a non-nullable integer, so it is changed only by sending a number (zero means unstated) and cannot be cleared with `null`.

validity_days.description: How long the quote stands after it is sent. Zero when unstated.

starts_on.description: First day of the contract period.

term_months.description: Length of the contract in whole calendar months from `starts_on`, which it requires.

auto_renew.description: Whether the contract renews at the end of its period.

notice_days.description: Days before the contract ends by which either party must give notice not to renew.

payment_terms_days.description: Days after an invoice is issued that payment is due. An invoiced quote states 1 to 180 days, the most a contract can record.

cola_bps.description: Cost-of-living adjustment in basis points; 300 is 3.00%.

credit_limit.description: The most an invoiced customer may owe, as a positive decimal of at most 999999999999.999999 with at most six decimal places, in the deal's currency. Required at submit when `payment` is `invoiced`. Execution takes it for the contract when the round is template-backed; for a quote without a template, Finance supplies it at execution.

notes.example: Round 2 after volume commitment moved up.

product_id.description: The priced product. Provide either a product or a grant key, never both.

grant_key.description: For grant lines in a plan section, the quota or entitlement to grant instead of a priced product.

quantity.description: Committed monthly quantity in the section's unit — events, minutes, units, or fee occurrences; the granted value on a grant line.

current_price.description: The customer's current unit price as a decimal string. Null when unknown.

offer.description: Offered unit price as a decimal string.

offer_increment.description: For per-minute lines, the billing increment as initial and continuation seconds.

included_qty.description: Units included at no charge. Valued at the offered price when the quote is checked against margin floors.

title.description: Section heading as it appears on the quote and the proposal. Unique within the quote, at most one section per family.

lines.description: The section's lines, in display order.

sections.description: The full section set, in display order. Replaces every existing section, line, and group of the quote.

AdminDealQuoteClauseRung.description: standard: the clause's approved text. fallback: one of its pre-approved deviations, named by `fallback_index`. custom: the seller's own text, which needs a justification and Legal review.

label.description: Short name a seller picks the fallback by.

AdminDealQuoteClauseFallback.description: One pre-approved deviation of the pinned clause version, in ladder order. Its position is the `fallback_index` that selects it.

key.description: The clause's stable key in the legal library.

clause_version_id.description: The clause version this row is pinned to. A template row keeps the version the round's template pinned; an added clause pins the version that was active when it was added.

version.description: Number of the pinned clause version.

fallback_index.description: Position in `fallbacks` of the chosen fallback. Null unless the rung is `fallback`.

fallback_label.description: Label of the chosen fallback. Null unless the rung is `fallback`.

custom_text.description: The seller's proposed text. Null unless the rung is `custom`.

justification.description: Why the seller proposes custom text, shown to Legal. Null unless the rung is `custom`.

removed.description: The seller dropped this optional clause from the round. A removed row is always on the standard rung.

added.description: The seller added this clause from the library; it is not a slot of the round's template. Added clauses need Legal review at submit.

mandatory.description: The pinned version cannot be removed from a round whose template holds it.

custom_allowed.description: The pinned version accepts custom text. When false the fallback ladder is exhaustive.

fallbacks.description: The fallback ladder the pinned version offers every issuing entity, in order.

standard_text.description: Standard text for display, as Markdown with `{{variable}}` placeholders. It is the body for the deal's issuing entity when the version has one, else the common body; submit selects the body again and resolves the variables. A submitted round shows the body submit selected, whatever the deal's issuer has become since.

carry_forward_note.description: Why the selection changed when it was carried forward from the previous round, such as a fallback the republished clause no longer offers. Null when it carried over unchanged or the seller has since changed it.

AdminDealQuoteClause.description: One clause of a quote round's order form, as the seller has chosen it.

data.description: The round's clauses, template slots first in template order and added clauses after in the order they were added. Empty when the round has no order-form template pinned.

clause_key.description: The clause's library key. A key that is not a slot of the round's template adds that clause, pinned to its active version.

fallback_index.description: Position of the chosen fallback in the clause's `fallbacks`. Required when the rung is `fallback`; ignored otherwise.

custom_text.description: The proposed text, as Markdown with `{{variable}}` placeholders. Required when the rung is `custom`; ignored otherwise.

justification.description: Why the standard and fallback texts do not fit, shown to Legal. Required when the rung is `custom`; ignored otherwise.

removed.description: Drop this optional clause from the round. A mandatory clause cannot be removed; a removed row is stored on the standard rung.

clauses.description: Every template row of the round, each exactly once, plus any added clause the round keeps. An added clause left out leaves the round.

quote_id.description: The quote round the artifact was rendered from.

kind.description: What kind of document this artifact is.

sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the stored document bytes.

created_by.description: Staff user who generated the artifact.

assumptions.description: Assumption overrides for this computation only. Defaults to the quote's stored assumptions.

sections.description: Section overrides for this computation only. Defaults to the quote's stored sections. Nothing is persisted either way.

content.description: The pasted or uploaded table as text. Tab-separated (a direct paste from a spreadsheet) and comma-separated content are both accepted; the first row must be the column headers. Provide exactly one of `content` or `content_xlsx`.

content_xlsx.description: An uploaded workbook (`.xlsx`), base64-encoded. Workbooks previously exported from a quote are matched back to their source round via the embedded metadata. Provide exactly one of `content` or `content_xlsx`.

confirm.description: False (the default) parses the table and returns the interpreted rows and column mapping without changing anything — review this echo first. True applies the parsed lines by opening the next negotiation round for the deal.

header.description: The column header as it appeared in the pasted or uploaded table.

field.description: The quote line field the column was mapped to, or `ignored` when the column carries no known field.

confidence.description: How certain the mapping is, 0 to 1. An exact header match is 1; alias matches score lower.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Unique per import.

monthly_volume.description: Committed monthly message volume for the country.

current_price.description: The customer's current unit price as a decimal string. Null when unknown.

sms_offer.description: Offered SMS unit price as a decimal string.

from.description: The value on the quote round the import is diffed against. Null when the field was unset.

to.description: The imported value. Null when the field is unset in the import.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the line.

change.description: How the imported line relates to the quote round it is diffed against.

fields.description: The line fields whose values moved, with the previous and imported value. Empty unless `change` is `changed`.

columns.description: How each table column was interpreted. Review before confirming.

lines.description: The parsed per-country rows, in table order. A confirmed import applies them to the quote's SMS/WhatsApp usage section.

issues.description: Non-fatal warnings raised while parsing, such as skipped empty rows.

diff.description: Per-country diff of the imported lines against the quote round they replace — lines added, removed, or with moved prices or volumes.

source_round.description: The round the uploaded workbook was exported from, read from its embedded metadata. Null for pasted tables or workbooks without metadata.

stale_round.description: True when the uploaded workbook was exported from a superseded round — the sheet being negotiated is older than the deal's latest pricing. Review the diff carefully before confirming.

quote.description: The new draft round the lines were applied to. Only present on a confirmed import.

entity_type.description: Registered kind of entity submitted for approval.

entity_id.description: Typed identifier of the submitted entity.

display_title.description: Business identity from the immutable submitted snapshot; older quote snapshots fall back to round identity.

tags.description: Consumer-owned review reasons frozen at submission.

current_step.description: Names of currently unmet stages and their current ordered steps; empty for a completed request.

note.description: Explanation returned to the quote author.

status.description: The transition to apply. `submitted` moves a draft to `approved` when every line clears the margin floor, or to `pending_approval` when any line prices below it. `sent` records that an approved quote went to the customer; `accepted` records the customer's acceptance of a sent quote.

name.description: The person's name, on one line.

email.description: A single plain email address; DocuSign sends the envelope there.

title.description: The person's title, on one line; their locked title tab prints it.

available.description: Whether signing is enabled and DocuSign is configured in this region.

ready.description: Whether all checks passed; sending checks the round again.

problems.description: Every failed signing check, including missing Finance authorization.

customer_contact.description: The primary contact frozen when the round was submitted, used to prefill the customer signer. Null when the round has no frozen customer context, including unsubmitted drafts and older rounds; the send request determines the signer.

signatory.description: The current Bird signatory, or null when signing is unavailable or Legal has not set one.

AdminDealSignatureEnvelopeStatus.description: Where signing stands. `creating` is a send in progress, which a retry of the same send resumes; `sent` means DocuSign sent it and the Bird signatory has not signed; `bird_signed` means the Bird signatory signed and the customer has not; `completed` means the customer signed too; `declined` means a signer declined; `voided` means it was withdrawn, by staff, by a new round or by DocuSign on expiry; `failed` means DocuSign refused the envelope and the round can be sent again.

name.description: The person's name, on one line.

email.description: A single plain email address; DocuSign sends the envelope there.

title.description: The person's title, on one line.

order_form_artifact_id.description: The stored order form the envelope carries.

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the order form bytes sent to DocuSign.

signatory.description: The Bird signatory as the signing settings named them at send.

sent_by.description: Staff user who sent the envelope.

contract_actor.description: The `admin:contracts` writer that completion records the execution and adopts the contract as, fixed at send.

failure.description: Why DocuSign refused the envelope, for a `failed` one.

execution_id.description: The contract whose execution completion recorded.

completion_error.description: Why completion is blocked; null while it is not.

data.description: The round's signature envelopes, newest first by default.

customer_signer.description: The customer's signer, who signs after the Bird signatory.

cc.description: Recipients who receive the completed document only. Each appears once, and neither the customer signer nor the Bird signatory may be copied.

reason.description: Why the envelope is withdrawn. DocuSign shows it to the recipients and caps it at 200 characters.
reason.example: Terms changed; a new round follows.
