PaginationLimit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

OrderDesc.name: order
OrderDesc.description: Sort direction. Defaults to `desc`, which sorts from newest to oldest or largest to smallest, depending on the selected sort field.

BirdAcquisition.name: Bird-Acquisition
BirdAcquisition.description: Percent-encoded JSON with consent set to granted and first and last touch objects. Each touch requires source, captured_at (RFC 3339), and a root-relative landing_path of at most 512 UTF-8 bytes without a query or fragment. Optional fields are medium, campaign, campaign_id, adgroup_id, content, term, locale, referrer_host and click identifiers. The first touch expires after 30 days. A null last touch uses the first touch. Missing, malformed, unconsented or expired context is recorded as unknown and never blocks authentication.

ConfirmationToken.name: Confirmation-Token
ConfirmationToken.description: The confirmation token from the emailed closure link. Minted by the matching closure-request endpoint and valid for 24 hours. A missing, expired, invalid, or already-used token is rejected.

OrderAsc.name: order
OrderAsc.description: Sort direction. Defaults to `asc`, which sorts alphabetically or from oldest to newest, depending on the selected sort field.

IncludeTotal.name: include_total
IncludeTotal.description: When true, the response includes a `total` field with the total number of items matching the request's filters across all pages.

XAssistantAuthorizationVersion.name: X-Assistant-Authorization-Version
XAssistantAuthorizationVersion.description: Current staff permission version returned by the Ask Bird capability check.

CountryPolicyPlatformFilter.name: platform
CountryPolicyPlatformFilter.description: Filter platform and sender policies to a single platform.

CreatedAfter.name: created_after
CreatedAfter.description: Limits the response to resources created at or after this timestamp. Combine it with `created_before` to select a time window. Use an RFC 3339 timestamp with a timezone offset.

CreatedBefore.name: created_before
CreatedBefore.description: Limits the response to resources created before this timestamp. Combine it with `created_after` to select a time window. Use an RFC 3339 timestamp with a timezone offset.

TagFilter.name: tag
TagFilter.description: Filter by tag. Accepts `name` to match any record carrying that tag name, or `name:value` to match a specific tag pair (for example `category:welcome`). Repeat the parameter to add more tags. A record must match every tag listed to be returned.

EmailBroadcastStatusFilter.name: status
EmailBroadcastStatusFilter.description: Filter by lifecycle status. Repeat the parameter to match more than one status, for example `?status=accepted&status=sending`.

EmailBroadcastAudienceFilter.name: audience_id
EmailBroadcastAudienceFilter.description: Filter by audience. Only broadcasts that use this audience are returned.

EmailBroadcastTagFilter.name: tag
EmailBroadcastTagFilter.description: Filter by tag. Pass `name` to match any broadcast that has that tag name, or pass `name:value` to match a specific tag pair, for example `campaign:spring_launch`.

EmailBroadcastSearchFilter.name: q
EmailBroadcastSearchFilter.description: Case-insensitive literal substring match against the broadcast's tags or the referenced template's name. With `email_management` read access, also matches the subject in the effective language of the template version resolved when this broadcast's execution starts. Draft and scheduled broadcasts have no execution subject to search. Percent signs, underscores, and backslashes are literal characters.

BroadcastTestIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
BroadcastTestIdempotencyKey.description:
Required key for one logical broadcast test send, scoped to the workspace, the authenticated
caller and this operation. Reuse the same key and the exact same request when retrying.

- A confirmed `202` response replays unchanged for the same key and request within the
  configured window, 3 hours by default. Authorization and the destination's member access are
  checked again on every retry.
- `409 request_in_progress` (E01004) or `503 IdempotencyUnavailable` (E01033): retry with
  backoff using the same key. Switching keys can send another test.
- `409 idempotency_key_reuse` (E01005): the key was used for a different request or
  broadcast. Use a new key for a different test send.
- After the window, saved results and unresolved requests can be removed. Reusing the key
  after removal can send another test, even if the earlier response was not confirmed.

XContentSHA256.name: X-Content-SHA256
XContentSHA256.description: Standard base64-encoded SHA-256 digest of the raw request body, using the same encoding as contact import upload-part digests (44 characters, 32 decoded bytes). Compute it from the exact bytes being submitted.

StatsTimezone.name: timezone
StatsTimezone.description: IANA timezone identifier used to group statistics, for example `Asia/Kathmandu`. The default is UTC. Day and hour boundaries, including the default window when `from` and `to` are omitted, follow this timezone. When this parameter is set, pass `from` and `to` as calendar days or `Z` instants instead of timestamps with explicit UTC offsets.

IncludeRemoved.name: include_removed
IncludeRemoved.description: Include banned and deleted organizations in the figures. Off by default, so the results reflect only active organizations.

ConversationInboxStatusFilter.name: inbox_status
ConversationInboxStatusFilter.description: Filter by workspace inbox status. Omit to include open and resolved conversations.

ConversationAssigneeFilter.name: assigned_to
ConversationAssigneeFilter.description: Return conversations assigned to this workspace member. Pass `me` for the signed-in user or `unassigned` for conversations without an assignee. An API key cannot use `me` and receives a `422` response.

ConversationLabelFilter.name: label
ConversationLabelFilter.description: Return conversations carrying this label. Repeat the parameter to require every supplied label.

WhatsAppStatsTemplateFilter.name: template
WhatsAppStatsTemplateFilter.description: Restricts the statistics to one template, identified by its ID (`wat_…`) or slug. Mutually exclusive with the other dimension filters (`category`, `phone_number`, `tag`); only one may be set per request. An ID matches the `template_id` key on a row of the per-template breakdown; a slug is accepted for callers that predate that key and resolves to the same messages.

EmailStatsTemplateFilter.name: template
EmailStatsTemplateFilter.description: Restricts the statistics to a template or a comma-separated union of templates, identified by ID (`emt_…`) or name. This parameter is mutually exclusive with other dimension filters.

EmailCompetitiveRange.name: range
EmailCompetitiveRange.description: How many days back the response covers, counting from now. One of three fixed trend windows rather than an open date range, matching how a competitive-intelligence chart is read. Defaults to 30.

EmailCompetitiveTimezone.name: timezone
EmailCompetitiveTimezone.description: IANA timezone identifier to report send times in; defaults to UTC. The grid is folded into this zone before it is summed, so a send lands on the weekday and hour it happened at locally rather than the one it happened at in UTC. A zone this API does not know returns 422 rather than falling back to UTC, so an axis is never labelled with a zone the figures were not folded into.

AdminCrmObjectParam.name: object
AdminCrmObjectParam.description: CRM record collection to read or manage. Existing Leads support provider-writable field updates; Lead notes require Bird-native write authority. Generic Lead creation remains unsupported.

AdminCrmAttributeParam.name: attribute
AdminCrmAttributeParam.description: Attribute API slug from this object’s field definitions.

AdminCrmOpportunityOutcome.name: stage_outcome
AdminCrmOpportunityOutcome.description: Filter opportunities by their current configured stage outcome. Unknown includes unmapped, missing or retired stages and source-managed catalogs. Omit to retain all stages. Combined with other filters; does not affect overview lead counts. A missing or invalid stage catalog returns 503.

AdminCrmOpportunityCurrency.name: currency
AdminCrmOpportunityCurrency.description: Exact recorded currency of opportunities, combined with all other filters. Amount bounds without currency and sort=amount without currency return 422. Does not convert values or affect lead counts in the overview.

AdminCrmExpectedCloseFrom.name: expected_close_from
AdminCrmExpectedCloseFrom.description: Inclusive earliest recorded expected-close date. Opportunities with no close date are excluded when either date bound is supplied. When listing records, requires object=deals; other objects return 422. Lead counts in the overview are unchanged.

AdminCrmExpectedCloseTo.name: expected_close_to
AdminCrmExpectedCloseTo.description: Inclusive latest recorded expected-close date, no earlier than expected_close_from; an earlier value returns 422. Dates are calendar dates without timezone conversion. When listing records, requires object=deals; other objects return 422. Lead counts in the overview are unchanged.

AdminCrmAmountMin.name: amount_min
AdminCrmAmountMin.description: Inclusive minimum recorded opportunity value. Exact decimal in the selected currency, which is required. Missing amounts are excluded. No conversion, probability weighting or revenue inference. When listing records, requires object=deals; other objects return 422. Lead counts in the overview are unchanged.

AdminCrmAmountMax.name: amount_max
AdminCrmAmountMax.description: Inclusive maximum recorded opportunity value, no smaller than amount_min; a smaller value returns 422. Exact decimal in the selected currency, which is required. Missing amounts are excluded. No conversion, probability weighting or revenue inference. When listing records, requires object=deals; other objects return 422. Lead counts in the overview are unchanged.

RequiredIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
RequiredIdempotencyKey.description: Required client-supplied deduplication key for this write. Reuse it for retries of the same intent. Successful results replay within the configured idempotency window (three hours by default); selected connected-app writes also replay uncertain-write conflicts. Use a new key only after confirming the prior result and beginning a different action.

AdminCrmRecordIdParam.name: record_id
AdminCrmRecordIdParam.description: CRM record identifier assigned by Bird or retained from an imported Attio record.

AdminCrmForecastPeriodStart.name: period_start
AdminCrmForecastPeriodStart.description: First expected-close date in the period, inclusive.

AdminCrmForecastPeriodEnd.name: period_end
AdminCrmForecastPeriodEnd.description: First expected-close date outside the period, exclusive. Must follow period_start.

schema.description: Explicit IANA business timezone, or UTC. Recorded expected-close dates are dates, not converted instants.

AdminCrmForecastScopeKind.name: scope_kind
AdminCrmForecastScopeKind.description: Seller scope requires exactly one member; omit scope_name or send an empty string. Whitespace-only scope_name is rejected. Team scope requires a nonblank scope_name and 1–200 unique nonzero members. Invalid combinations return 422.

AdminCrmForecastScopeName.name: scope_name
AdminCrmForecastScopeName.description: Required nonblank team name for team scope; omitted or an empty string for a seller. Whitespace-only seller names are rejected. Invalid scope/name combinations return 422. Renaming a team creates a different context and does not rewrite earlier submissions.

AdminCrmForecastMemberIds.name: member_ids
AdminCrmForecastMemberIds.description: Exact stable CRM owner-member roster. Seller scope requires one member; invalid scope/roster combinations return 422. Each item is a member TypeID or, until the CRM typed-ID transition closes, a bare UUID. Order is canonicalized; duplicates and unmapped recipients are refused on submission.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryFrom.name: from
AdminCrmSalesHistoryFrom.description: Inclusive start for retained history observations. Each operation defines which events or record revisions it includes.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryTo.name: to
AdminCrmSalesHistoryTo.description: Exclusive reporting end. Must be later than from, no later than the current server time, and at most 366 days after from.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryOwnerId.name: owner_id
AdminCrmSalesHistoryOwnerId.description: Filter the observed owner identity. Cannot be combined with owner_state.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryStageId.name: stage_id
AdminCrmSalesHistoryStageId.description: Filter the observed stage identity. Cannot be combined with stage_state.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryOwnerState.name: owner_state
AdminCrmSalesHistoryOwnerState.description: Select unassigned or uninterpretable owners. Cannot be combined with owner_id.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryStageState.name: stage_state
AdminCrmSalesHistoryStageState.description: Select unassigned or uninterpretable stages. Cannot be combined with stage_id.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryCurrency.name: currency_code
AdminCrmSalesHistoryCurrency.description: Restrict to observations containing this denomination on either side and compute value flows in this currency only. Omit to see mixed-denomination rows with no aggregate money totals.

schema.description: Three uppercase letters matching a captured denomination. Legacy values are accepted without ISO 4217 membership validation.

AdminCrmSalesHistoryChange.name: change
AdminCrmSalesHistoryChange.description: Limit the selected population to one kind of observed change.

AdminSupportWorkbenchThreadIdParam.name: thread_id
AdminSupportWorkbenchThreadIdParam.description: Exact Plain thread identifier returned by the support queue.

AdminSupportCommandRecoveryKey.name: Idempotency-Key
AdminSupportCommandRecoveryKey.description: Original command key for this staff member, operation and case or Plain conversation. Recovery finds the saved result or permanently cancels the original command before a replacement can be submitted.

AdminSupportOperationsSince.name: since
AdminSupportOperationsSince.description: Start of the history report window, up to 90 days ago. Defaults to 30 days ago. Keep the same value while paging.

AdminSupportTeamFilter.name: team
AdminSupportTeamFilter.description: Select work assigned to this specialist team.

AdminSupportUnassignedFilter.name: unassigned
AdminSupportUnassignedFilter.description: When true, only work without an owner. Cannot combine true with owner_user_id. Omitted or false includes all owners.

AdminSupportDueBeforeFilter.name: due_before
AdminSupportDueBeforeFilter.description: Include only dated obligations due strictly before this instant; all other supplied filters also apply.

AdminSupportUnfinishedFilter.name: unfinished
AdminSupportUnfinishedFilter.description: Select unfinished obligations, including handoffs already accepted. False or omission includes all statuses.

AdminSupportSearchFilter.name: search
AdminSupportSearchFilter.description: Find work whose title contains this text, ignoring case.

AdminSupportCreatedBeforeFilter.name: created_before
AdminSupportCreatedBeforeFilter.description: Select work created before this instant to review ageing obligations.

AdminSupportWorkbenchTranslate.name: translate
AdminSupportWorkbenchTranslate.description: Include English translations of support text when available. Original text is always preserved.

AdminEmailStatsFields.name: fields
AdminEmailStatsFields.description:
Metric groups to compute and return, comma-separated. Defaults to every group. A group left out is omitted from every point and from `totals`, and its aggregate states are not merged, which is what makes a narrow read cheap: pass `delivery` alone for a volume chart.
- `delivery`: the recipient lifecycle counts and rates (accepted through bounces and complaints). - `engagement`: opens, clicks, unsubscribes and their rates. - `latency`: the processing, delivery and end-to-end percentiles. - `block`: messages blocked by enforcement. Its `block_rate` is denominated on accepted recipients, a `delivery` count, so it is null unless `delivery` is requested too.

AdminAgenticDataThrough.name: data_through
AdminAgenticDataThrough.description: Last completed UTC day to include. Derive it from the overview period.to minus one UTC day. Use the oldest available regional cutoff when combining regions. Cannot be newer than this region's summary; omitted uses its own cutoff.

AdminContractAsOf.name: as_of
AdminContractAsOf.description: Evaluate status, effect, and current version at this instant, using UTC for contract start and end dates. Defaults to the current time.

AdminTrustInquiryId.name: inquiry_id
AdminTrustInquiryId.description: The Persona inquiry identifier, as it appears on the verification record.

AccountingPeriodFilter.name: period_id
AccountingPeriodFilter.description: Only return records from this accounting period.

AutomationEventWorkspaceId.name: workspace_id
AutomationEventWorkspaceId.description: Workspace that owns the automation. This routes the event and does not authenticate the sender.

AdminBillingReportFrom.name: report_from
AdminBillingReportFrom.description: Start of the optional financial report, inclusive. Supply with report_to. Both boundaries must be midnight UTC and cover at most 92 complete days. Omit both to leave the report out of the response.

AdminBillingReportTo.name: report_to
AdminBillingReportTo.description: End of the optional financial report, exclusive. Supply with report_from. An incomplete pair, partial UTC day, future day or window longer than 92 days returns 422. Reporting dates do not change the list's pagination or filters.

AdminRevenueFrom.name: from
AdminRevenueFrom.description: Inclusive start at midnight UTC. The report accepts at most 92 complete days.

AdminRevenueTo.name: to
AdminRevenueTo.description: Exclusive end at midnight UTC, no later than the start of today.

NetSuiteIssueMonth.name: month
NetSuiteIssueMonth.description: Invoice issue month in UTC. Must be YYYY-MM, 1900-01 or later, and no later than the current month.

NetSuiteExpectedDigest.name: expected_digest
NetSuiteExpectedDigest.description: Digest from the other file's X-Export-Digest header. Returns 409 if either export changed; download both files again.

AdminSalesRecoveryIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
AdminSalesRecoveryIdempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key and exact reviewed request, as the same staff member, after an uncertain result. The source recovery action retains its original result while its source and receipt remain available, beyond the default replay window. Current access and erasure are checked again on each attempt. Changed input with the same key is rejected; begin a new reviewed action only after the earlier result is known.

AdminSalesProspectSource.name: source
AdminSalesProspectSource.description: Prospect entry kind, applied before pagination. Distinct from the saved attribution source label.

AdminSalesProspectAttributionSource.name: attribution_source
AdminSalesProspectAttributionSource.description: Search the saved first-touch source or fallback referrer host.

AdminSalesMailContactID.name: thread_id
AdminSalesMailContactID.description: Acquisition identifying a retained Sales inquiry or sign-up contact. A sign-up does not need an existing inbox conversation.

AdminSalesDemandAttributionSource.name: attribution_source
AdminSalesDemandAttributionSource.description: Exact nonempty saved first-touch source. Use attribution_unknown for arrivals without one.

AdminSalesDemandProduct.name: product
AdminSalesDemandProduct.description: Exact nonempty submitted product. Use product_unknown for arrivals without one.

AdminSalesDemandCommercialSeller.name: commercial_seller
AdminSalesDemandCommercialSeller.description: Filter by the captured CRM member, as a member TypeID or the bare UUID accepted until the CRM typed-ID transition closes, unassigned, or unknown at the selected commercial outcome. Unknown also includes arrivals with no attributable observed commercial outcome; it is not limited to observed outcomes with missing seller history. Requires milestone agreement_signed, billing_adopted or billing_applied; other combinations return 422. It scopes arrivals, counts, groups, cursors and exports and never means current ownership or target credit.

AdminSalesDemandIncludeTotal.name: include_total
AdminSalesDemandIncludeTotal.description: When true and the generation is ready, includes the total number of matching items across all pages. Demand responses omit total when this parameter is false or absent, and for pending, building, failed and stale generations; they do not return null in these cases.

AdminSalesInboundStatusFilter.name: status
AdminSalesInboundStatusFilter.description: Restrict to threads in this conversation status.

AdminSalesInboundThreadID.name: thread_id
AdminSalesInboundThreadID.description: Sales inbox thread to read. A demo-form thread is identified by its acquisition.

AdminSalesAgentInquiryID.name: inquiry_id
AdminSalesAgentInquiryID.description: Retained demo request or signup to continue into a pursuit.

AdminSalesAIReviewIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
AdminSalesAIReviewIdempotencyKey.description: Required key for this exact staff review. Reuse the same key and request after an uncertain response. The original review replays while retained, after checking current staff access and source retention. The key is scoped to the acting staff identity and source; changed intent within that scope conflicts. Another authorized staff member may reuse the same key for a distinct review. This operation does not use the generic response-cache replay window.

AdminSalesAIHandlingIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
AdminSalesAIHandlingIdempotencyKey.description: Optional key for this exact handling change or approval, scoped to the acting staff identity and source. Another authorized staff member may reuse the same key for a distinct mutation. Reuse the same key and request after an uncertain response. A retained matching request returns current handling without repeating its mutation, after checking current staff access and source retention. Changed intent conflicts when that key has a retained receipt. A keyed same-state rearm retains its receipt without counting as an intervention; reuse the exact request to recover it. This operation does not use the generic response-cache replay window.

SalesDocumentRevisionFilter.name: revision
SalesDocumentRevisionFilter.description: Only return entries for this content revision. Omit to include all revisions.

AdminNumbersHolderOfRecordNumber.name: number
AdminNumbersHolderOfRecordNumber.description: The number to look up, in E.164 format. The leading `+` is required; a bare-digits or otherwise formatted number is refused.

AutomationExecutionStatusFilter.name: status
AutomationExecutionStatusFilter.description: Limits the response to executions in this state.

AutomationExecutionVersionIDFilter.name: version_id
AutomationExecutionVersionIDFilter.description: Limits the response to executions of this immutable published version. Draft executions do not match.

AutomationExecutionFailureCodeFilter.name: failure_code
AutomationExecutionFailureCodeFilter.description: Limits the response to executions with this stable platform failure code. Older compacted executions with unavailable metadata do not match.

AutomationExecutionExitReasonFilter.name: exit_reason
AutomationExecutionExitReasonFilter.description: Limits the response to executions with this authored explicit-exit reason. Older compacted executions with unavailable metadata do not match.

AdminAcquisitionModel.name: model
AdminAcquisitionModel.description: First saved touch or last saved touch. Last falls back to first when the supplied last touch is missing, invalid or earlier than first; either can be direct.

AdminAcquisitionTo.name: to
AdminAcquisitionTo.description: Exclusive UTC cohort end, at most 92 days after the start.

AdminAcquisitionProduct.name: product
AdminAcquisitionProduct.description: Product selected on the sales inquiry.

AdminAcquisitionIncludeOrganizationIDs.name: include_organization_ids
AdminAcquisitionIncludeOrganizationIDs.description: Include founding organization IDs and unresolved organization links for each campaign cohort.

BillingIssuedAfterFilter.name: issued_after
BillingIssuedAfterFilter.description: Return documents issued at or after this timestamp.

BillingIssuedBeforeFilter.name: issued_before
BillingIssuedBeforeFilter.description: Return documents issued at or before this timestamp.

DemoCaptchaToken.name: X-Captcha-Token
DemoCaptchaToken.description: Fresh CAPTCHA token for the demo form. A successful validation or submission consumes the challenge.

DemoSubmissionToken.name: X-Demo-Submission-Token
DemoSubmissionToken.description: Private 32-byte submission proof encoded as unpadded base64url. Keep the same secret for retries of one idempotency key, and keep it separate from that key and the submitted contact details.

DemoToken.name: X-Demo-Token
DemoToken.description: Private capability returned when this demo inquiry was accepted.

EsimAnalyticsFrom.name: from
EsimAnalyticsFrom.description: Inclusive window start at midnight UTC. The window accepts at most 92 days.

EsimAnalyticsTo.name: to
EsimAnalyticsTo.description: Exclusive window end at midnight UTC, no later than the start of tomorrow. When it is later than as_of, the final day is still filling.

VoiceShortLegThreshold.name: short_leg_threshold_ms
VoiceShortLegThreshold.description: Duration in milliseconds below which an answered leg counts toward `short_legs`. Defaults to 30 seconds. Each response echoes the value it used.

VoiceStatsDestination.name: destination
VoiceStatsDestination.description: When set, limits the statistics to calls to this destination country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. This is the drill-down from a row of the destination breakdown, and it matches the same country that breakdown reports for a call.

VoiceStatsTrunkID.name: trunk_id
VoiceStatsTrunkID.description: When set, limits the statistics to calls carried by this SIP trunk. This is the drill-down from a row of the trunk breakdown. Calls that used no trunk, such as Verify voice calls, match no value here and are excluded whenever it is set.

VoiceStatsOwnNumber.name: own_number
VoiceStatsOwnNumber.description: When set, limits the statistics to calls on this number of yours, in E.164 form. It matches your own end of the call, which is the caller on an outbound leg and the recipient on an inbound one. It is named apart from the call log's `number` because that one matches either party, where this one is always your end. A number that has no standard form matches exactly as the network presented it, so an unusual one is still searchable. A value that matches no call gives an empty result rather than an error, as any unmatched filter does. To narrow by the party you called instead, use `destination`.

VoiceStatsStatus.name: status
VoiceStatsStatus.description: When set, limits the statistics to calls with one of these statuses, comma-separated. Four of the vocabulary's values match nothing here, for three different reasons: these statistics cover ended calls only, so `ringing` and `in_progress` are outside their scope; `busy` and `canceled` are not emitted yet and arrive as `failed` today; and no call is stored as `other`, which the outcome split uses for a status it does not name. The five that do match are `answered`, `no_answer`, `failed`, `rejected` and `unknown`.

VoiceStatsBreakdownLimit.name: limit
VoiceStatsBreakdownLimit.description: Maximum groups returned, ranked by the requested metric. The response total counts all matching groups before this limit.

EsimSubscriberFilter.name: subscriber_id
EsimSubscriberFilter.description: Return eSIMs assigned to this subscriber.

EsimTagFilter.name: tag
EsimTagFilter.description: Filter by tag. Accepts `name` to match any eSIM carrying that tag name, or `name:value` to match a specific tag pair (e.g. `trip:summer`). A trailing colon (`name:`) matches the name alone, the same as `name`. A term with an empty name is rejected. Repeat the parameter to AND-combine several tag filters.

EsimIccidPrefixFilter.name: iccid_prefix
EsimIccidPrefixFilter.description: Keep only eSIMs whose ICCID starts with these digits. Use it when you hold only the first part of an ICCID. Pass `iccid` instead when you hold the whole number.

VoiceSequenceRunStatusFilter.name: status
VoiceSequenceRunStatusFilter.description: Return runs with this execution status.

VoiceSequenceRunVersionIDFilter.name: version_id
VoiceSequenceRunVersionIDFilter.description: Return runs pinned to this published version.

VoiceSequenceRunFailureCodeFilter.name: failure_code
VoiceSequenceRunFailureCodeFilter.description: Return runs with this exact retained failure code.

VoiceSequenceRunExitReasonFilter.name: exit_reason
VoiceSequenceRunExitReasonFilter.description: Return runs with this exact retained exit reason.

VoiceSequenceStatsModeFilter.name: mode
VoiceSequenceStatsModeFilter.description: Run modes to include. Defaults to `production`.

VoiceSequenceStatsSequenceID.name: sequence_id
VoiceSequenceStatsSequenceID.description: Limits results to a retained sequence in this workspace, including an archived or deleted sequence. An unknown sequence returns 404.

VoiceSequenceStatsVersionID.name: version_id
VoiceSequenceStatsVersionID.description: Limits results to a retained publication of the selected sequence. Requires `sequence_id`; an unknown or mismatched publication returns 404.

VoiceSequenceStatsSequenceIDs.name: sequence_ids
VoiceSequenceStatsSequenceIDs.description: Comma-separated sequence IDs to include in the results. Omit to include all matching retained sequences in the workspace. An empty selector returns 422; an unknown or foreign sequence returns 404.

VoiceSequenceStatsRequiredSequenceID.name: sequence_id
VoiceSequenceStatsRequiredSequenceID.description: Sequence whose retained publications to read, including an archived or deleted sequence. An unknown or foreign sequence returns 404.

VoiceSequenceId.name: sequence_id
VoiceSequenceId.description: ID of the named voice sequence.

AutomationStatsAutomationIDs.name: automation_ids
AutomationStatsAutomationIDs.description: Comma-separated automation IDs whose rows should be returned. Use this or automation_id, not both. Omission includes all matching automations; an empty selector returns 422. The selector does not change independently requested workspace summaries.

AutomationStatsRequiredAutomationID.name: automation_id
AutomationStatsRequiredAutomationID.description: Automation whose published versions are compared.

AutomationStatsAutomationID.name: automation_id
AutomationStatsAutomationID.description: Restricts statistics to one automation. Omission includes all automations in the workspace.

AutomationStatsVersionID.name: version_id
AutomationStatsVersionID.description: Restricts statistics to one immutable published version. Omitting its owning `automation_id` returns 422. A version not found under that automation in the current workspace returns 404.

Unprocessable.description: The request has invalid field values, violates a business rule, or carries a query parameter the endpoint does not declare. Field validation errors use `type: validation_error` and include the affected fields in `details`. Business-rule errors identify the failed rule in `type`.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The service is temporarily unavailable. If `Retry-After` is present, wait for that delay before retrying; otherwise, retry with exponential backoff. Reuse the same idempotency key and request when retrying a mutation.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body or message size exceeds the allowed limit

Gone.description: The resource existed but is no longer available.

MisdirectedRequest.description: The request reached the wrong regional endpoint. The organization or API key belongs to a different region; reissue the request against the regional host named in the error message.

TooEarly.description: The resource is not available yet. Retry shortly.

RateLimit.description: Remaining capacity for the request's rate-limit policy as an IETF Structured Field. Format: `"<policy>";r=<remaining>;t=<seconds_until_reset>`.

RateLimit-Policy.description: Effective quota for the request's rate-limit policy as an IETF Structured Field. Format: `"<policy>";q=<quota>;w=<window_seconds>`.

RetryAfter.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

ContentDisposition.description:
Indicates the response is a file attachment and carries the suggested
download filename, for example `attachment; filename="invoice-2600042.pdf"`.

IdempotencyReplay.description: The API includes this header when it replays the response for an earlier request that used the same `Idempotency-Key`. The API does not process the request again.

CacheControl.description: Caching directives for the response, for example `public, max-age=3600`.

NetSuiteExportDigest.description: SHA-256 digest covering the month and both CSVs. Pass as expected_digest when downloading the other file.

NetSuiteExportNotice.description: Data provenance and missing-service-period notice for the prepared export pair, when applicable.
